rows.title: Intelligence and Data Analyst Development Programme
rows.descriptionText:
Location(s)@: LondonHours of Work: 36 hours a week. Full time, office-basedSalary: £40,428 rising to £43,705 after one year
Job descriptionLocation: London, with time split across two locations in Central and West London (Zones 1 and 2)This programme is expected to attract significant interest and may close within a short time frame, so early applications are encouraged.Flexible working: throughout most of the five-and-a-half-year programme, you’ll be able to benefit from flexitime and compressed hours, subject to business need. However, during the initial four-month training period, you will need to follow fixed full-time hours (36 hours per week, Monday to Friday). Remote, hybrid or home working are not possible in this role.
About usMI5 keeps the country safe from serious threats like terrorism and attempts by states to harm the UK, its people and way of life. We carry out investigations by obtaining, analysing and assessing intelligence, and then work with a range of partners, including MI6 and GCHQ to disrupt these threats. Through our protective security arm, we provide advice and guidance to government, businesses and other organisations about how to keep themselves safe. A role in MI5 means you’ll do unique and challenging work in a supportive and encouraging environment, making a real difference to UK national security.
The programmeJoining the Intelligence and Data Analyst Development Programme (IDADP) means committing to a five-and-a-half-year structured pathway designed to build the skills, experience and confidence needed to become a fully trained Intelligence and Data Analyst (IDA).Why does it take five-and-a-half years? Because IDAs play a vital role in protecting the UK. Working with colleagues across MI5, partner agencies and UK allies, they turn complex, incomplete information into insight that shapes investigative decisions. IDAs work with a wide range of data and tools to uncover hard-to-spot patterns, connect activity that appears unrelated, and help investigative teams understand threats, risks and opportunities.To do this well, IDAs need a strong foundation in analytical tradecraft, sound judgement, growing technical capability and the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-moving investigative environment. These are not skills you can develop overnight, which is why we’ve created a rigorous programme that builds capability through structured training, guided practice and varied postings. It’s a steep learning curve, but you’ll have dedicated support from managers, development partners and your programme cohort throughout.We run several development programmes, each leading to different long-term careers. Consider carefully which programme best suits your strengths and interests, as you cannot transfer between pathways once recruited.
Your five and a half-year development pathwayThis pathway reflects the structure most people follow, though exact postings may vary depending on business need. While the programme usually includes three postings, some may be extended, meaning you complete two longer placements instead. As MI5’s analytical capability evolves, your pathway may adapt too, but every stage will be designed to build your skills and support your long term development. Because postings are aligned to business need, they’re assigned for you rather than chosen, ensuring you gain the right experience at the right time.Stage 1: intensive analytical training for four monthsYou’ll begin with a full-time, office-based training period where you’ll learn how to work with multiple types of data, apply structured analytical techniques, use advanced tools, and approach open-ended problems. Training combines classroom learning, hands-on practice and collaborative exercises with your cohort. To help you get the most from this essential training, annual leave cannot be taken during this period.Stage 2: your first analytical posting for two to two-and-a-half yearsAfter training, you’ll join an analysis delivery team for a posting lasting between two and two-and-a-half years. Here, you’ll refine investigative requirements, work with complex datasets and produce intelligence products that support investigations. As your confidence grows, you’ll operate with increasing autonomy, present findings clearly and collaborate with partners across MI5.Stage 3: your next postings (for the remainder of your pathway)You’ll then complete one or two further postings. These may be within other analysis delivery teams working directly on investigations, or within a non-delivery area of analysis, such as training or tradecraft development to help improve our capabilities. These posts will broaden your experience and strengthen your understanding of how analytical capability develops across MI5.Across these postings, you’ll deepen your technical expertise, including coding and querying, and learn to adapt as analytical tools, technologies and threats evolve. You’ll also contribute to the wider analytical community by sharing knowledge, supporting peers and refining analysis methods.Postings may be based in either Central or West London, so you must be prepared and able to work at either location.After the ProgrammeBy the end of the IDADP, you’ll have a strong analytical foundation and a skillset in high demand across the Intelligence community. You’ll be ready to continue your career as an IDA or move into a range of specialist roles across MI5. Many analysts progress into specialist analysis roles, support operational teams, develop analytical tradecraft, mentor others, or contribute to emerging technical capabilities.
About youTo join you must either have:at least one year of full-time experience in a role where you have developed and applied the core skills needed for analysis. This should include analysing data to draw conclusions, making evidence-based decisions, identifying patterns, managing competing priorities, communicating insight and collaborating effectively with others.a 2:1 degree (or equivalent) in any subject where your studies involved working with or interpreting data in a structured way. This might include analysing data to identify patterns or trends or to draw informed conclusions. What matters is that your degree required you to work with and analyse data to reach sound, reasoned decisions.You don’t need to be a trained analyst – nobody arrives with the full skillset. What matters is that you can spot patterns, think critically, work with incomplete or ambiguous information and build a clear picture from different sources. Curiosity, a growth mindset and a willingness to learn will be essential to your success.Equally essential are adaptability and resilience. Postings are assigned based on business need and may evolve as our tools, technologies and analytical approaches adapt to a constantly shifting threat landscape. Being comfortable applying your skills in new and unfamiliar situations – and collaborating closely with analysts, Intelligence Officers and operational teams – is essential. The role also involves listening to and analysing audio information, so you will be required to pass a hearing test if needed for your post. If you wear hearing aids, you’ll be able to complete the test using them.
Looking for a different pathway into analysis?If you’re interested in an analytical career with MI5 but aren’t sure if the IDADP is right for you, or if you don’t already hold a 2:1 degree or have the required work experience, applications for our Operations Analysts (also known as Real-Time Analysts) will open in November. Working shifts as part of a team operating around the clock, you’ll assess intelligence in real time, identify emerging threats and patterns, and provide insight that supports operational decision making. Keep an eye on our jobs page or, register with us and sign up for job alerts and we’ll let you know when applications open.
Learning and developmentYour development combines classroom learning, hands-on analytical work and continuous upskilling. During the initial training period, you’ll learn how to handle data, apply structured analytical methods, use advanced tools and solve complex problems.In your postings, you’ll apply these skills to real investigative work – organising datasets, identifying patterns, prioritising tasks, collaborating with colleagues and communicating insight clearly. You’ll also build strengths in problem-solving, communication, collaboration and decision-making.Each year, you’ll have 12 protected learning and development days, as well as access to technical upskilling and internal training, with your skills validated through an accreditation process. Throughout, you’ll be supported by your development partner, line manager, cohort and experienced analysts.
Your work-life balanceWe recognise the importance of a healthy work-life balance. Throughout the majority of the programme, you’ll be able to benefit from flexitime and compressed hours are available through most of the programme, subject to business need. During the initial four-month training period, fixed, full-time hours apply and annual leave cannot be taken. Across the programme, you may need to work longer hours, but you will receive time off in lieu. Remote or home working is not possible in this role. Find out more on our work-life balance page.
Some of our benefitsYou will enjoy 25 days’ annual leave, rising to 30 days after 5 years' service, alongside 8 bank holidays and 2.5 additional leave days (set dates through the year). We also offer an excellent pension scheme, an interest-free season ticket loan and lots more. Discover more about our full range of benefits.
Equal opportunitiesTo protect the UK, we need a truly diverse workforce that reflects the society we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all individuals, particularly those who are currently under-represented in our workforce, such as:those from an ethnic minority backgroundwomenpeople with disabilities or neurodivergent conditionsthose from low socio-economic backgroundsThis is part of our commitment to building a culture that is welcoming and inclusive of people with different identities, lived experiences, and perspectives, and where everyone has the confidence to bring their whole self to work. Find out more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion.
Before you apply Due to the sensitive nature of our work, there are some eligibility criteria you’ll need to meet (as well as our recommendations to aid your application). You will need to:be a British citizen or hold dual British nationality. Read more on our eligibility criteriago through vetting and comply with our no drugs policy. Learn more about the vetting processfamiliarise yourself with our guidance on the use of artificial intelligence tools in applicationscomplete your application and all subsequent recruitment processes from within the UKThis programme is based in London, so you’ll need to live within a commutable distance. You must be willing and able to work across two London locations (one in Central London and one in West London, both Zones 1-2) at different points in the programme. Please consider the financial and practical implications before applying. A relocation loan is available to support those moving to London. Remote or home working is not possible due to the secure nature of our work.We’d recommend using a different email address (with no identifying features e.g. first and/or surnames and date of birth) for your contact with us. This will help keep your personal and application correspondence separate, and more secure.You should not discuss your application, other than with your partner or a close family member.We offer reasonable reimbursement of travel costs for candidates attending in-person appointments during the recruitment and vetting process. Full details will be provided with your interview or assessment invitation.Reimbursement is discretionary and will only be made in line with the Candidate Expenses Policy, as amended from time to time. Candidates must book their own travel, using the most economical option, and provide original hardcopy receipts for reimbursement.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Nexgen CloudNexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.
We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.
THE ROLE: Data AnalystNexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.
What You'll Be DoingRather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the wayOwn the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performingCheck that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and creditsSupport commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churnModel pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbersValidate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the companyHelp the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data
About YouWe care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:EssentialHands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projectsStrong SQL and Excel skillsSolid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagreeHands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build workA root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it
Nice To HaveExperience with DatabricksExposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based businessSome experience with financial modelling or FP&A workTime spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built
What We OfferCompetitive salary and annual discretionary bonus schemeEmployee wellbeing benefits25 days holiday, plus public holidaysPrivate Medical InsuranceEnhanced Pension SchemeFlexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experimentVisible, meaningful impact as we scaleClear career progression in a high-growth companyA collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownershipThe chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future
WHY APPLYWe welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.
MORE INFORMATIONVisit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

rows.title: Data & AI Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Data Analyst

Our Data & AI team is made up of curious, client‑focused professionals who help organisations turn data into insight, decisions, and action. We’re looking for a Data Analyst who combines strong business analysis capability with data product management skills to shape, define, and deliver high‑value use cases across analytics, AI, and modern data platforms.

If you’re passionate about understanding how businesses work, translating that into well‑defined data and AI use cases, and working closely with both business and technology stakeholders, we’d love to talk.

Together We Do What Matters.

Come join us

As a member of Avanade’s Data & AI practice, you’ll work at the intersection of business and technology, helping clients unlock value from their data across AI, Agentic AI, data platforms, reporting, and analytics. You’ll play a critical role in shaping data‑driven products and solutions, ensuring they are well‑defined, client‑centric, and deliver measurable outcomes.

This role is ideal for analytically minded professionals who are curious, collaborative, and motivated by driving meaningful change through data.

What You’ll Do

Partner with clients to understand business problems, opportunities, and priorities, translating them into clear data, analytics, and AI use casesCombine business analysis and data product thinking to define scope, success measures, roadmaps, and requirements for data‑driven solutionsAnalyse source systems, APIs, and data feeds, assessing data quality, structure, and suitability for analytics and AI use casesDesign and document analytics‑focused data models, including dimensional models and star schemasProduce source‑to‑target mappings, business rules, and transformation logic to support data engineering and analytics deliveryWork closely with data engineers, architects, and AI specialists to ensure requirements are well understood and effectively deliveredEngage confidently with both business and technology stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor and translator between worldsSupport the evolution of data products over time, incorporating feedback, learning, and changing business needs

Qualifications

Skills and experience

Proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Consultant within data, analytics, or AI programmesStrong background in business analysis, including requirements definition, stakeholder engagement, and use‑case developmentExperience analysing source systems, APIs, and data integrations, with an understanding of how operational data is used for analyticsSolid knowledge of data modelling for analytics, particularly dimensional modelling and star schemasHands‑on experience producing source‑to‑target mappings and working with data engineers to support implementationUnderstanding of modern data platforms and analytics architectures, ideally within Microsoft or cloud‑based ecosystemsExcellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non‑technical audiencesExperience with technologies such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric is advantageous

About You

Characteristics that can spell success in this role include:

Naturally curious and analytical, with a strong desire to understand why things work the way they doPassionate about driving change through data, analytics, and AI, not just producing outputsClient‑centric, with a clear focus on outcomes, value, and measurable impactComfortable working across ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder landscapesConfident engaging with senior business stakeholders and technology teams alikePragmatic, collaborative, and able to balance rigour with paceKeen to continuously learn, develop, and stay current with emerging data and AI trends

Enjoy your career

Some Of The Best Things About Working At Avanade

Opportunity to work for Microsoft’s Global Alliance Partner of the Year (20 times)A minimum of 80 hours per year dedicated to learning, certifications, and professional developmentAccess to global Data & AI communities, accelerators, and subject‑matter expertsThe chance to work on cutting‑edge initiatives across AI, Agentic AI, analytics, and modern data platformsClear and supported career progression across Consultant and Senior Consultant levels

A great place to work

At Avanade, you’ll gain distinctive experiences, limitless learning, and ambitious growth in return for your skills and ideas. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels a strong sense of belonging and is empowered to do their best work.

You’ll join a supportive community of collaborators who will mentor, challenge, and learn alongside you — in a company purpose‑built for business‑critical, leading‑edge technology solutions that improve how people work, interact, and live.

We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.

Over the years we’ve grown into a leading UK lifestyle brand with over 80 shops across the UK and Ireland, 400+ wholesale partners and a thriving online business, but never losing touch of our roots.

Our passion for well-crafted clothing, exemplary customer service and connection to our local communities drives everything we do. As we continue to grow in the UK and internationally, we are focussed on delivering excellence across every touchpoint, whether that is at our warehouse, in store or through our customer service channels, building a team that shares our values.

Each employee plays a part in the success of Seasalt, and this was evidenced by our Drapers Award win of “Best Place to Work”.

Like all our retail employees, our Sales Advisors are ambassadors for Seasalt, embodying our values by putting our customers at the heart of everything they do. They are an essential part of the team, supporting store management and creating a memorable shopping experience for every customer.

We have a brilliant opportunity for a Part Time Sales Advisor on a 12 hour temporary contract to join the team in our beautiful shop in Ilkley.

You'll Help Us By

Delivering an exceptional and inspiring service, demonstrating a thorough knowledge of our brand, products, design inspiration and servicesRecommending additional services and solutions to our customers to drive sales and gather customer dataActively driving sales across channels by introducing customers to our website, using it as a selling tool and supporting with the processing of online ordersHaving a first point resolution approach to any customer issues or feedback and actively seeking out solutions for the benefit of the customerSupporting the Store Manager and team to drive store sales, profitability and consistent KPI achievementHelping with implementing store visual merchandising, windows standards and guidelines and utilising all product, categories, and bestseller information to maximise commercial opportunities within the storeHaving a flexible approach to your work, playing an active role in all operational tasks such as management of stock, loss prevention, health and safety, and store safety standards amongst others

Your high standards of customer service will be really important to you and is extremely valued in this role. The enthusiasm and energy you have shines through as you enjoy working and being a part of a team of like-minded people. Effectively communicating both with your team and our customers will come naturally.

The commitment you have to your work is evident and you enjoy seeing the results of this. Difficult situations don’t phase you as you are able to adapt, show resilience and have the confidence to work independently.

Why We Hope You'll Love Working With Us

The success of Seasalt is down to the skill and hard work of our team. We don't just want to attract the best and brightest people to come and work with us, we want you to stay and grow with us.

Benefits

As well as doing everything we can to boost your development professionally, we believe encouraging personal growth is just as important. So you can fulfil your passion and purpose, not just at work but in life, we offer a range of benefits that are designed to enhance your career and wellbeing. These include:

Hourly rate: £13.1031 days (FTE) paid annual leave, increasing with length of serviceUniform allowanceAttractive 50% employee discountHealth Cash Plan scheme to cover costs of everyday health expenses plus virtual 24/7 GP ServiceFree access to our Employee Assistance Programme through Retail Trust with 24/7 support including mental health support and counsellingFlexible benefits scheme to personalise your benefits packageEnhanced family leave policiesPension Scheme with generous 7% employer contributionsLife assurance programmeLearning and Development opportunitiesDo Good Things with our two days per year paid volunteering opportunitiesEmployee networks to develop and provide support to our people, including the Inclusion Network100’s of savings on top retailers and gym memberships through our discount hub

At Seasalt we have a brilliant team of people – they're what make Seasalt a fantastic place to work. rows.title: Sales Graduate
rows.descriptionText:
We're looking for enthusiastic graduates who want to start a career in tech sales in the energy space starting this autumn. 
General Index (GX) delivers future-proof commodity prices. Our spot prices and forward curves are calculated algorithmically based on thousands of daily trades collated from 200+ data partners, using transparent and consistent methodologies and a compliant approach. Producing 6000+ daily prices in crude oil, refined products, natural gas and energy transition, we democratise access to benchmarks that represent real market activity. We’re easy to use, with hassle-free integrations and straight-forward licensing - providing more choice to the industry.  With offices in London, Krakow, Houston and Singapore, GX is now scaling our go-to-market team and we are looking for enthusiastic graduates to join us, learning and growing alongside our business. 
You are: Curious. You know that being a great salesperson requires a strong understanding of our data, technology and industry, as well as going above and beyond to know our customers’ and prospects’ challenges inside out.Exceptionally proactive. At GX we hire smart people to tell us what to do, not to tell them what to do – which is why we’re running a graduate scheme for sales. If something is not entirely clear, you find a way by asking questions and experimenting. We are still building our playbook and we want you to be a part of that journey.Customer-centric. You care that our customers have a first-class experience with us and want them to thrive post-sale (not just during the sales process).Ambitious and driven. You want to win and celebrate success with your team – ensuring we take GX to the next level.Resilient. You understand that prospecting is tough and are able to handle objections and rejections along the way. Cold calling is a big part of the job, and you understand that it takes practice and persistence to succeed.A team player. You enjoy collaborating with different departments in the business.Commercially-savvy. You are comfortable working with numbers, working alongside our sales management to pull together complex proposals.
You offer: A track record of strong results and strong work ethic – whether this be at university or working in other roles that prepare you for a career in sales. Ability to travel (occasionally) to visit prospects and customers in-person.Digital skills. You are digitally and AI-savvy and passionate about technology.\
You will: Learn how to carry out outbound prospecting to key personas on our target account list across energy, financial services and consulting industries.Learn how to carry out high quality qualification and discovery with outbound and inbound leads, both in online calls, in-person meetings and industry events.Learn how to build relationships with industry professionals, learning how to multi-thread to ensure we expand across strategic accounts using email, calls and LinkedIn.Learn how to use the latest AI tools to move at speed.Develop a firm understanding of our data and markets – articulate how our data products solve problems and create opportunities for our customers.Use our sales and marketing stack to ensure rigour and efficiency, employing tools such as HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Gong to work in a data-driven and AI-enabled way. Learn how to manage a thriving pipeline, using sales methodology (e.g. MEDPICC) to ensure we align with our ideal customer profiles and company goals.Do high-quality demos of our data using our GX Go interface. Work alongside the team on renewals of accounts, ensuring we seek expansion opportunities and keep our customers happy.Use data from our customer analytics tool (PostHog) to ensure data-driven high-quality conversations with users. 
We offer: 1 year graduate scheme, with the opportunity to land a full-time role in our sales team. This includes regular mentoring with our C-Suite. Office in Covent Garden.Competitive base salary and commissions program.Private healthcare with BUPA.Pension scheme.Structured development, with a track record of internal promotions.Regular off sites and team socials, with a positive and high-energy culture.
Don't meet all the requirements? At GX we believe that professional development happens through teaching and learning from your peers and managers. Even if you’re uncertain about whether you have the experience we’re looking for, please apply if this position sparks your curiosity. 
A diversity of identity, perspective, and experience makes us stronger. We welcome you to apply to GX regardless of your background, age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, or ability.

rows.title: 2027 Industry Placement, Events and Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About the Role

Are you passionate about marketing and delivering high-quality results? Are you looking to work on a wide range of marketing projects, and gain exposure to all aspects of the marketing mix? We’re looking for an intern to join our UK & Ireland Corporate marketing team, to help support delivery and implementation of the UK & Ireland and EMEA marketing strategy, as well as to provide operational support on the day-to-day running of the function.

You will have a busy, diverse, hands-on-role which will touch on all aspects of the marketing programme, from supporting planning processes through to implementation and delivery of key initiatives. You will work closely with the EMEA marketing leader, senior marketing executive, the UK & Ireland segment marketing teams, country marketing teams and the global functional marketing teams. You will also work with senior stakeholders in the business and key account teams, to help support strategic marketing initiatives across our key buyer groups.

A successful candidate is someone who will thrive in a fast-paced, professional team environment. This person must be able to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization and have the ability to juggle multiple, competing tasks and demands, with strong attention to detail.

What You'll Do

Support the UK & Ireland marketing team to ensure efficient planning, execution, and measurement of campaigns and initiatives as part of our UK & Ireland marketing strategy, working with the relevant functional marketing teams as required.Help to ensure consistency of ‘best in class’ approach to larger marketing investments, including assisting with setup and preparation of briefing calls and briefing packs.Support UK & Ireland corporate marketing team with preparation of presentations and regular reporting for EMEA business leadership and global marketing leadership, ensuring formatting and branding is in line with company templates and standards.Assist with digital and website content development and maintenance, including review of service, industry and biography webpages.Help to create compelling and innovative communications that meets various internal and external messaging needs, including drafting of client mailings, newsletters and social media posts.Support events management for internal team events and external client events, including conferences, seminars, roundtable breakfasts/dinners, and networking drinks/dinners.Assist with production of collateral, including proofreading and liaising with creative and content teams.Conduct market and competitor research to inform marketing strategies and activities.Assist with other day-to-day team tasks and ad hoc projects, including web and email enquiries, management of shared mailboxes, processing invoices, etc.Building social media assets and copy for any upcoming marketing activations.Organise upcoming tasks for the team and recording key updates in meetings.Work with segment marketing teams on UK&I marketing campaigns as required.

How You'll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need to Succeed

Basic Qualifications

Applicants must be completing a sandwich course at university and due to graduate in 2029Applicants must be available for this placement year from 6th September 2027 to 25th August 2028Applicants must be predicted a 2:1 or above final grade (or equivalent) for their degreeApplicants should be proficient in Microsoft Office applications (particularly PowerPoint and Excel)Ability to prioritise and manage time, workload and projects effectivelyStrong communication abilities, both verbally and in writing and comfortable communicating at all levels of an organisationWillingness to learn how to navigate a complex organisation and establish networks, with excellent stakeholder management skillsProactive workload management – Demonstrates the ability to prioritise tasks effectively, make time for important work, and proactively seek clarification or support when needed to keep work progressing and ensure deadlines are met.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in a marketing or corporate environment, ideally professional services or B2BPrior experience in events management, including online events.Experience in assisting with the creation and co-ordination of collateral both digital and paper basedExperience with using Eloqua (Oracle email marketing) or similar packagesExperience with using Salesforce (CRM Sales Cloud) or similar packagesLeadership experience desirable – Experience of taking on leadership or responsibility is desirable, whether gained through employment, education or extracurricular activities. This could include leading a sports team, contributing to a university society, taking responsibility in a hospitality role, participating in military youth programmes, volunteering, or other team-based activities

Our Application Process

The deadline for applications is 29th October 2026

STEP 1: Complete our online application form and submit your CV (no cover letter required).

STEP 2: Complete a pre-recorded video interview.

STEP 3: Attend a competency based In Person interview and written task to explore your skills and motivations in our Offices in London on the 25th of November 2026.

STEP 4: Attend a 2nd virtual interview with our senior managers between 1st – 10th December 2026.

STEP 5: Job offers are made to successful candidates before Christmas.

rows.title: Marketing Executive - Events
rows.descriptionText:
Department: Commercial

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: London

Reporting To: Denise Rossa

Description

The Events Marketing Executive plays a key role in driving engagement and growth. Their purpose is to drive lead generation, as well as to develop and execute marketing strategies that position the learning programs effectively to legal and compliance professionals. This includes managing digital campaigns, crafting compelling messaging, coordinating with subject matter experts, and analysing data performance to improve brand reach. The role requires a strong understanding of the target audience’s professional needs and the ability to translate complex topics into accessible, value-driven communications.

Our values create the environment that we work in at Centellic, whether you’re at home or in the office, and we know that because our employees tell us.

We create a welcoming and inclusive environment for everybody at Centellic. We make time for each other, whether it’s to celebrate each other’s successes or to hear from a range of voices across our teams. We trust our colleagues to act with honesty and integrity.

We acknowledge the importance of flexibility and work-life balance, and encourage our people to think about this in all aspects of their working life. We are always developing and embracing change, offering our employees opportunities to grow and develop their careers with Centellic. We explore new ways of working to ensure that we are delivering the best products and services.

Key Responsibilities

Email Marketing

 Accurate proofing of emails, including newsletters and targeted campaigns. Build emails and create templates. Develop an understanding of basic segmentation, dynamic content, A/B testing and page rules, forms, and landing pages etc. Execute email marketing campaign activities aligned with marketing plans e.g., sending marketing emails, requesting mailing lists, writing copy, sourcing new data etc. Incorporate email testing strategy in marketing plan. Develop knowledge of email marketing best practice and competitor trends.

Social Media Marketing

 Conduct a variety of paid campaigns, including boosting post, matched audiences, look alike profiles and creation of targeted groups. Implement a clear testing strategy for organic posts and paid posts. Track lead gen/ direct registrations as a result of social campaigns. Accurate posting throughout all stage of the campaign including, LinkedIn events, organic posts reflecting available content, during event and post-event posts.

Websites

 Build websites accurately. Have an excellent working knowledge of Swoogo. For example, be able to offer solutions on Swoogo, bespoke to different events e.g., if we include add-ons, multiple streams, invitation only events etc.

Mentoring

 Train marketing assistants on all marketing platforms and activities.

Data Requests

 Pull complex data requests for events. Have an awareness and be able to act on insufficient internal data. Create campaigns in Pardot.

Product Knowledge

 Become an event marketing specialist in a few brands/ event types. Develop a good working knowledge of audience composition and use that to be better

adapt copy, segment data and build audiences.

 Have a basic understanding of current trends in the brands you are working on. Independently identify important delegates and speakers. Be able to understand and identify the different organisation types and segment data accordingly.

Marketing Plans

 Build marketing plans from templates. Build in a testing strategy in line with your marketing plan. Have a clear understanding of why marketing plans are structured in such a way. Identify cross promotion opportunities with other events and webinars.

Audience Management

 Monitor audiences effectively for your events, constantly ITR and audience composition. Flag and act appropriately (organising meetings, flagging with manager) if an event is underperforming. Suggest crisis management strategies for underperforming events.

Reporting And Analytics

 Track feedback of the event, draw out relevant comments and testimonials and make

inferences from those.

 Be able to spot and act on registrations trends. Adapt marketing plan dependent on the success/ lack of success of different activities. Accurately maintain budgets and track ROI. Track event revenue and put in strategies to reach targets. Report upwards on any of the above.

Partnerships

 Source accurate ‘supporting organisation’ research lists for events you are working on. Follow the ‘supporting organisation’ workflow.

Event Attendance

 Attend events. Coordinate interviews. Coordinate interview questions. Conduct interviews and network on the day. Help with on-the-day ops (as required).

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Proficiency in email marketing platforms (e.g., Pardot, Mailchimp), CMS tools, and social media ad managers.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Analytical mindset with attention to detail.Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.Collaborative and adaptable approach to working cross-functionally.Experience in eLearning, education, or digital events is a plus.

Benefits

Our people are our most valuable asset, as such, we offer a wide range of benefits to help ensure that all are supported:

Start Of Employment

Eye careEmployee Assistance ProgrammeA day off for your birthday

After 3 Months Employment

Pension (4% employer contribution and 4% employee contribution)

After 4 Months Employment

Life assurance

After Probation

Cycle to work schemeSeason ticket loan£350 annual wellbeing allowance to contribute to gym memberships or fitness classesPuregym accessPerks at work platform access

After 1 Year Service

Private healthcare

Additional Perks

Company socials Access to Employee Affinity Networks Mentoring scheme Volunteering Day Mortgage AdviceWork from anywhere (2 weeks)Generous parental leave

We are committed to making our organisation an inclusive, respectful & engaging place to work with a culture shaped by our core values that promote equality, collaboration & respect in everything we do. We are proud to be part of the Disability Confident Scheme, meaning we are committed to being inclusive and accessible, which starts with our application and recruitment process. If you do require any reasonable adjustments to be made, please let us know as part of our application page.

At Centellic, we believe in the power of growth and the importance of nurturing talent. We have learned that building the right team delivers extraordinary results.

Our fast-paced journey to becoming a global technology-driven information service provider has been built upon the values we hold close: rewarding excellence, providing meaningful work on our leading brands, and fostering an inclusive environment that is diverse, connected, and supportive.

By doing this, we have grown together and achieved global success. Join us and be a part of a journey where your contributions are valued, your impact is significant, and your growth is our priority.

rows.title: Retail Media Marketing Activation Assistant
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

At the John Lewis Partnership we have created a successful Insights and Media offering. However, as the Retail Media industry is in growth, we are also looking to significantly grow our offering. Creating Insight & Media propositions which create WIN-WIN-WIN outcomes: (i) more engaging experiences for Customers, (ii) growth for JLP, and (iii) growth for suppliers. As Marketing Activation Assistant, you will support the Marketing Activation Managers and Specialists, and the broader Retail Media Marketing Activation team to deliver the annual calendar of initiatives agreed with brands and develop dedicated campaigns for all our clients. This will include defining the brief and briefing into channels for activation. You will support the coordination of client participation in brand and seasonal campaigns. You will assist the monitoring of the performance of your Retail Media campaigns, supporting the preparation of PCA reports to inform strategic planning conversations for the following year. You'll be organised, adept in working with insight and customer segmentation, always with an eye on marketing channel effectiveness and driving outcomes for our Suppliers. You will have a thorough understanding of and a passion for marketing, making use of a variety of marketing best practices to meet objectives set. You'll have strong commercial acumen, natural ability with insight and data and work well under-pressure. Your ability to deliver compelling presentations will be regularly used and you will be a collaborative and proactive team member, forming part of matrix business and marketing teams to create campaigns which are bigger than the sum of the parts. PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS A HYBRID POSITION IN THE TECH TEAM, WITH WORKING TIME DIVIDED EQUALLY (50/50) BETWEEN ONE OF OUR MOST STRATEGIC TECH CLIENTS AND OTHER RETAIL MEDIA CLIENTS.

Expected salary up to - £32,000 depending on experienceContract type - This position is a Permanent contract.Working pattern/flexible working - The Partnership has adopted a hybrid working approach, meaning you'll be able to work a mixture between the office and home based upon your personal needs, whilst balancing the needs of the business. Within the Retail Media Sales & Planning team, we believe in the power of connection, which is why our core office days are currently Wednesdays and Thursdays. (Please be aware, this may change in the future) We typically aim for around three days a week in the office to allow for collaboration and attendance of key meetingsLocation - This role is based at our London Head Office campus in Pimlico. Please note, any cost incurred as a result of travel to the office is the responsibility of the successful candidate. There is no travel allowance for this role. 

Key Responsibilities

Support the delivery of the annual calendar of initiatives for all brands with guidance from more senior Marketing Activation PartnersSupport the delivery of defined elements within an overall marketing campaign, including the definition of the marketing brief, the channel and media plan, message hierarchy, creative execution, all the way through to delivery of the campaign itself being on time and on budget. This includes collating information from brands to get assets right first time.Work with brand/ seasonal campaign teams to coordinate retail media participation in brand and seasonal campaignsMonitor performance of the retail media funded campaigns and support the preparation of PCA reports.Support relationship building with key stakeholders.Work collaboratively across the business to ensure delivery of agreed milestonesActivate the proposition ensuring efficient delivery of capabilityReport on the success of the activity and communicate this regularly.

Essential Skills/experience You’ll Need

Evidence of customer orientation, effective stakeholder management and planning and prioritisationExperience working with projects and managing StakeholdersEvidence in strong written and verbal communicationExperience in data, insight and analytics

Desirable Skills/experience You May Have

Relevant marketing campaign management experienceKnowledge or experience with creative production processes Relevant experience supporting within a retail media environmentFurther qualifications in marketing or businessRelevant experience working within the retail sector

For internal use only:

About The Partnership

We’re the largest employee owned business in the UK and home of our cherished brands, John Lewis and Waitrose. We’re not just employees, we’re Partners, driven by our purpose to build a happier world. As we look to our future, there’s never been a more exciting time to join us.

We’re ruthlessly focused on being brilliant at retail. We continue to innovate, adapt and diversify. Never Knowingly Undersold on price, quality and service in John Lewis and passionately serving food-lovers in Waitrose.

As Partners we all share the responsibility of ownership and in its rewards. We use our voices to contribute to our success, working together through the good and challenging times, holding true to our behaviours and treating everyone with kindness and respect.

We all own making the Partnership somewhere we belong. Embracing our differences and creating an environment where we’re free to be ourselves and can THRIVE. Growing ourselves individually, and as a collective.

As Partners, we make all the difference. And, we all own it.

Important points to note: 

It’s important to note that some of our roles are subject to pre-employment vetting (which may include DBS checks for successful candidates). If required, you’ll be informed and provided with information about vetting during the recruitment process and we encourage you to complete any vetting documents quickly to avoid delays. Any DBS checks required will be carried out by a third-party registered body and financial probity checks may also be required for some of our roles.

We occasionally close vacancies early in the event we receive a high volume of applications, and therefore, we recommend you apply early. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability which means you may need longer to complete your application please contact us as soon as possible.

We want all of our Partners to have a good work-life balance and we support flexible working. This might mean flexible or compressed hours, job sharing or shorter hour contracts, where possible. Please discuss this further with the hiring manager during your interview.

rows.title: Sales Executive, ETF Solutions - PA25Q4SEETFJH051
rows.descriptionText:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

Job Description

Job Title: Sales Executive, ETF Solutions

Locations: London | Hybrid

Get To Know Us:

Calastone is the largest global funds network, connecting the world’s leading financial organisations.

Our mission is to reduce complexity, risk and costs, enabling the industry to deliver greater value to investors. 4,500 clients in 57 countries and territories benefit from Calastone’s services, processing over £250 billion of investment value each month.

Calastone is headquartered in London and has offices in Luxembourg, Hong Kong, Taipei, Singapore, New York and Sydney.

The Sales Executive, ETF Solutions will play a key role in building and driving pipeline and revenue for Calastone and SS&C's range of ETF propositions. Working closely with colleagues across Calastone and GIDS, you will combine consultative selling, structured discovery and go-to-market collaboration to help shape and scale our ETF servicing proposition globally.

Why You Will Love It Here! 

Flexibility: Hybrid Work ModelYour Future: Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS&C UniversityWork/Life Balance: Competitive holiday schemeYour Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staffDiversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on DiversityTraining: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career

What You Will Get To Do:

Build and own the ETF servicing sales pipeline from prospecting and structured discovery through to deal execution.Identify and engage ETF issuers, asset servicers, platforms, authorised participants, market makers and other ecosystem partners.Leverage SS&C's client base, internal network and subject-matter expertise to uncover cross-sell and new business opportunities.Work closely with the ETF team on segmentation, targeting, value proposition development, use cases and go-to-market execution.Lead early-stage commercial conversations, support solution framing and proposals, and progress qualified opportunities through the sales cycle.Partner with Product, Legal, Client Delivery, Operations and Marketing to coordinate opportunity progression and feed market insight into the ETF proposition.Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting activity in Salesforce while keeping up to date with ETF market, regulatory and competitive developments.

What You Will Bring:

Sales or relationship-management experience within ETFs, capital markets, fund servicing or market structure.Strong understanding of the ETF ecosystem, its key participants and associated operational flows.A proven track record of originating, qualifying and progressing complex opportunities involving multiple stakeholders.Experience working in a large financial services environment; previous exposure to SS&C or a similar organisation would be advantageous.Strong consultative selling, discovery and commercial communication skills, with the confidence to engage senior decision-makers and technical SMEs.Good CRM discipline and familiarity with structured sales methodologies, pipeline management and forecasting.A proactive, collaborative and adaptable approach, with the ability to thrive in an evolving, early-stage proposition environment.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.

Thank you for your interest in SS&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers.

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

rows.title: Customer Operations Associate | Tech startup
rows.descriptionText:
This fast-growing technology company has built one of the UK's leading marketplace platforms by combining brilliant customer experience with smart technology and operational excellence.As the business continues to grow, they are looking for an ambitious graduate to join the Operations team. You'll gain exposure to almost every part of the business, working alongside experienced colleagues who will give you genuine responsibility from an early stage.This is the kind of company where good ideas are encouraged, initiative is recognised and you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact.
The role
This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in operations within a growing technology business.
You'll begin by spending your first couple of months in the Customer Experience team, learning how the business works from the ground up. By speaking to customers and suppliers every day, you'll quickly develop an understanding of the challenges, processes and moving parts that keep the business running.
From there, you'll move into a broader operations role, taking ownership of projects across the business.

It's an excellent environment for someone who enjoys learning, thrives on variety and wants to understand how a successful technology business really operates.

rows.title: Cyber Security - Manufacturing Technology Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Cyber Security Manufacturing Technology Engineer

Help protect the operational technology that keeps modern manufacturing safe, resilient and productive.

Laing O'Rourke's IT function has renewed its strategy to support the company's ambition to transform the construction industry, making it more sustainable, more productive, and fit for the future.

Technology has a critical role to play in achieving this ambition. Our focus is on applying digital capability in ways that genuinely matter, shaping how complex projects are delivered, how decisions are made, and how innovation improves outcomes for people, communities, and the environment.

Our mission is clear: to create a modern and resilient technology environment where trusted data informs every decision, AI enhances every process, and digital capability enables the organisation to operate with greater scale and productivity.

To deliver this, we are building a different kind of IT function, one that is trusted by the business, forward looking in its thinking, and deeply connected to operational outcomes. We are looking for individuals who are curious, thoughtful, and motivated by contributing to work that has real industry impact.

The Role

As our Cyber Security Manufacturing Technology Engineer, you will help protect the operational technology (OT) and industrial control systems (ICS) used across our manufacturing environments. You will shape and maintain practical cyber security controls that support production efficiency, safety and quality, while reducing risk and protecting operational continuity and intellectual property.

Working at the intersection of manufacturing operations, engineering and cyber security, you will embed security into technology and processes from design through to operation. Your judgement and technical expertise will help colleagues understand risk, implement proportionate controls and respond effectively when issues arise.

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement and continually improve cyber security controls for operational technology and manufacturing environments.Collaborate across IT, manufacturing and engineering teams to deliver reliable solutions aligned with architecture and cyber security standards.Assess vulnerabilities in manufacturing systems and equipment, then guide practical remediation or compensating controls that minimise operational disruption.Integrate cyber security requirements into new production lines, industrial equipment and manufacturing systems from the outset.Investigate cyber incidents affecting manufacturing and develop recovery approaches that reduce production downtime and strengthen future resilience.Work with Cyber Security Governance, Risk and Compliance colleagues to improve security across manufacturing suppliers and third-party vendors.Support alignment with relevant frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, ISO/IEC 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

Essential Requirements

Proven experience developing and implementing cyber security controls and governance in a manufacturing environment.Deep understanding of industrial protocols, network segmentation and vulnerability management for manufacturing equipment.Ability to translate technical and compliance topics into clear, business-relevant language for a range of stakeholders.Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical and risk-based approach to decision-making.Ability to work independently, remain accountable for outcomes and contribute effectively with multidisciplinary colleagues.A clear commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Desirable Requirements

A relevant professional certification, such as GICSP, CISSP or CISM.Knowledge of operational technology cyber security standards, including IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82.Experience working across multidisciplinary teams in a complex organisation.

What Makes This Role Compelling

This is an opportunity to influence cyber security in environments where digital resilience has a direct connection to safe, reliable manufacturing. You will work on meaningful technical challenges, build trusted relationships across operational and technology teams, and help shape security as an enabler of innovation and continuity.

About Laing O'Rourke

Laing O'Rourke is an international engineering and construction business known for pushing boundaries in digital engineering, modern methods of construction and sustainable delivery. With more than 150 years of heritage, we are committed to creating environments in which diverse teams can excel and thrive.

Accessibility & Inclusion

We are proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme. If you meet the essential criteria and would like to be considered through our Offer an Interview scheme, please let us know. We're also happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

If you require an alternative format of this advert or need support during the application, please contact: resourcingteam@laingorourke.com

rows.title: Customer Success Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Puzzler, part of DC Thomson, is looking for a commercially minded and data-driven Customer Success Manager to help shape the future growth of one of the UK's most loved puzzle brands.
This is a unique opportunity for someone who loves building relationships, uncovering insights from data, and seeing the direct impact of their work. You'll spend your time talking to clients, understanding what drives customer engagement, and using evidence and experimentation to turn great ideas into measurable results.
Working across both our B2B and B2C audiences, you'll help partners get maximum value from our products while identifying opportunities to grow engagement, retention and revenue. Whether you're analysing customer behaviour, marketing a new product feature, or having a conversation with a client about their goals, you'll play a pivotal role in helping Puzzler continue to evolve and thrive in the digital world.
With more than 50 years of heritage, Puzzler creates puzzles enjoyed by millions through newspapers, magazines, websites, apps and iconic brands including The Sunday Post, Stylist and Beano. It's a fun, creative business with ambitious growth plans – and this new role will be right at the heart of them.
Puzzler already has an established portfolio of B2B customers generating more than £1m in annual revenue, alongside a growing digital audience of puzzle enthusiasts. We're looking for someone who can combine strong relationship-building skills with a passion for data and customer insight to unlock the next phase of growth.
You'll be the voice of the customer, working closely with clients, product teams and marketers to understand what drives success and identify opportunities to increase engagement, retention and lifetime value. By blending customer conversations with analytics and experimentation, you'll turn insight into action and help shape both commercial performance and customer experience. You'll also have the chance to influence product development and marketing strategy, helping ensure that customer needs remain at the centre of everything we do.
Key responsibilities include: 
Customer Retention & Revenue Growth - Deliver increased client retention and lifetime value by embedding a structured customer success model that reduces churn and drives expansion revenue across the B2B portfolio.Customer Lifecycle & Engagement - Design and implement consistent onboarding, engagement and success planning processes that ensure customers achieve defined outcomes and realise value from Puzzler products.Digital Growth - Drive measurable growth in B2C audience and engagement through targeted digital marketing, content optimisation and experimentation across web and app channels.


Skills: Builds and manages strategic relationships with B2B clients, acting as a trusted partner.Proactively identifies risks and opportunities to improve retention and growth.Applies advanced data analysis to interpret customer behaviour, engagement and value.Translates insight into clear actions that improve performance and inform strategy.Plans and executes data-driven digital marketing initiatives.Uses segmentation, targeting and experimentation to increase engagement.Works with product teams to prioritise and deliver improvements based on customer insight and commercial value.Balances user needs with business outcomes.Contributes to digital and customer strategy, aligning customer success activity with commercial goals and portfolio priorities.Identifies opportunities to use new tools, automation and AI to improve customer insight, engagement and operational efficiency.
Experience: 
Essential B2B customer success or account management in digital productsDemonstrable experience of turning analytics into actionable insightsUse of CRM and marketing platforms (e.g. HubSpot)Creating and evaluating the success of marketing materialsWorking across matrixed product, marketing and commercial teams
Desirable Conducting user research through interviews, surveys, A/B testing and experimentationUnderstanding or awareness of the publishing industry and how it worksAn interest in puzzles
Behaviours that will help this role succeed: 
Being More Curious - Actively seeks customer insight through data, research and direct engagement. Challenges assumptions and uses evidence to shape decisions.Experiment with Purpose - Runs structured experiments to improve engagement, product performance and marketing effectiveness. Scales what works and stops what does not.Owning the Outcomes - Takes full accountability for retention, engagement and revenue outcomes. Tracks performance rigorously and takes action to close gaps.Being More Collaborative - Works across Digital, Product, Marketing and Client teams to deliver shared outcomes. Shares insight and best practice to improve performance across the portfolio.Owning the Customer Voice - Represents the customer in all decision-making forums. Ensures customer value is central to product, marketing and commercial decisions.Driving Commercial Impact - Focuses activity on outcomes that improve revenue, retention and growth. Prioritises work that delivers measurable business value.
To apply for this role, please follow our online application process and submit a CV and cover letter.
Closing date for applications: 15th October 2026 at 5pm

rows.title: Associate
rows.descriptionText:
Mergers & Acquisitions Corporate & Investment Banking Graduate Programme 2027 

Standard Chartered M&A Advisory Group is a global team with offices across the world and provides comprehensive advisory services to its clients on a wide range of M&A transactions and capital-raising activities, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures and financial restructurings. Our M&A teams work closely with our coverage partners, and other product groups.

As a graduate, you'll gain exposure to live deals, work alongside experienced bankers, and develop the analytical, commercial and communication skills that underpin successful transactions. From researching industries and analysing companies to supporting client presentations and deal execution, you'll contribute to work that helps clients navigate complex decisions and unlock growth opportunities. This is an opportunity to learn in a fast-paced, high-performance environment where your ideas and contributions matter from day one.

About the Graduate Programme – how you’ll learn and grow

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over our two-year graduate programme, you’ll gain hands-on experience, build lasting relationships and grow your understanding of clients, markets and the wider business. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work and be supported to build a successful long-term career.

You’ll Benefit From

Real impact: Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to business outcomes.Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed. Global collaboration: Work with colleagues and clients across markets, products and functions. Continuous growth: Learn from structured development, mentoring and practical experience.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career  

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation. 

We’re looking for people who can:  

Take ownership and demonstrate initiative.  Think critically and solve problems in a structured way.  Learn quickly and adapt to new challenges, seeking opportunities to grow and develop  Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others  Communicate confidently and collaborate across different cultures and backgrounds. Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in global markets, industries and clients.  Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced and International environment.   

For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Finance & Banking, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics and Statistics. 

Eligibility    

To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study and graduating by July 2027.  You must also have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.  

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals. 

Key Dates 

Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards  Start Date: July 2027   

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)  

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.  

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint. 

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we doNever settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so wellAre better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkitsA continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers
