rows.title: Senior VMware Virtualization Support Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI is seeking a Senior VMware Virtualization Support Engineer who will be a key member of the Americas Infrastructure Virtualization team, providing advanced operational support, platform maintenance, incident management, and continuous improvement for the enterprise VMware virtualization environment.

The role supports a highly available, business-critical virtualization platform currently based on VMware Cloud Foundation 8 (VCF 8) and will actively participate in the planned migration and transition to VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9).

Working as part of a regional and global infrastructure support organization, the engineer is responsible for maintaining platform stability, availability, performance, security, and operational readiness. The position provides Tier 2/3 technical support, participates in the 24×7×365 on-call rotation, troubleshoots complex infrastructure incidents, performs lifecycle and patching activities, and contributes to automation and AI-enabled operational improvements.

The environment includes VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere, NSX-T, vSAN, Aria Operations, vRealize Log Insight (VRLI), vRealize Network Insight (VRNI), and associated enterprise storage and networking technologies.

This position is located in the New York, NY or Jersey City, NJ area (Hybrid)

Your future duties and responsibilities

Platform Support & Maintenance

 Provide Tier 2/3 operational support for the VMware virtualization platform as part of the Americas Infrastructure Virtualization team. Maintain the existing VCF 8 environment and participate in the planning, testing, migration, and operational transition to VCF 9. Support and maintain VMware technologies including vSphere, NSX-T, vSAN, Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI. Perform routine platform health checks, troubleshooting, maintenance, configuration changes, and lifecycle management activities. Monitor platform availability, capacity, performance, and infrastructure health to ensure services meet established SLAs. Work within established architecture, engineering, security, and operational standards.

Incident & Problem Management

 Respond to production incidents and service requests involving VMware virtualization infrastructure. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for compute, storage, networking, performance, and availability issues. Participate in major incident management and collaborate with application, network, storage, security, and other infrastructure teams to restore services. Document incidents, root causes, corrective actions, known errors, and operational procedures. Identify recurring incidents and contribute to problem-management initiatives designed to eliminate or reduce repeat failures. Escalate complex product issues to VMware/Broadcom and other technology vendors as required.

VCF 8 to VCF 9 Migration

 Participate as a technical member of the team responsible for migrating the existing VCF 8 platform to VCF 9. Support readiness assessments, compatibility reviews, upgrade planning, testing, implementation, and post-migration validation. Assist with migration activities while minimizing service disruption and maintaining compliance with enterprise security standards. Validate platform health, application connectivity, performance, monitoring, backup, and operational processes following migration activities. Develop and update operational documentation and support procedures for the VCF 9 environment.

Monitoring & Capacity Management

 Configure, maintain, and tune monitoring thresholds, alarms, dashboards, and reporting within Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI. Perform proactive monitoring to identify capacity, availability, latency, and performance issues before they impact production services. Review infrastructure utilization and recommend VM rightsizing and capacity optimization opportunities. Support capacity planning across compute, memory, storage, and network resources. Participate in the implementation of anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and intelligent capacity-management capabilities.

Automation & Operational Improvement

 Develop and maintain automation using PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, and VMware APIs. Automate repetitive operational activities including health checks, provisioning, patching, reporting, configuration validation, and lifecycle management. Maintain and improve automated operational runbooks and remediation procedures. Contribute to self-healing capabilities for well-understood infrastructure events where automated remediation can be implemented safely. Explore and implement practical AI-assisted operations capabilities, including incident triage, alert correlation, log analysis, knowledge retrieval, and root cause analysis. Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve platform reliability and support efficiency.

Change, Release & Lifecycle Management

 Participate in change and release management activities for the VMware virtualization environment. Perform VMware software upgrades, firmware updates, security patches, and infrastructure maintenance through approved change processes. Develop implementation, validation, rollback, and recovery procedures for infrastructure changes. Ensure changes comply with enterprise standards, security requirements, and VMware recommended practices. Participate in maintenance windows and after-hours implementation activities when required.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

 Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for workloads hosted on the virtualization platform. Participate in scheduled DR exercises and document results, issues, and remediation actions. Support platform capabilities required to meet established business RPO and RTO requirements, including critical workload targets of RPO ≤ 5 seconds and RTO ≤ 15 minutes, where applicable. Maintain operational documentation and recovery procedures required to support business continuity.

Operational Support

 Participate in the 24×7 on-call support rotation for production virtualization services. Perform morning and end-of-day platform health checks using dashboards, monitoring platforms, and automated scripts. Investigate infrastructure alerts and take appropriate corrective or escalation actions. Support OS, hypervisor, firmware, storage, and VMware platform patching activities. Maintain accurate support documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks. Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to other members of the infrastructure support team.

Collaboration & Service Management

 Work closely with application owners and infrastructure teams to understand requirements and support the delivery of standardized virtual infrastructure services. Collaborate with networking, storage, security, backup, cloud, and hardware teams to troubleshoot cross-platform issues. Coordinate with VMware/Broadcom and other technology vendors for technical support, product defects, upgrades, and complex incidents. Work with regional and global IT teams to maintain consistent platform standards and operational processes. Support the virtualization service catalogue and provide input into service consumption, capacity, cost, and performance reviews.

Reporting & Governance

 Provide operational reporting covering platform availability, incidents, capacity, performance, SLA compliance, patching, and infrastructure health. Contribute to dashboards and metrics used by infrastructure management to evaluate service performance. Track automation benefits, operational improvements, capacity savings, and incident trends. Participate in operational reviews, problem-management meetings, change reviews, and service improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 10+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. 5–7+ years of hands-on VMware experience supporting large-scale environments using technologies such as vSphere 8+, VMware Cloud Foundation, NSX-T, and vSAN. Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting production VMware environments. Experience participating in VMware platform upgrades or migrations, preferably involving VMware Cloud Foundation. Experience supporting an existing VCF 8 environment and/or migration to VCF 9 is highly desirable. Strong troubleshooting skills across virtualization, compute, storage, networking, and operating-system layers. Strong automation skills using technologies such as PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, and VMware APIs. Hands-on experience with Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI or equivalent monitoring, logging, and network-visibility platforms. Solid understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, iSCSI, vSAN, and platforms such as Dell/EMC, Isilon, Pure Storage, and NetApp. Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, load balancing, and NSX-T concepts such as micro-segmentation and distributed firewalls. Experience working within formal incident, problem, change, and release management processes. Understanding of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patching, and VMware security-hardening practices. Experience with AI/AIOps concepts such as anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, alert correlation, automated RCA, and intelligent capacity forecasting is desirable. Experience identifying VM rightsizing, capacity optimization, and infrastructure cost-reduction opportunities. Ability to troubleshoot complex production incidents under time-sensitive conditions. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regional and global technical teams. Ability to participate in a 24×7 production support/on-call rotation. Strong organizational skills with experience working in Agile and/or ITIL-based operational environments.

Desired Certifications & Skills

 VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification. VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Cloud Management and Automation certification. Advanced VMware certification such as VCAP is desirable. ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional. Experience with Aria Operations APIs and custom automation. Experience developing operational dashboards, automated health checks, and infrastructure reporting. Exposure to AIOps, LLM-assisted operations, ChatOps, or automated incident-management solutions is beneficial.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

rows.title: Business Operations

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Our vision is to become the marketplace for everything expensive, specialized, and difficult to move. We’re building the infrastructure that powers the procurement and disposition of assets across America’s essential industries, automating everything from discovery and payments to freight, warranty, and financing. Today, Garage operates in cities and towns across all 50 states and has surpassed $100M+ in annualized transaction volume on the platform.

Our mission is to save local governments and essential services businesses time and money. We started with fire departments two years ago and have since expanded into EMS and heavy-duty, launching new verticals while growing revenue >10x last year.

If you move fast, hold a high bar, and want meaningful ownership in building a category-defining company, Garage is the place to do it.

About The Role

As a Business Operations Associate, you’ll help make Garage run. You’ll work across nearly every part of the company, jumping in wherever there is an important problem to solve, process to build, or initiative that needs an owner.

This is a true operator role. You’ll build processes from scratch, fix things that aren’t working, coordinate across teams, and own the many things required to keep a fast-growing startup moving. Some projects will be highly visible; others will happen behind the scenes but be just as critical to the company’s success.

Along the way, you’ll get unusual exposure to how a startup operates — from People and Finance to GTM, Product, company planning, and leadership decision-making. As you build context and earn trust, you’ll take on increasingly strategic projects, making this an ideal role for someone who wants to learn how to run a company from the inside out and ultimately grow into a startup leader or Chief of Staff.

What We’re Looking For

Own the systems, processes, and recurring workstreams that keep Garage running smoothly, including core internal operations like People Ops, benefits, compliance, and insurance. Step into ambiguous problems without clear owners, create structure, and drive them from open question to completed outcome. Identify inefficiencies and build scalable, repeatable processes that make the company faster and more effective. Work cross-functionally to coordinate priorities, unblock execution, and drive important company-wide initiatives forward. 

What You Need

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university2+ years of experience at a startup in an execution-focused role, investment banking, consulting, ex-Founders, working at a startup, business development, or related rolesA natural operator mindset with a strong bias toward action — you see something that needs to get done and take ownership of figuring it outA willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever the company needs, from building a new process to handling the small but important details that keep things runningExceptional organization and reliability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without letting things fall through the cracksComfort with ambiguity, a steep learning curve, and the ability to bring structure to problems you may have never encountered beforeIntellectual curiosity and strategic thinking, paired with a strong desire to turn ideas into action and make the people around you more effective

Our Values

Take Big Swings. We are here to transform an overlooked industry—not make small improvements around the edges. We set ambitious goals, take calculated risks, and push through setbacks. We never trade lasting impact for short-term comfort. Customers Come First. Our customers operate in an industry burdened by slow, expensive, and outdated processes. We attack the problems that cost them the most and measure our success by the time and money we give back to them. Play For the Front of the Jersey. We put the mission ahead of ourselves. We challenge each other directly, support each other relentlessly, and step up whenever the team needs us. We win together, and we have fun doing it. All Gas, No Ego. Building something that matters takes relentless effort. We move fast, take ownership, and see hard problems through. When we fall short, we own it, learn quickly, and come back stronger. 

Why Join Garage?

Do work that matters. Our platform helps people buy the assets that local communities rely on to keep their communities safe, clean, and operating every day. Help shape the company. Join as one of our first 45 employees and work directly alongside the founders. Make an outsized impact. You’ll join a talent-dense, high-performance team where every person moves the company forward. Build from a strong foundation. We’ve raised $18M, including a $13.5M Series A, from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, FJ Labs, and other leading investors. 

What we offer

Competitive salary and stock options100% medical, dental and vision insurance coverageUnlimited PTO (in addition to company observed holidays)Daily lunch & dinner (for employees based in NYC)$100/month wellness stipend401(k) w/ employer matchPre-tax commuter benefitsAnnual team offsiteRelocation assistance

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. We don’t expect you to check all the qualification boxes and encourage you to apply if you have experience in some of the areas.

Equal Opportunity

As an equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, natural origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected class.

Compensation Range: $90K - $130K

rows.title: Applied AI Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Come Work With Us

Metropolitan Commercial Bank (the “Bank”) is a full-service commercial bank based in New York City. The Bank provides a broad range of business, commercial, and personal banking products and services to individuals, small businesses, private and public middle-market and corporate enterprises and institutions, municipalities, and local government entities.

Metropolitan Commercial Bank was named one of Newsweek’s Best Regional Banks and Credit Unions 2024. The Bank was ranked by Independent Community Bankers of America among the top ten successful loan producers for 2023 by loan category and asset size for commercial banks with more than $1 billion in assets. Kroll affirmed a BBB+ (investment grade) deposit rating on January 25, 2024. For the fourth time, MCB has earned a place in the Piper Sandler Bank Sm-All Stars Class of 2024.

Metropolitan Commercial Bank operates banking centers and private client offices in Manhattan, Boro Park, Brooklyn and Great Neck on Long Island in New York State.

The Bank is a New York State chartered commercial bank, a member of the Federal Reserve System and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, and an equal housing lender. The parent company of Metropolitan Commercial Bank is Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (NYSE: MCB).

Position Summary

Metropolitan Commercial Bank (the “Bank”) is seeking an Applied AI Analyst to support the design, configuration, testing, and monitoring of applied AI, Generative AI, machine learning, and agentic workflow solutions in a highly regulated banking environment. Working under the guidance of AI Scientists and in partnership with engineering, risk, and business teams, this role focuses on internal human-in-the-loop use cases such as AI-assisted loan documentation generation, fraudulent transaction detection models, policy and knowledge copilots, workflow automation, and other productivity solutions. A meaningful portion of the role is dedicated to AI solution intake and delivery support— learning new business domains, engaging business owners, preparing required documentation, and supporting vendor and risk reviews, so that solutions can be built and deployed under strict control gates and documentation standards aligned to internal and external regulations. The role emphasizes strong documentation, human oversight, privacy-by-design, cybersecurity, and disciplined lifecycle controls aligned to internal and external regulations. The role also emphasizes familiarity with Microsoft Foundry / Foundry Agent Service, approved Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, RAG architectures, and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake.

Standard 4-day in-office requirement, 1 day remote (of your choosing and subject to manager's approval) 

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Applied AI solution development & analysis:

Support AI Scientists in building, configuring, and testing applied AI/GenAI solutions for high-value banking use cases such as credit memo generation, policy/regulatory summarization, knowledge assistants, and internal productivity copilots.Develop and refine prompts, grounding instructions, structured outputs, evaluation datasets, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using embeddings, vector search, document chunking, and metadata-driven retrieval.Prepare and transform structured and unstructured data; assist with API integrations, notebooks, and repeatable workflows that improve quality, traceability, and analyst productivity.

Agentic Workflow Design & Orchestration

Assist in designing and testing agentic workflows using approved enterprise platforms and frameworks, including multi-agent patterns, human-in-the-loop approvals, handoffs, and subagent / agents-as-tools designs.Work with emerging interoperability patterns such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool / skill / plugin integration, and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) connectivity under supervision and within approved guardrails.Document workflow steps, tool schemas, fallback logic, escalation paths, and safe disablement / rollback procedures for agentic and GenAI solutions.

Microsoft Foundry, Copilot, And Enterprise Platform Enablement

Support prototyping and evaluation in Microsoft Foundry / Foundry Agent Service and related Microsoft ecosystems (for example, Microsoft 365 Copilot) while partnering with Engineering and Data teams operating on Snowflake and other approved enterprise platforms.Assist with prompt and agent configuration, retrieval integration, logging, model / tool versioning, and operational runbooks.

Evaluation, Testing, And Monitoring

Create and execute test cases for accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, task completion, retrieval quality, bias/fairness, and basic adversarial or prompt-injection scenarios; escalate issues promptly.Track KPIs/KRIs, output quality, drift indicators, and user feedback; maintain evidence needed for pilot reviews, production monitoring, and periodic reassessment.

AI Governance, Intake Documentation, And Cybersecurity/privacy Controls

Support AI use-case intake and governance processes by preparing required documentation (e.g., AI intake forms, model/system inventories, change-control artifacts, and audit-ready evidence packs) aligned to MCB’s Trustworthy & Responsible AI Principles and internal approval processes.Learn domain and process context for new use cases by speaking with business owners and control partners; translate requirements into clear problem statements, data needs, user journeys, control gates, and documentation required to comply with internal and external regulations.Support third-party / AI vendor due diligence by collecting and organizing evidence, reviewing vendor documentation, and helping risk-tier AI vendors and solutions in partnership with Third-Party Risk and Cyber/IT; act as an AI subject matter expert in providing an understanding of AI-specific risks.Apply privacy-by-design, data minimization, access-control, and secure prompt/data handling practices; follow approved tooling and build standards.

Cross-functional Partnership And Continuous Learning

Communicate findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to AI Scientists, managers, control partners (Model Risk, Compliance/Legal, Cyber/IT, Data Privacy), and business stakeholders; incorporate feedback quickly and accurately.Contribute to playbooks, standard operating procedures, and reusable templates for prompts, evaluations, agent patterns, and workflow controls.

Innovation And Best Practices

Stay current on practical applied-AI methods—including RAG, evaluation frameworks, agentic workflow design, MCP, A2A, and Microsoft Foundry capabilities—and recommend fit-for-purpose uses under established control gates.Demonstrate sound judgment, curiosity, and willingness to learn from senior AI Scientists while promoting responsible AI, reproducibility, and disciplined execution.

About Our Entry Level Programs


How does it feel to work on a team driven to make a big impact? Empowering. We believe your career should always be growing. And that’s exactly what it will do at BAE Systems as part of our Entry Level Programs. Our Entry Level Programs are designed to accelerate the development and career of highly-motivated entry level candidates who aspire to achieve their technical and leadership potential. This is accomplished through challenging and rewarding rotational assignments, technical and leadership training, advanced education, leadership opportunities and exposure, and mentorship. You’ll hit the ground running with a company truly committed to your growth as you enjoy a special camaraderie on a team dedicated to protecting what really matters.

You will be an integrated team member collaborating with System, Hardware, and Test Engineers in one or more of the phases of Project Planning, Design, Development, and Testing. These teams are dedicated to solving complex problems and developing creative technical solutions to meet customer requirements. Products are primarily safety critical embedded systems such as flight control computers, engine control computers, cabin systems, flight desk panels, as well as electrification efforts for aircraft and hybrid-drive systems for ground vehicles.

BAE Systems offers a number of programs for entry level engineers. These potential placements include the Engineering Leadership Development Program (ELDP), Engineering Rotational Program (ERP), the VERGE Mentoring Program, and Direct Engineering positions. Our Entry Level Programs are three-year programs designed to develop high potential, entry-level individuals into future leaders. You’ll have the opportunity to experience assignments in several operational functions, business areas, and product groups.

Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who are Coolr?

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale.

With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, and Harvest Snaps (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world. The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started… In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the US, the UK, and beyond.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Social Media Analyst to join our US team and turn social and influencer performance data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll analyse campaign, organic, influencer and community data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate findings into strategic recommendations for clients.

Working closely with our strategy and client teams, you’ll develop reporting, measurement frameworks and test-and-learn plans, while building real-time dashboards to streamline performance tracking.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves social, data and strategy, and wants to turn numbers into stories that drive better creative and business decisions.

The job 💻

Every role at Coolr plays a vital part in the work we do. Here are some of the key areas of responsibility for this role:

Collating and processing high volumes of social-first performance data (Engagement, Views, CTR, CPM, etc.)Monitoring and reporting on performance for social-first campaigns, always-on organic content activity, influencer partnerships and community engagementDistilling clear actions and insight from the data, making strategic recommendations, optimization plans, and presenting findings in a clear, client-facing presentations and reportsCrafting clear performance analysis and narratives in reportingClosely working alongside a team of strategists to develop qualitative and quantitative research for both current clients and new business prospectsCreating automated social dashboards to help aid and manage reporting across the agency. These will be client specific and update in real time to pull results efficientlyDeveloping measurement frameworks and test and learn plans that define ‘which metrics matter’ based on client goals, allowing optimizations and strategic pivots to be grounded in dataCreating data driven insights for the agency as well as working these into white papers and articles for the agency to publish with external media sources

What we are looking for 👀

Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:

Experience in an analyst or insights role within an agencyHighly skilled in Excel (Pivot tables, custom formulas)Experienced in building custom audience segments in Consumer Insights platforms (Global Web Index, MRI Simmons, etc.) and the analysis of the data against hypotheses.Proficient with a wide suite of social reporting platforms (Brandwatch, Sprout, Sprinklr, Amplify, Meltwater, Talkwater etc.)Proficient with native social media reporting tools (Meta Ads manager, Facebook Ads manager, TikTok insights etc.)Passionate about social media, brands, and the world of communicationUp to date with latest news and trends that are going on in the industryAble to work to tight deadlinesCurious about brands, culture, data and how the three interact

A Coolr Offer

We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:

💰 Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

🤸‍♂️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

🌴 Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

🎉 Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

💆 Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

➕ Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

♣ Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $70,000 to $85,000, based on your experience and level.

Coolr Culture:

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

Coolr DE&I 🌎

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda’s Marketing organization is highly data-driven and uses experimentation, technology and analytics to create measurable value across markets and channels.

Marketing has successfully developed a strong bottom-up culture of AI adoption, with teams using GenAI to improve analysis, reporting, campaign operations, content development and other recurring workflows. We are now establishing a small Marketing AI Products team to take the next step: turning the most valuable cross-team opportunities into reliable, scalable and widely adopted products.

The team will focus on a small number of high-impact “lighthouse” initiatives while Marketing sub-teams continue to develop and own their everyday, team-specific AI use cases. Initial opportunity areas include experiment analysis, business reporting and monitoring, campaign operations, creative workflows and SEO/AEO content.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on analyst and product builder who can operate at the intersection of Marketing, data, product development and generative AI.

You will identify high-value workflows, translate business problems into clear product requirements, develop and evaluate solutions, and work with developers and Marketing teams to take successful ideas from prototype through deployment and adoption.

This is not a traditional reporting role or a purely coordination-focused product role. You will be expected to work directly with data and AI tools, understand users’ workflows in detail and take ownership of delivering measurable outcomes.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

Identify recurring Marketing workflows where AI can materially improve speed, quality, scalability or decision-making.Quantify each opportunity by establishing its current effort, pain points, user base and potential business value.Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, milestones and measurable success criteria.Build and test prototypes using SQL, Python, automation tools and generative AI technologies.Partner with developers, Technology teams and sponsoring Marketing teams to turn successful prototypes into reliable products.Design evaluation frameworks covering output accuracy, reliability, usability, safety and appropriate human review.Lead user research, pilots and iterative testing with analysts, channel specialists and other target users.Drive rollout, documentation, training and adoption in partnership with sponsoring teams.Measure hours saved, improvements in turnaround time and quality, adoption levels and downstream business impact.Maintain a prioritized portfolio of Marketing AI opportunities and communicate progress, learnings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.Monitor developments in AI capabilities and identify when existing products should be improved, expanded or retired.Contribute reusable tools, standards and playbooks that help Marketing teams build better AI-enabled workflows independently.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

4–6 years of relevant experience in analytics, product analytics, marketing strategy, business operations, consulting, product management or a related field.Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative, technical or business discipline such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics or finance.Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large or complex datasets.Hands-on experience with Python, scripting, workflow automation or similar technical tools.Experience defining hypotheses, designing experiments and translating results into actionable business recommendations.Strong product thinking, including the ability to understand user problems, define requirements and make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions.Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured workstreams and move rapidly from analysis to execution.Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.Experience influencing stakeholders and communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, dependable solutions.Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Analytics, Product and Technology teams.Experience building GenAI applications, AI agents or automated analytical workflows.Familiarity with prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, APIs, model evaluation and human-in-the-loop workflows.Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code or Google AI Studio.

It’s Great if You Have

Experience writing product requirements, managing a product backlog or taking an internal product from prototype to scaled adoption.Knowledge of digital marketing, performance marketing, experimentation, SEO/AEO, campaign operations or personalization.Experience establishing quality-assurance and monitoring processes for data or AI products.Experience deploying internal tools or working closely with software engineers on production systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will help launch and scale a small number of cross-Marketing AI products with clear adoption and value metrics. These products should deliver measurable improvements in employee productivity, output quality or business outcomes—and have clearly defined ownership, documentation, quality controls and maintenance plans.

Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will partner with consulting teams and work directly with clients to understand their primary business objectives, strategize a research plan, and lead the end-to-end research process from design to insights.

You will engage as a consulting team member to generate qualitative and quantitative B2C and B2B insights and translate findings into business recommendations. Most of your time will be spent on client-facing engagements to design research strategies to meet engagement objectives and lead survey instruments and/or qualitative question guide development with key stakeholders. You will advise on the analytics plan, including advanced modeling, and help the team analyze, identify and synthesize emerging implications and recommendations for clients. You will also be responsible for working with the firm’s preferred vendors to program and field the research to ensure high-quality data.

You will also contribute to firm knowledge initiatives through in-depth support of B2C and B2B insights needs and collaborate with other consultants to develop original points of view or tools focused on areas of expertise.

You will be based in our Atlanta, Boston, New Jersey, New York, or Washington DC office and will be part of the Growth Marketing & Sales Solutions team. You will work with our Agile Insights Solution that helps companies across all industries gain consumer, shopper and buyer insights with our comprehensive suite of agile market research techniques and expertise.

rows.title: Sr. Social Media & Content Associate

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Betterment

Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

About The Role

Betterment is hiring a Social Media & Content Associate to support the execution of our organic social strategy across three lines of businesses (Betterment, Betterment at Work, and Betterment Advisors Solutions) and help scale how we show up across platforms. This role sits on the Brand Creative team, reporting into the Social Media Manager. We play a key role in shaping the Betterment brand and product story, translating complex financial topics into clear, engaging content that builds trust and long-term brand equity.

As a Social Media Associate, you will play a key role in bringing our content calendar to life. You’ll focus on drafting, creating and publishing content, routing posts through compliance and approval workflows, maintaining documentation, and monitoring performance. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience using design and editing tools, who is creative and able to help make complex financial topics and product launches engaging.

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

New York City: $89,000 - $99,500

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.

A Day in the Life

We make content about money and have a lot of fun doing it. You’ll help us tell the stories behind our products, our people, and why financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Drive day-to-day workflow for the creation of posts, including drafting copy, coordinating or creating creative assets, editing, shooting, routing content for reviews and approvals, and maintaining accurate compliance documentation.Schedule and publish content using social management tools, ensuring tagging, accessibility standards, and compliance requirements are met.Monitor engagement and comments across channels, flagging audience questions, trends, or potential risks by responding directly or routing to the appropriate team.Pull weekly and monthly performance metrics to contribute to reporting and optimization efforts.Partnering with Marketing, Creative, and Comms, assist in packaging product launches, research, and marketing initiatives into social-ready formats including product explainers and social first stories.Contribute ideas during brainstorms and support timely content tied to market events, and key brand moments.Stay up-to-date on social trends to identify opportunities and know when to be bold (but also when to be…demure).

What We’re Looking For

2-3 years of experience in social media, digital marketing, or content creation; experience in financial services or other regulated industries is a plus.Established ability to manage day-to-day publishing across corporate social channels.Experience with social video, including short-form video creation and platform-native best practices.Excellent writing and visual communication skills, with demonstrated ability to capture and apply a consistent brand voice.Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to manage multiple platforms and priorities.Familiarity with any analytics and scheduling tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Meta, and other native platform insights).Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Captcut, Edits or similar design tools, with a comfort leveraging AI capabilities to ideate and execute content faster..Strong working knowledge of social best practices, including formatting, tagging, accessibility, and engagement norms.Collaborative mindset and comfort working cross-functionally with different teams across the organization.

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.

We set audacious goals

We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.

We value all perspectives

When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.

We simplify financial services

We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.

Our Commitment To Your Total Well-being

We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA optionsOwnership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.

What Happens Next

We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.

In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.

On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.

We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!

Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter. 

Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Come join us!

rows.title: Computational Journalist, AI Deployment

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About AppliedXLAppliedXL detects material changes in authoritative records and turns them into verified intelligence.We monitor regulatory filings, government records, scientific data, company disclosures and other primary sources to determine what changed, whether it matters and what the evidence supports. Our intelligence powers news, research and analytics products used by financial institutions and information providers. At the center of our platform is the AXL Event Engine, which combines domain-specific event definitions, continuous monitoring and evidence verification to create structured, traceable event records.
This is an initial six-month contractor role, with the option to extend based on fit, impact and company needs.
We’d love to learn a little about how you think. Please send us a brief cover letter telling us about a domain, sector or industry you’d be excited to map, what you’d want to track, and why. We’ll only consider applications that include one. Email at support at appliedxl dot com.
The RoleWe are hiring a Computational Journalist to develop and deploy the research and AI workflows behind our intelligence products. The work centers on four questions: What changed? Is it material? What evidence supports it? What does it affect?
You will help extend our system into new domains, improve how we detect and verify change, and turn successful experiments into intelligence products used by customers.You do not need to be a software engineer. You do need to be rigorous with incomplete records, fluent with AI tools, and comfortable turning ambiguous research questions into systems that can be tested.
What You’ll DoMap new domains using the AXL Event Engine, identifying authoritative sources, material events and the evidence needed to verify them.Build AI workflows for research, extraction, classification, monitoring and analysis.Turn unstructured records into structured entities, events and signals with clear source lineage.Develop methods for detecting changes in values, states, claims, commitments, relationships and timelines.Distinguish material events from routine updates and noise.Verify evidence, reconcile conflicting information and preserve the basis for each conclusion.Build evaluation sets and test outputs for accuracy, omissions and unsupported claims.Investigate failures across source data, retrieval, model behavior and workflow design.Test new models and tools against real-world tasks and adopt them when they improve performance.Work with research, product and engineering to turn successful experiments into reusable workflows and customer-facing products.
What We’re Looking ForDeep practical familiarity with LLMs and current AI tools. You already use them to research, analyze or build.Experience designing multi-step AI workflows for research, extraction, classification, monitoring or similar tasks.Strong analytical judgment when information is incomplete, messy or conflicting.Comfort with APIs, databases and structured data, even if you are not a production engineer.A habit of checking model outputs against the underlying evidence.Ability to move quickly from an unclear problem to a working, testable approach.Strong writing and source discipline.Curiosity and a track record of teaching yourself new domains, sources and tools.
Experience may come from journalism, research, intelligence, data, product, financial information, scientific analysis or another field involving complex records.
Useful ExperienceStructured extraction, entity resolution or event-based data.Evaluation design and systematic testing of AI outputs.Healthcare and life sciences, government and regulatory records, or financial disclosures.Retrieval, tool use or agent workflows.Tracking how information changes over time.Turning experimental workflows into systems others can reliably run.
How You’ll WorkYou’ll join a nimble team working directly with leadership, engineering and our partners. Projects move quickly and often begin with an open research question rather than a predefined specification.The approach is practical: understand the sources, build the workflow, test it against the record, identify where it fails and improve it until the results hold up. One week you might map a new domain; the next, debug an extraction workflow or turn a prototype into something a customer relies on.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

With more than 640 million users around the world and 300 billion ideas saved, Pinterest Machine Learning engineers help build personalized experiences to help Pinners create a life they love. At Pinterest, you’ll experience hands-on access to an incredible vault of data and contribute large-scale recommendation systems in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

By applying to this role, you will be considered for multiple roles open across our various data science teams. 

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to help evolve and shape the future of our product -- inspiring Pinners and connecting them with actionable content, understanding advertisers and measuring the value Pinterest provides to them, and enabling our employees to evaluate potential product changes faster than ever before. You’ll apply quantitative analysis, statistical techniques, modeling and data mining while working cross-functionally with engineering and product partners.

The results of your work will influence the team roadmap, identify actionable product opportunities, refine our experimentation platform, and drive key initiatives, turning your insights and analyses into real-world products.

What You’ll Do

Contribute to our product roadmap and mission - to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love - using data and exploratory analysis to understand user behavior and trends, and identify opportunities for product innovation.Design and implement core metrics that guide the team efforts and help design and evaluate A/B experiments that drive these metrics.Explore alternative experimentation techniques to help internal teams evaluate their ideas faster.Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest.


What We’re Looking For

Master’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, applied sciences, computer science or related field.Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL and a scripting language (Python or R)experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches including in the fields of Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling, Forecasting, Econometrics or other related fieldsExcellent communication skills and the ability to explain learnings to both technical and non-technical partnersStrong critical thinking when working with AI-generated suggestions, with a clear approach to validating correctness, performance, security, and maintainability.Ability to connect data analysis to real business problems, in order to impact business performance.


In-Office Requirement Statement

We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we’re not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connectionThis role may require you to be located near an office for in-person collaboration, and therefore may need to be located a commutable distance from one of our Pinterest offices.

rows.title: Assistant Account Executive, Burson Global Marketing & Communications

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About The Role

Fresh off being named PR Agency of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions Festival of Creativity – yes, we’re still enjoying saying that – Burson is looking for an Assistant Account Executive to join our Global Marketing & Communications team.

In this role, you’ll help shape how Burson shows up in the world. You’ll support brand and content development, external communications and marketing activations at major industry events including Davos and Cannes. You’ll also gain hands-on experience in agency-side marketing and communications while working with the team that built the Burson brand from the ground up.

What You'll Do

This role is ideal for a curious, driven self-starter, with a creative spirit and attention to detail; an early career communicator who is eager to help develop a brand from the inside out. You’ll work closely with senior leaders – including the EVP, External Marketing; Global Head of Communications; and Global Chief Brand and Corporate Strategy Officer – and collaborate with colleagues across creative, digital, operations, disciplines and markets. Much like Burson builds reputation at scale for its global client partners, this role is focused on helping to develop and deliver integrated programs that advance Burson’s strategic priorities and strengthen its own brand reputation.

External Communications

Track category trends to sharpen our communications strategies, messaging, content development and outreach.Draft and edit content packages that support all of our earned efforts – from press releases and pitches to bylines and presentations.Translate one message into many, tailoring content and messaging for different audiences, channels and markets without losing the thread to Burson’s brand voice.Review local market, practice group and Burson Group brand materials to ensure they align with Burson’s brand voice, tone and messaging guidelines.Show up with ideas, news angles and relevant industry perspectives.Keep multiple workstreams moving at once.

Media Management

Help design and shape how AI transforms our communications workflows and infrastructure, serving as an early adopter and proof point for Burson’s innovation tools and services across media intelligence, outreach and reporting.Use real-time media intelligence and AI-supported monitoring tools to flag coverage, surface emerging narratives and identify story opportunities as they happen.Build and maintain a living map of journalists, publications, podcasts, newsletters and emerging channels, tracking beats and interests to sharpen where and how we pitch.Draft and execute targeted pitches, coordinate follow-up and track outcomes.Partner with social and owned-channel colleagues to extend the life of earned coverage – turning placements into content that performs across platforms and formats.Keep a daily pulse on the industry, including competitor coverage, Burson’s earned media and the broader conversation. Flag trends, risks and opportunities for the team.Turn outreach and coverage data into insight by tracking results, distilling takeaways and using what you learn to sharpen future strategy. “It felt like a good week” is a mood, not a measurement framework.

Events and External Marketing

Partner with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver events and external marketing activations aligned with Burson’s broader brand and communications strategy.Develop event timelines, project plans, guest lists, invitations, agendas, speaker materials, briefing documents and other logistical deliverables.Support thought leadership and practice marketing campaigns from conception through launch, coordinating with stakeholders across the organization to keep materials, timelines and deliverables on track.Coordinate with creative, digital, operations, regional teams, external vendors and partners to help ensure event materials and deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.Cultivate relationships with vendors and partners through timely, relevant and professional engagement.Provide on-site and virtual support for events, including registration, run-of-show coordination, stakeholder communications, troubleshooting and post-event follow-ups. The event may be on a world stage, but someone still needs to know where the name badges are.Assist with post-event reporting, coverage tracking, attendee communications and evaluation of event outcomes.For a full list of Burson’s upcoming events please visit: https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/burson-events

Experience That Contributes To Success

At least six months of experience, including internships, in the PR field. Agency experience is a plus.Based in New York and the ability to work within Burson’s hybrid in-office model, with at least three days per week in the Burson NYC office at 3WTC.Exposure to – or genuine curiosity about – in-house or agency-side marketing and communications. Important plot point: this is not a client-facing agency role.Excellent written and verbal communication skills that can flex across formats.Sharp organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.Comfort working with senior leaders, with the ability and speed to manage time-critical requests.Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint and Excel, as well as basic project-management tools.Hands-on experience with AI and a willingness to keep learning as the tools – and the conversation around them – continue to evolve.

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:

$35,000—$75,000 USD

You Belong At Burson

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

rows.title: VIE - Data Analyst (H/F) - New York

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
CONTEXTE ET MISSION

Dans le cadre de l'expansion de sa Data Platform cloud, Hermès engage la transformation de son patrimoine data aux États-Unis. Vous rejoignez cette initiative à un moment charnière : celui où les fondations analytiques se construisent. Votre mission est de garantir que les données soient fiables, documentées et exploitables .

Le ou la VIE sera un interlocuteur clé entre les équipes métier US et l'équipe Analytics & AI de HDTI, contribuant à la fois à la fiabilisation des données et à leur valorisation via Power BI. Vous formerez également un binôme opérationnel avec le ou la VIE Data Engineer présent(e) sur le même programme : l'un construit les fondations, l'autre les valorise.

Ce poste requiert avant tout une forte compréhension fonctionnelle des données : savoir analyser un jeu de données, en comprendre le sens métier, identifier les anomalies et documenter avec rigueur. La maîtrise technique est un levier, la capacité d'assimilation des processus fonctionnels est indispensable.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

Relais standards & bonnes pratiques

 Agir en tant que relais local des standards, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques définis en matière d'analyse de données et de développement BI et en garantir l’adoption et le respect au sein de l'équipe US.

Exploration & rétro-documentation de l'existant

 Établir le diagnostic data de l'existant US. Produire des profils de données (data profiling) et documenter les anomalies et zones de risque, constituant ainsi la cartographie de référence du patrimoine data avant migration. Identifier les règles métier implicites dans les données existantes pour alimenter la modélisation cible. Construire la mémoire analytique du projet.

Analyse de qualité & détection des écarts (Gap Analysis)

 Comparer les données sources (plateforme locale) aux nouveaux data models Snowflake, périmètre, définitions, et produire une analyse d'écarts actionnables pour les équipes d'ingénierie. Formaliser les écarts constatés et proposer des règles de réconciliation ou de transformation. Suivre les indicateurs de qualité data tout au long du processus de migration, en assurant une visibilité continue sur l'état de fiabilité des données.

Développement de dashboards & reporting

 Livrer les premiers reportings opérationnels post-migration aux équipes métier US, avec un impact visible dès les premières semaines : vous traduisez la donnée en décision. Développer des dashboards Power BI sur le semantic layer de la nouvelle Data Platform, en respectant les standards de certification Hermès. Contribuer à l'adoption de la nouvelle plateforme par les équipes métier en rendant les données accessibles, lisibles et fiables.

Collaboration & documentation

 Travailler en lien étroit avec le Data Engineer VIE et les équipes Analytics & AI Paris pour assurer la cohérence des livrables. Documenter systématiquement les analyses, hypothèses et conclusions dans les outils de référence de l'équipe. Contribuer aux ateliers de qualification métier pour valider les règles de gestion et les définitions de données.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 Diplôme Bac+4/5 en data, statistiques, économétrie, mathématiques appliquées ou école de commerce avec spécialisation data ou équivalent Première expérience (stage, alternance ou poste junior) en analyse de données ou BI dans un environnement structuré SQL avancé Power BI Capacité à réaliser du data profiling et à interpréter des indicateurs de qualité de données La connaissance de Snowflake ou d'un cloud data warehouse est un plus La maîtrise de Python ou R pour l'analyse exploratoire est appréciée Autonomie, rigueur, sens analytique, curiosité Aisance en anglais professionnel (écrit et oral) indispensable ; le français est un atout

CE QUE VOUS Y TROUVEREZ

 Une mission à fort enjeu sur un programme de transformation data stratégique . Un rôle de passerelle entre les équipes IT & métier US et les équipes data centrales, avec une visibilité forte dès le départ. Basé(e) aux États-Unis, vous évoluez dans un environnement à culture entrepreneuriale forte, avec une autonomie réelle et une exposition directe aux équipes métier locales dès le premier mois. Les VIE qui réussissent cette mission ont vocation à rejoindre les équipes Analytics & AI d'HDTI à l'issue de leur contrat, en France ou à l'international. Ce poste est un tremplin, pas une parenthèse.

Merci de vérifier que vous remplissez les conditions du V.I.E avant de postuler à l’offre d’emploi.

Vous pouvez être volontaire si vous remplissez les 5 conditions suivantes :

Avoir entre 18 et 28 ans à la date de l'inscription. Le départ en mission s'effectue au plus tard le jour du 29e anniversaire. Au-delà, aucune dérogation n'est accordée.

Être français ou ressortissant d'un pays de l'Espace économique européen

Être en règle avec les obligations de service national (journée de défense et de citoyenneté)

Jouir de vos droits civiques (droit de vote et casier judiciaire vierge)

Remplir les conditions d'aptitude physique exigées pour les personnes exerçant des activités de même nature dans l'organisme d'accueil

Plus de détail sur le lien suivant : https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F10040

Employeur responsable, Hermès s'engage en faveur de l'éthique, de la diversité et de l'inclusion.

Rejoignez l'aventure humaine Hermès et construisez votre parcours cousu main.

"Créateur, artisan et marchand d’objets de haute qualité, Hermès est, depuis 1837, une maison française, familiale et indépendante qui emploie près de 25 185 collaborateurs dans le monde. Animé par un esprit d’entreprendre continu et une exigence constante, Hermès cultive la liberté et l’autonomie de chacun grâce à un management responsable. L’entreprise perpétue la transmission de savoir-faire d’exception par un ancrage territorial fort dans le respect des hommes et de la nature – source de matières d’exception. Seize métiers artisanaux irriguent la créativité de la maison dont les collections rayonnent dans près 300 magasins dans le monde."
