rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The Marketing team at Agoda is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale, measurable marketing programs designed to improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers. The team combines a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists and data scientists, collectively building a team that thrives on data, creative ideas and technology. . The Marketing leadership fosters a great learning environment, providing the opportunity to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a diverse variety of backgrounds from across the globe.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples: 

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, Tripadvisor, Trivago and other search engines. Tableau, Power BIAbility to move fast and be efficient, making decisions on objective evidence rather than subjective gut feelInnate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomesExcellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

rows.title: Capabilities & Insights Analyst - Automotive
rows.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will collaborate with our global consultants to conduct research and analysis on companies and trends in the Automotive sector, e.g. auto manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, electrification, autonomous vehicles, and more.

You will be part of a global team that helps develop innovative solutions for our clients, as well as contribute to the continuous development of our knowledge infrastructure within the automotive domain. Your work will range from short-term information gathering to long-term project support. You will get access to a variety of industry-specific sources and global network of experts. You will analyze the positioning and competitiveness of our clients, evaluate key financial figures, technology and product strategies, and define market sizes and fields of application.

You will also receive coaching and professional development opportunities. In addition to mentoring from experienced colleagues, you will also attend high-quality internal training sessions.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or similar is required1+ years professional experience in the automotive sector, either within the industry or corporate strategy/market research covering automotive spaceComfortable using different generative AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, etc.) and know when to leverage themExcellent organizational capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completionProficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoningAbility to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverablesExceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environmentAbility to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at timesAbility to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not easily accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines)No immigration sponsorship is offered. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. indefinitelyStrong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

rows.title: Visiting Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist with expertise in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to support and advance cutting-edge translational research in cardiovascular imaging. The successful candidate will play a central role in the development, validation, and deployment of AI-enabled methods, with emphasis on cardiac MRI (CMR), quantitative imaging, and diagnostic and prognostic applications.

This position is ideal for a PhD scientist who enjoys hands-on technical development, close collaboration with clinicians, engineers, and industry partners, and contributing to NIH-funded, multi-center research programs, including active collaborations with Siemens Healthineers, with clear pathways toward clinical translation and impact.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Imaging Research

 Develop and implement deep learning models for MRI reconstruction, segmentation, quantification, and image enhancement Design, optimize, and evaluate AI pipelines to improve image acquisition efficiency, image quality, and robustness Integrate AI methods with quantitative CMR imaging biomarkers, including myocardial blood flow, strain, and tissue characterization Develop and apply methods for multi-modality data integration, combining imaging, physiologic signals (e.g., ECG), genetic, and clinical data for diagnostic and prognostic modeling Perform rigorous model validation, including reproducibility testing, bias assessment, and external validation Design, develop, and implement user-friendly software platforms for clinical deployment of AI-enabled imaging tools

Scientific Leadership

 Serve as a technical lead on funded research projects (NIH R01s, industry collaborations) Contribute to study design, statistical analysis plans, and imaging endpoints Lead or co-author high-impact manuscripts, abstracts, and grant submissions Mentor trainees (PhD students, postdocs, research staff)

Data & Infrastructure

 Build and maintain scalable AI/MRI pipelines (Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, etc.) Work with large-scale imaging datasets and HPC/GPU environments (H200s GPUs) Collaborate on data harmonization, curation, and governance across multi-site studies

Translational & Collaborative Work

 Partner closely with cardiologists, radiologists, MR physicists, and industry collaborators Support translation of AI tools toward clinical feasibility and regulatory readiness Present work at national and international scientific meetings

Required Qualifications

 PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Medical Physics, or related field Strong background in machine learning / deep learning / computer vision Demonstrated experience with MRI or medical imaging data Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) Track record of peer-reviewed publications in imaging or AI-related fields

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience in cardiac MRI Familiarity with MRI physics, image reconstruction, or quantitative perfusion/flow Experience with generative models (diffusion models, super-resolution, image synthesis) Prior involvement in NIH-funded research or multi-center studies Interest in clinical translation and real-world deployment

Job Description

A Visiting Scientist collaborate swith other researchers in their particular field of science.

Required QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field2+ years supporting Ivalua or another enterprise S2P platform (e.g. SAP Ariba, Coupa).Source to Pay knowledge — Strong understanding of business processes and data structures for procurement, sourcing, invoicing, supplier management, and contracts.Hands on experience with building and supporting integrations between systems using different protocols including APIs, web services (REST/SOAP), SFTP, and an integration middleware (such as Boomi, MuleSoft, SAP PI/PO, etc.).Ability to read and interpret JSON, XML, SQL, and integration logs.Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.Excellent communication skills.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

rows.title: Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Salary Range: $80,000 - $90,500 per year

This is a Boston based opportunity with a 4 day in office expectation (Monday - Thursday) with 1 day remote (Friday).

At this time, Wayfair will not sponsor applicants for employment authorization for this position for the following work visas: STEM OPT EAD, H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, O-1, J-1, or TN.

Wayfair is continuing to expand our commitment to hiring and supporting talent early in their careers, focusing on filling opportunities with recent graduates who have 0-3 years of work experience. We are continually recruiting candidates for this position on a rolling basis as we have a high volume of openings that become available.

Who We Are

Wayfair’s Operations organization is revolutionizing the customer experience through the development of a proprietary logistics network and optimization platform that manages inventory from overseas factories to customer’s front door. This team works directly with suppliers, vendors, and customers to provide new levels of efficiency and performance. They also interact internally with Product, Engineering, and Business Intelligence teams to generate the core analytical insights that enable Wayfair to tackle transportation, warehousing, and delivery challenges. As an Analyst, you’ll develop and execute strategies that generate competitive advantage for Wayfair, and the results of your findings will improve the day-to-day efficiency of a complex and sophisticated global supply chain.

We are looking for analytical, action-oriented, and collaborative individuals that can translate business problems to actionable insights and data driven solutions to influence operational results. Successful individuals in this role excel at both qualitative and quantitative analysis while also being eager to communicate upward and outward to tell a concise story.

What You'll Need

Basic Qualifications

At Wayfair, we focus on helping people on their journey to home - specifically those who have lost their way from home. rows.title: Customer Success Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Flexcompute is a cutting-edge technology startup that specializes in ultra-fast simulation technology. Our products are utilized by companies in designing and optimizing technology products, with applications ranging from designing airplanes and cars to wind turbines and quantum computing chips. Our customer base includes both household names and startups in emerging industries. Our company was founded by world-renowned leaders in simulation technology from Stanford University and MIT. Backed by top VC firms, we are poised to disrupt the billion-dollar engineering simulation industry with our fast-growing trajectory.

About The Role

The Customer Operations Specialist owns provisioning and onboarding: getting every new customer access to the right products, seats, and entitlements quickly and correctly, and making sure they reach first value fast with no gaps. You are the operational bridge between Sales, our Application Engineers, and the customer, and the person who keeps access clean and accurate across the entire customer base.

This is a high-ownership role with real room to grow. You will help build and maintain processes where little exists today.

Preferred: US Citizen/Greencard holder (for ITAR Accounts)

What You'll Do

Own provisioning. Create, modify, and deprovision access across products, including seats, licenses, and credit entitlements, quickly and accuratelyOwn onboarding. Run the handoff from Sales to Operations to Application Engineers so every new customer has an owner, a checklist, and a clear path to first valueKeep access clean. Maintain accurate account records, entitlements, and contacts, and run regular audits so access always matches what each customer is entitled toPartner across the business. Work closely with Sales, Application Engineers, and the Deal Desk so customers move smoothly from close to provisioning to billingBe the frontline for access. First responder for access and entitlement requests, resolving what you can and escalating technical questions to the Application Engineers and Infrastructure teamSurface signals. Flag at-risk and expansion-ready accounts to Sales and Customer Success from usage and onboarding dataImprove the machine. Find the manual and error-prone steps in provisioning and onboarding and systematically remove themStay close to customers. Spend regular face time with customers through check-ins and account reviews to confirm they are getting value and that renewals stay on track, surfacing risks early to Account owners


Tools you'll work with

Day to day you'll work primarily in HubSpot (account records, onboarding stages, contacts), our product provisioning and admin consoles, and Excel / Google Sheets for tracking and audits. Comfort learning internal tools quickly and keeping data clean across systems is essential.

How success is measured: KPIs

The metrics you'll own and report on:

Time-to-provision: time from signed deal to access grantedTime-to-first-value: time from provisioning to the customer's first meaningful useProvisioning accuracy: share of provisioning actions completed with no errors or reworkOnboarding completion: share of new customers completing onboarding within the agreed windowAccess-request resolution: share of access and entitlement requests resolved within SLAEntitlement accuracy: share of accounts whose access exactly matches entitlements at auditHandoff quality: share of deals that move from close to live with no dropped stepsRenewal readiness: share of accounts with a recent customer touchpoint and no unaddressed risks ahead of renewal


Requirements

1 to 3 years in a customer-facing, operations, or coordination role (customer success, support, onboarding, sales operations, or similar)Strong organization and attention to detail; you rarely let things slipComfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, and quick to pick up new software toolsClear, professional communication with both customers and internal teamsA self-starter who takes ownership and follows through without being chasedComfortable juggling many small tasks and deadlines at once

Nice to haves

Experience with HubSpot or another CRMExposure to SaaS onboarding, provisioning, or customer success operationsFamiliarity with AI tools for organizing work and automating repetitive tasksInterest in, or exposure to, technical, engineering, or scientific productsExperience documenting or improving a process


Benefits

Competitive compensation with equity of a fast-growing startupMedical, dental, and vision health insurance401(k) ContributionGym allowanceFriendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers

Focus Partners is seeking a Client Service Associate to join our growing team! Translate system workflows into system configurations  Translate and present project concepts into effective visual images which clarify design elements and issues for both business and technical audiences. rows.title: Single Billing Office Cash Specialist (On-Site)
rows.descriptionText:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under general supervision of the Manager of Hospital Billing, and within regulatory requirements, the Single Billing Office (SBO) Cash Specialist is responsible for processing electronic and manual charge and cash revenue transactions into the electronic medical record. The Single Billing Office Cash Specialist provides a vital role to the patients, family members, Finance, and Revenue Cycle for Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH) and its affiliates. This position is responsible for supporting the Customer service department, posting of self-pay payments, credit balances, cash balancing, reconciliation and depositing cash for BILH, as well as the patient window inquiries at BILH. Position is required to meet stringent quality, productivity and time sensitive standards The primary role of the SBO Cash Specialist is to act as a liaison to our customers, departments and physician practices on all matters regarding cash.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to:

Timely verification and reconciliation of electronically received charge or remittance revenue transactions originating from a variety of charge capture and specialty-driven computer systems and health insurers.Assists customers with statement, bill, and copay issues to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.Works with BILH hospitals, off-site practices, and departments throughout the organization to ensure the daily cash bag is balanced and everything is documented on the cash sheet as appropriate.Working in an SBO (Single Billing Office) environment, the SBO Cash Specialist will need to have knowledge of Hospital and Professional Billing in order to assist the customer with questions related to their bills and statements received from insurance companies.Resolves unapplied cash, payment plans, and cosmetic services.Resolves self-pay credits and refunds to patients as necessary.Posting of self-pay payments to the patient’s account.Prepares and reconciles bank deposits.Monitors the Deposit tool to ensure timely deposits from off-site.Investigates debits and credits for the Finance department.Maintains appropriate audit results or achieves exemplary audit results. Meet productivity standards or consistently exceed productivity standards.Provides and promotes ideas geared toward process improvements within the Central Billing Office.Assists the Cash Manager with the resolution of complex credits and self pay accounts.Completes projects and research as assigned.

Organizational Requirements

Maintain strict adherence to the BILH Confidentiality policy.Incorporate BILH Standards of Behavior and Guiding Principles into daily activities.Comply with all BILH Policies.Comply with behavioral expectations of the department and BILH.Maintain courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.Demonstrate an understanding of the job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.Demonstrate a commitment toward meeting and exceeding the needs of our internal and external customers and consistently adhere to Customer Service standards.Participate in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.Participate in and successfully complete Mandatory Education.Perform all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.

Education

Minimum Qualifications:

High School Diploma Required, Bachelor’s Degree Preferred

Licensure, Certification & Registration:

Billing Certification preferred

Experience

2 years of experience in cash management and customer service or related fields

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

Understanding and ability to utilize various electronic, web based and manual coding resourcesAbility to perform transactions in a patient accounting systemProficient data entry computer skillsDemonstrated ability to utilize word processing, spreadsheets and work files in performing work tasksDemonstrated attention to detail and accuracySkillful ability to use calculators to reconcile amountsStrong communication skills including verbal in person, telephone and writtenDemonstrated ability in being a cooperative and productive member of teamAbility to troubleshoot problemsAbility to continue to learn skills and expand knowledgeStrong multitasking skills

Pay Range

$21.00 - $28.26

The pay range listed for this position is the base hourly wage range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law. Compensation may exceed the base hourly rate depending on shift differentials, call pay, premium pay, overtime pay, and other additional pay practices, as applicable to the position and in accordance with the law.

More than 35,000 people working together. Nurses, doctors, technicians, therapists, researchers, teachers and more, making a difference in patients' lives. Your skill and compassion can make us even stronger.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Qualifications

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Case Research
rows.descriptionText:
Join a fast-growing company that's transforming the industry! Financial Recovery Technologies (FRT) is a technology-based services firm that helps institutional investors identify, file claims, and collect funds made available in securities class action settlements globally. As a Senior Analyst on the Case Research Team, you will use your eye for detail and your proven research skills to ensure FRT never fails to identify an opportunity to recover portfolio funds for its clients and prepare data for downstream processing, ensuring we recover all funds due to our clients.
As a Senior Analyst on the Case Research Team at FRT, you will:
Apply your diligent and detail-oriented mind to the timely and accurate identification and representation of relevant legal matters in our case databaseFollow defined processes for ensuring all cases are identified that would relevant in connection with our domestic claim filing and antitrust productsEnsure no cases are missed – your team should be the first-to-know of new cases and new developments and settlements in existing casesIdentify potential improvements to our case research processes and work with others to make them happenEnsure our case research process is comprehensive yet efficient, putting quality assurance and control measures in place when appropriateIdentify opportunities to increase automation in our case, client, and claim tracking systemsMake sure your work is auditable – not only should we have an excellent process, we should be able to prove we followed it!Analyze key case data by demonstrating the application of standard models and consistent decision-makingExtract and interpret case data in various legal documentsApply our standard analysis models to data to properly set up our own case processing for success
OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE IS:Experienced (3+ years) in conducting (mostly online) research (exposure to legal research is a plus!);Extremely detail oriented – you regularly double-check your work, not because you are sloppy and have to but because you would rather measure twice and cut once;Engaged in their work, even in the face of at-times-repetitive tasks;Can see the forest for the trees, making connections to the bigger picture;A fast learner, capable of making a quick impact on a team;Able to adhere to established processes without losing the creative spark required to fine tune those processes and identify alternative ways of accomplishing objectives;Comfortable with the basics of Excel, SQL, and database concepts;Intellectually curious, with a demonstrated commitment to continuous growth; andOf course, looking to join a growing company with a vibrant, entrepreneurial culture, dedicated to being the top provider in the class action recovery space.
WHAT FRT OFFERS:Competitive salary and bonus ($60,000-$80,000 base)Health, dental, vision401k (with company match)Income protection plans (life, accidental death and dismemberment, short- and long-term disability) and access to a suite of voluntary benefitsFun, smart, diverse colleaguesWe are a hybrid company; in office, we offer:Close to public transit (walking distance to Wellington T on Orange Line)Free drinks and snacksFree parking onsiteFree access to onsite gym
THIS POSITION WILL BE BASED IN OUR MEDFORD, MA HEADQUARTERS. LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY, PLEASE.
AGENCIES: WE ARE NOT WORKING WITH AGENCIES ON THIS REQUISITION.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, GenAI Marketing (Bangkok Based, Relocation Provided)
rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda’s Marketing organization is highly data-driven and uses experimentation, technology and analytics to create measurable value across markets and channels.

Marketing has successfully developed a strong bottom-up culture of AI adoption, with teams using GenAI to improve analysis, reporting, campaign operations, content development and other recurring workflows. We are now establishing a small Marketing AI Products team to take the next step: turning the most valuable cross-team opportunities into reliable, scalable and widely adopted products.

The team will focus on a small number of high-impact “lighthouse” initiatives while Marketing sub-teams continue to develop and own their everyday, team-specific AI use cases. Initial opportunity areas include experiment analysis, business reporting and monitoring, campaign operations, creative workflows and SEO/AEO content.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on analyst and product builder who can operate at the intersection of Marketing, data, product development and generative AI.

You will identify high-value workflows, translate business problems into clear product requirements, develop and evaluate solutions, and work with developers and Marketing teams to take successful ideas from prototype through deployment and adoption.

This is not a traditional reporting role or a purely coordination-focused product role. You will be expected to work directly with data and AI tools, understand users’ workflows in detail and take ownership of delivering measurable outcomes.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

Identify recurring Marketing workflows where AI can materially improve speed, quality, scalability or decision-making.Quantify each opportunity by establishing its current effort, pain points, user base and potential business value.Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, milestones and measurable success criteria.Build and test prototypes using SQL, Python, automation tools and generative AI technologies.Partner with developers, Technology teams and sponsoring Marketing teams to turn successful prototypes into reliable products.Design evaluation frameworks covering output accuracy, reliability, usability, safety and appropriate human review.Lead user research, pilots and iterative testing with analysts, channel specialists and other target users.Drive rollout, documentation, training and adoption in partnership with sponsoring teams.Measure hours saved, improvements in turnaround time and quality, adoption levels and downstream business impact.Maintain a prioritized portfolio of Marketing AI opportunities and communicate progress, learnings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.Monitor developments in AI capabilities and identify when existing products should be improved, expanded or retired.Contribute reusable tools, standards and playbooks that help Marketing teams build better AI-enabled workflows independently.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

4–6 years of relevant experience in analytics, product analytics, marketing strategy, business operations, consulting, product management or a related field.Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative, technical or business discipline such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics or finance.Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large or complex datasets.Hands-on experience with Python, scripting, workflow automation or similar technical tools.Experience defining hypotheses, designing experiments and translating results into actionable business recommendations.Strong product thinking, including the ability to understand user problems, define requirements and make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions.Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured workstreams and move rapidly from analysis to execution.Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.Experience influencing stakeholders and communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, dependable solutions.Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Analytics, Product and Technology teams.Experience building GenAI applications, AI agents or automated analytical workflows.Familiarity with prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, APIs, model evaluation and human-in-the-loop workflows.Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code or Google AI Studio.

It’s Great if You Have

Experience writing product requirements, managing a product backlog or taking an internal product from prototype to scaled adoption.Knowledge of digital marketing, performance marketing, experimentation, SEO/AEO, campaign operations or personalization.Experience establishing quality-assurance and monitoring processes for data or AI products.Experience deploying internal tools or working closely with software engineers on production systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will help launch and scale a small number of cross-Marketing AI products with clear adoption and value metrics. These products should deliver measurable improvements in employee productivity, output quality or business outcomes—and have clearly defined ownership, documentation, quality controls and maintenance plans.

rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The B2B Digital Marketing team sits within Agoda’s B2B Marketing organization and is responsible for delivering high‑quality, scalable marketing campaigns for our partners across B2B2C channels. We work closely with Commercial, Product, Data, and regional Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are efficiently executed, performance is clearly measured, and partners receive actionable, data‑driven recommendations that drive value for both Agoda and our partners.

Our mission is to balance operational excellence with growth impact — building repeatable, scalable frameworks that allow us to support dozens of partners at once, while still delivering insights tailored to each partner’s performance and business context.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples: 

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, Tripadvisor, Trivago and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.Modeling: Analyze vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop predictive models using data science techniques (eg. understanding impact on bookings from large scale TV campaigns or demand elasticity from pricing optimization) and liaise with product teams on implementation roadmapReporting, analysis and insights: Building dashboards to track performance, derive insights, understand growth levers and communicate recommendations via presentations to stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor’s degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject (computer science, mathematics, engineering business or science)Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English2+ years experience in data crunching from top-tier consulting, investment banking, private equity or strategy/business for a fast-growing globaltech companyExperience in one or more data analysis packages or databases, eg., SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQL and visualization tools, eg. Tableau, Power BIAbility to move fast and be efficient, making decisions on objective evidence rather than subjective gut feelInnate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomesExcellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

It’s great if you have: 

Experience in digital marketing or ecommerceExperience with A/B testing and other testing metricsStrong presentation and negotiation skillsSkills that foster collaboration and team spirit

rows.title: Marketing QA Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
What You'll Do

Own the QA process across multiple projects and run comprehensive QA testing for new promotions, marketing automations, and feature releases across the iLottery platform, mobile app, and website.Compose, build and finalize test plans, test cases, and regression testing procedures to validate technical functionality, platform improvements, and player-facing features.Ensure that new promotions, player journeys, and segmentation logic function as encouraged from both a technical and customer-facing perspective.Log, track, and analyze defects in collaboration with internal teams and vendor partners; clearly document issues for effective resolution.Work closely with product managers, developers, and marketing leads to ensure business and technical requirements offer clarity across business units and translate into effective QA plans. Maintain documentation to improve awareness within the team, project efficiency and facilitate effective exchange of information.Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for ongoing platform development and marketing initiatives. Provide input on release readiness and support crucial changes prior to releases and campaign launches.Perform cross-platform testing using manual and automated methods. Use external testing providers like Applause for scalability and real-user validation. Own measurement set up and validate tagging and analytics events related to promotions, campaigns and new platform features.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Marketing Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. A comparable amount of training and related experience may be substituted.Proven experience in digital QA, technical testing, or QA Specialist roles supporting websites, apps, or marketing technologies. Use of QA tools & platforms (Jira, BrowserStack, etc).Solid understanding and shown success of QA approaches, project phases, and testing processes, across web and mobile platforms in agile environments.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and risk mitigation.Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, customer journeys, segmentation logic, and workflows connected through software interfaces.Clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with multi-functional teams and external vendors.Knowledge of accessibility and compliance standards is a plus.Experience with lottery, iGaming, or ecommerce platforms is an advantage.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

rows.title: Business Analyst I (Growth Marketing)
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Job Level: Entry Level

Are you interested in taking on responsibility for the business management of projects ranging from $1 million to $4 billion? Would you like to play a key role in forecasting and accounting practices? If so, Kiewit and Mass Electric Industrial is looking for individuals who can make a meaningful impact on our company culture every day.

The Finance Analyst is an entry-level operational finance role focused on supporting construction projects in accounting, finance, and operations-related functions. Each project runs like a small business, with the Finance Analyst responsible for critical tasks such as cost control, payroll, accounts payable/receivable, human capital management, and compliance. This position will develop expertise in executing processes and utilizing tools related to various cost and revenue components, including labor, construction equipment, materials, and subcontracts. The Finance Analyst will also play an integral role in the month-end close process and assist with preparing financial reporting packages for project management.

At Kiewit, the scale of our operations is vast. Our construction and engineering projects span the United States, Canada, and Mexico, improving and connecting communities with every initiative. We depend on our high-performing operations support professionals — they are the glue that holds multiple areas of the business together and the catalysts that make things happen. We hire only the most driven people and provide them with diverse career opportunities, strong leadership and mentorship, collaborative and rewarding work, and responsibilities they won’t find just anywhere. We’re always pushing new limits — and you can too.

Mass Electric Construction Co. is a subsidiary of the Kiewit Corporation.  Since our founding in 1928 in Boston, Massachusetts, Mass. Electric Construction’s philosophy has been to pursue electrical projects that require a higher level of technical and logistical skill. MEC Industrial has organized strategically to actively participate and capture projects in the growing industrial market.  We intend to effectively compete and win in traditional and alternate delivery procurements and position ourselves for a sustainable future. We self-perform the majority of our work and are looking for people committed to the industrial construction industry.

Location

One of the many things that makes our culture unique is that we go where the work is, giving your career exposure to abundant opportunities nationwide. Because our projects span coast to coast, relocation is a core part of the MEC experience. We move our teams based on where the work is needed, while also considering each team member’s development plans, skill sets, and career goals. This means your MEC adventure is custom‑designed to meet both business and personal growth needs.

MEC Industrial is headquartered in Waltham, MA, but our job sites extend across the country—from major metropolitan areas to small towns. Candidates must be able to travel and relocate as frequently as business needs require. With projects happening in diverse locations, you’ll gain the chance to experience it all.

In this role, you will shape pricing and commercial strategies for partner opportunities, advise stakeholders on trade-offs, and drive value through execution and experimentation. You will work across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and partner-facing teams, often in situations where alignment matters as much as the analysis itself.

Own and evolve pricing strategies and optimization for B2B partner channels.Build and lead experimentation roadmaps, including test design, success measures, decision frameworks, and post-test actions.Evaluate pricing and growth opportunities through structured analysis, including elasticity, incrementality, cannibalization, and scenario modeling where relevant.Act as a trusted advisor to senior internal and external stakeholders; surface trade-offs, align priorities, and drive decisions to closure; Coordinate cross-functional execution across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and operations teams.Turn complex findings into concise executive narratives, recommendations, and decision-ready materials; Manage strategic partner and vendor interactions when required, including presentations, working sessions, and follow-ups.

What You'll Bring

Experience applying quantitative analysis to commercial decisions in technology, e-commerce, travel, management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing.Strong business judgment and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend a path forward.Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence without authority and build alignment across functions, seniority levels, and geographies.Fluency with data and analytical tools, including advanced SQL; experience with visualization tools such as Tableau or an equivalent platform.Practical experience designing or interpreting controlled experiments and translating results into decisions.A high-ownership, bias-for-action mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment.A bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

It's a plus if you have

A background in using quantitative data for decision making within tech, ecommerce , management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing initiativesExperience building decision frameworks or analytical tools that are used repeatedly in live business decisions.Working knowledge of Python or R for modeling and scalable analysis.

What Success Looks Like

Become a trusted advisor whose recommendations are clear, rigorous, and commercially grounded.Turn pricing insights and experiments into decisions and coordinated execution.Build alignment across stakeholders, functions, and markets.Develop repeatable approaches that can scale across partners.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:

As a Data Scientist, you will apply data science, analytics, machine learning, and AI to help improve customer experiences, products, and business operations. rows.title: Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Industrial Economics, Incorporated (IEc) provides consulting services for natural resource managers, regulators, attorneys, and other clients involved in public policy development and implementation. Our staff applies expertise in economics, science, engineering, business, computer modeling, and data management to cutting-edge environmental and natural resource policy and management issues. We are known for developing smart, objective analyses to address high-profile environmental and public policy problems, leveraging a unique combination of analytic rigor and creativity.
Position: Analyst to support one or more of IEc’s key practice areas, including public policy analysis, applied economics, environmental management and policy, natural resource damage assessment, program evaluation, finance, and sustainability.
Responsibilities: IEc Research Analysts (RAs) perform research and data gathering and organizing tasks; conduct quantitative analyses using a variety of economic, financial, or scientific methods; and communicate results in written reports and presentations. Candidates must demonstrate academic experience in at least one of a wide range of disciplines relevant to IEc’s work including, but not limited to, economics, applied mathematics, statistics and data science, public policy, engineering, finance, chemistry, biology, ecology, and other environmental sciences. RAs frequently work on multiple projects simultaneously and may work as part of large, multidisciplinary teams or more independently, depending on the project. Successful RAs are collaborative, exhibit intellectual curiosity, possess strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, pay careful attention to detail, and communicate effectively.
Required QualificationsBachelor’s or equivalent international degree in a relevant field (see above). Candidates with graduate degrees will not be considered for this position
Compensation and Advancement• IEc offers competitive salaries ranging from $50,000 to $60,000 commensurate with experience, as well as an annual performance bonus averaging 10% of annual salary.• We are committed to the health and well-being of our staff and provide excellent benefits, including quality medical and dental insurance with contribution to a Health Savings Account; generous contribution to retirement savings (based on tenure); an Employee Assistance Program; flexible vacation/holiday time; financial support for relevant professional development opportunities; sick time and short- and long-term disability; paid family and medical leave; commuter benefits; recreational and social opportunities; and more.• RAs are eligible for promotion to Senior Research Analyst (Senior RAs). As most advanced positions at IEc require a graduate degree, RAs and Senior RAs often depart for graduate school or other career opportunities after working at IEc for approximately two to four years.Position Location: IEc office is located in Cambridge, MA; this position requires presence in the office at least three days a week, with remaining days as optional hybrid working arrangements.
Position Start Date: Immediate/Fall 2026
To apply, you must upload all of the following materials: Cover letter; resume; undergraduate transcript; writing sample that should be authored solely by you (must be no more than 5 pages in length, which can be an excerpt from a longer paper, and include some type of technical information/analysis). To apply, please visit our website at www.indecon.com/open-positions
Industrial Economics is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable EEOC regulations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

rows.title: Associate - Global Transaction Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Associate - Global Transaction Analytics

About Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

The Team

Global Transaction Advisory Group (TAG)

TAG is a subsidiary of A&M, an established leader in providing global leadership and advisory services to a variety of diverse industries. TAG professionals specialize largely in providing financial and accounting buy-side and sell-side due diligence, capital markets and accounting advisory, global transaction analytics, environmental, technical & sustainability (ETS) and other related M&A services for private equity, hedge funds, sovereign wealth, family office and corporate clients around the world

Global Transaction Analytics (GTA)

A&M’s Global Transaction Analytics (GTA) practice, within our Transaction Advisory Group, has an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing team in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Denver, Chicago, New York, Atlanta, Houston, Nashville and Boston. We are seeking an Associate to bring their energy, passion, and expertise to help our clients get the answers they need to get the deal done across the investment lifecycle from pre-deal to post-deal analysis.

A&M GTA provides data analytics services to clients to uncover maximum actionable insights to support their M&A, divestment and investment strategy. GTA is a global team which leverages market leading technology, advanced analytics capabilities, and A&M’s operational, functional and industry expertise to drive relevant business insights. Our global team provides analytics as a service to private equity and corporates across the transaction lifecycle.

TAG is a subsidiary of A&M, an established leader in providing global leadership and advisory services to a variety of diverse industries. We provide private equity and corporate clients buy side and sell side financial accounting due diligence. TAG professionals actively engage in assessing a target’s quality of earnings, analyzing cash flows, reviewing working capital, identifying key business drivers, reviewing forecasts, and conducting comprehensive discussions with management and their advisors.

How will you contribute?

As an Associate in our GTA practice, you will have the opportunity to work with our highly motivated and effective team of professionals on a variety of interesting projects across different industries including but not limited to manufacturing, distribution, consumer, retail, restaurants, business and industrial services as well as healthcare, software & technology, energy and financial services. You will add value to our clients by offering data-enabled business, financial, and operational transparency during pre-acquisition due diligence or post-acquisitions performance improvement projects.

Responsibilities Will Include

Assist with numerous client engagementsExtract insights from data sets and trends by utilizing different tools and techniquesEffectively facilitate day-to-day client interaction and relationshipsWork cohesively and collaboratively across stakeholdersCounsel and mentor junior members of the team and continue to develop the team’s technical acumen

Qualifications

A minimum of 2+ years of experience in data analytics or transaction servicesBuy-side/vendor due diligence experience across industries preferredUnderstanding of M&A / PE investment lifecycle preferredBachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Statistics, Information Systems or a related fieldUnderstanding of data extraction, manipulation, analytics and visualization approachesStrong technical background with hands-on data analytics experienceProficiency in Microsoft Excel, relational databases/SQL querying, Alteryx, business intelligence/visualization (Tableau preferred), big data and machine learning conceptsAbility to leverage business intelligence software Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a through yet concise mannerExceptional project management skillsExcellent interpersonal and communication skillsFlexibility to work as both a team member in a collaborative setting and as an individual contributor Ability to thrive and be effective in fast-paced settings
Your journey at A&M

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

The base salary is $100,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.

A&M does not require or administer a lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

rows.title: Engineering Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At WECTEC Staffing Services, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Westinghouse Electric Company LLC, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.

About The Role

Engineering Analyst

Houston, TX

12 Months

The Engineering Analyst III serves as a data steward, technical advisor, and operational partner—ensuring that asset data is reliable, applicable, and supports our maintenance and asset management goals. Manage and analyzing Asset and Location data within IBM's Maximo Asset Management system. You will support our asset management operations by ensuring data integrity, generating applicable insights, and allowing data-driven decision-making. You will work with maintenance, engineering, and IT teams to improve asset lifecycle management and improve operational efficiency. Additionally, you will load/importin, validate asset and location records within the Maximo system.

Key Responsibilities

Gather and prepare data from multiple sources for upload, map source data to Maximo fields, perform quality checks, review drawings

Troubleshoot data discrepancies. Validate and ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency within Maximo.

Collaborate with teams to identify data needs, automate workflows, and streamline reporting processes.

Extract, clean, and analyze data from the Maximo Asset Management system to support business objectives.

Collaborate with site teams and Maximo users to gather required information and resolve any data-related issues, supporting both initial data loads and ongoing updates.

Help troubleshoot and resolve Maximo-related data issues.

Provide recommendations based on data trends and predictive analytics to improve preventive and corrective maintenance.

Support system upgrades, configuration changes, and data migration programs for Maximo.

Train users on automated data entry, reporting tools, and best practices for maintaining data quality.

Maintain dashboards and reports for asset performance, maintenance activities, and compliance.

Qualifications

Experience working with IBM Maximo or similar Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems

Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrate analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities

Proficient in SQL, Microsoft Excel, and data visualization tools such as Power BI, they should also understand asset management processes, and reliability principles.

Degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business, or a related technical discipline, or alternatively

8+ years of equivalent experience.

Our Safety Pledge To You

If you are as committed to your success as we are committed to your safety, then this is the position for you! For us, our guiding principle has always been and will continue to be the safety of our people. It's that simple!

rows.title: Business Analyst I (Growth Marketing)
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical instincts, clear communication, and a genuine eagerness to learn the craft of product management in a fast-moving, AI-driven environment.
