rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches and develops advanced analytics and machine learning-based solutions to solve challenging problems related to national security. Our team consists of passionate and motivated engineers with advanced degrees in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science, who are seeking opportunities to use their deep technical knowledge and creativity to tackle some of the hardest problems that our customers face. Our projects span multiple different data modalities and incorporate advanced algorithms, deep learning, and statistical techniques to uncover patterns in social media, structured and unstructured text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data, and must operate under challenging constraints not typically found in the commercial world. The tools and technologies we develop have real world impact and US Government analysts and operators use them to enable intelligence activities around the globe.

The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will help develop and integrate cutting-edge AI/ML models into production systems that solve critical national security problems.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, and domain experts, you will analyze interesting and challenging datasets to develop, implement, and evaluate AI/ML models to discover trends and form valuable intelligence insights. You will help bridge the gap between prototype and product by hardening solutions, building scalable backend services, and creating polished user interfaces with intuitive workflows. You will build software with AI/ML at its core, ranging from classical statistical methods to frontier language models, deployed across a diverse set of platforms including cloud, on-prem, desktop, mobile, and edge devices. In addition, you will collaborate closely with customers to understand mission needs, rapidly prototype capabilities, and iterate based on user feedback.

This position can be based in Woburn, MA; or Arlington, VA. Applicants should expect to primarily work onsite.

What you will do:

Investigate and analyze large and interesting data sets to identify and expose hidden patterns and trendsDevelop and apply novel AI/ML models to automatically derive valuable insights for defense and intelligence analystsCollaborate with diverse teams to develop and deploy cutting-edge capabilities into production systemsSupport the engineering of robust backend services, scalable APIs, and intuitive user interfaces

Who you are:

Active Secret Security Clearance with SCI Eligibility, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S governmentHold a BS with 2+ years of experience or M.S in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other related disciplineExperience in applying AI/ML methods to real-world data science problems, especially in settings where data is sparse, noisy, and/or high dimensionalExperience deploying AI/ML models and constructing analytics pipelines using modern Python-based frameworksFamiliarity with creating data visualizations and user interfaces or dashboardsProficient with Python and the traditional data science and machine learning stack, namely NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, and matplotlibProficient with version control software (Git), JIRA, Confluence, or other common collaboration toolsDemonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams and communicate with customers and end users

Even better:

Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance Solid understanding of software engineering principles, including testing, scalability, observability, maintainability, and performance optimizationExperience working with large datasets (> 100 GB) and familiarity with big data infrastructure and frameworks such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Dask, or MapReducePossession of an advanced degree in a scientific field and 2+ years of relevant experience after Bachelor’s degree (work or post-graduate)Experience in intelligence and military-related mission areas 

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $115,000 - $140,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

rows.title: Sales Analytics Analyst-Category
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Sales Analytics Analyst-NWPB (Category)

Position Overview:

This position supports the Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages (NWPB) division as a Sales Analytics Analyst dedicated to supporting the Category Strategy team. The analyst will serve as a critical thought partner to category leaders, providing insights, analytics, and reporting that help identify emerging consumer and retailer trends, shape category strategies, and drive growth for NWPB's portfolio of premium brands, including San Pellegrino, Maison Perrier, Acqua Panna, and Essentia.

This role goes beyond reporting and data management. The analyst will help transform data into actionable business insights that influence category recommendations, customer strategies, and marketplace decisions. By leveraging syndicated data, retailer insights, and internal business intelligence resources, this individual will help the Category Strategy team understand market dynamics, uncover growth opportunities, and strengthen NWPB's competitive position across channels and customers. In addition to that, this role supports category presentations that are shared amongst the local & global leadership teams.

As an integral member of the Category Strategy organization, you will collaborate closely with category leaders, customer teams, sales analytics, and cross-functional partners to deliver fact-based recommendations that support category growth, enhance retailer partnerships, and drive market share gains for San Pellegrino, Maison Perrier, Acqua Panna, Essentia, and the broader NWPB portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

Analysts will advise our category team by leading the facilitation of best-in-class data, insights, reporting, and analysis. Key responsibilities include:

Partner with Category Strategy leaders to identify growth opportunities for San Pellegrino, Maison Perrier, Acqua Panna, Essentia, and the broader NWPB portfolio by analyzing category trends, consumer behavior, competitive activity, and retailer strategies.Develop actionable category insights and recommendations that help position NWPB brands to win within evolving consumer preferences, premium beverage trends, and retailer growth strategies.Monitor category, consumer, and competitor performance to proactively identify risks and opportunities that influence brand share, category growth, and customer business planning.Support the development of category growth strategies and customer-facing selling stories that demonstrate how NWPB brands can drive incremental category value and meet retailer objectives.

Requirements:

Minimum of 18 months of experience in retail sales or a related sales environment with a focus on sales reporting and analytics.Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution or equivalent professional experienceProficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and TeamsIntermediate/advanced skill in Excel (Xlookups, pivots, etc.)Strong analytical, critical thinking, and time-management abilitiesExcellent customer service orientation and interpersonal skillsSuperior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearlyHigh level of organizational skills and attention to detailComprehensive understanding of 4P sales fundamentals

Preferred Qualifications:

Analytical Experience: Understanding data, building reports, and conducting analysisExperience with syndicated data sources (e.g., Circana, Nielsen) and data visualization techniques.Background in CPG or retail, with experience working in category strategy.Track record of successfully achieving Key Performance Indicator (KPI) objectives in previous roles.Proactive and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to challenge existing processes, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and identify opportunities that extend beyond the defined role.

Salary: $79,503.52 to $109,746.80 per year

Bonus Eligibility: 10%

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

Au sein d'une équipe internationale en charge du pilotage de la performance des services informatiques, vous contribuerez à développer de nouvelles approches basées sur la Data, l'Intelligence Artificielle et l'automatisation.

 Collecter, préparer, structurer et analyser des données provenant de différentes sources. Développer et améliorer des tableaux de bord et des visualisations de données. Explorer des modèles permettant d'anticiper les risques et les incidents. Rechercher des corrélations entre incidents, problèmes, changements et disponibilité des services. Expérimenter l'utilisation de l'IA générative pour faciliter l'analyse des incidents et de leurs causes. Contribuer à l'automatisation des analyses et des reportings récurrents. Améliorer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées pour le pilotage. Transformer les résultats des analyses en indicateurs et recommandations exploitables par les équipes opérationnelles et le management.

Analyse, traitement et visualisation de données

Python et/ou outils similaires d'analyse de données

Manipulation de données provenant de sources multiples

Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation

Une connaissance de SQL constitue un plus

Anglais professionnel

Curiosité et goût pour les nouvelles technologies

Esprit analytique et capacité à résoudre des problèmes

Rigueur et autonomie

Capacité à transformer des données complexes en informations simples et compréhensibles

Force de proposition et envie d'expérimenter

Goût du travail en équipe dans un environnement international

The team operates at the intersection of business operations, technology, and business intelligence. Team members partner with business stakeholders, application engineers, product teams, and operational leaders to develop solutions that improve efficiency, enhance reporting capabilities, and provide visibility into key business outcomes. Through operational reporting, data integration, and data visualization solutions, the team helps Real Estate Lending business units make informed, data-driven decisions.

The Summer Associate will work with operational and reporting data to develop meaningful dashboards, visualizations, and performance metrics that support business decision-making and process improvement initiatives.

rows.title: Senior Analyst Consumer & Marketplace Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

POSITION SUMMARY: 

The Marketing Analytics Sr. Analyst will play a vital role in supporting Nestlé USA's divisions by providing timely and unbiased insights to help inform key business decisions. This position requires a strong analytical mindset to develop and deliver perspectives grounded in data and statistical models, coupled with a deep understanding of evolving market and category dynamics. The successful candidate will utilize various analytical tools and leverage a variety of data sources (both syndicated and custom) to diagnose business performance, identify and size potential challenges and opportunities, and make impactful recommendations on marketing strategy and commercial allocation to help Nestle USA win in the marketplace.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Conduct thorough analyses of business performance, including sales driver decompositionEvaluate marketing performance and help guide commercial budget allocation through marketing mix modelingSize future category growth potential by analyzing market trends and shifts in consumer behaviorIdentify and size potential headwinds and tailwinds driven by macroenvironmental forcesPerform ad-hoc analyses requiring heavier data-driven approaches to support business decision-makingBuild strong relationships with key stakeholders across sales, marketing, finance, and the broader consumer insights teamCollaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on business priorities and the latest marketing strategies and objectivesPresent findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable mannerFurther champion Marketing Analytics by identifying opportunities to enhance capabilities and influence

REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science/Analytics, or a related fieldMaster’s degree in a relevant field is a plus

DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

3-5 years of proven experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, marketing research, or a related field, preferably within a consumer goods or retail environmentAbility to interpret complex data sets, with proven track record of drilling down deeper to uncover what really mattersExperience with syndicated market data and tools (e.g. Circana, NielsenIQ, Numerator, 84.51, Luminate) is a plusProficiency in analytical tools and software (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, R, Python, etc.)Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)Understanding of statistical modeling techniques and their application in marketing analysis

DESIRED SKILLS:

Strong analytical, creative problem-solving and decision-making skillsStrong interpersonal, collaboration, communication, and storytelling skills Ability to convey complex analytical insights to non-technical stakeholdersAbility to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environmentEnthusiasm for developing a deeper understanding of category and marketplace dynamicsPassion for driving businesses strategy and making a meaningful impactDesire to stay ahead of broader market/industry trends (general research and business news, new methodologies and techniques), and seek out opportunities to self-educate proactively

rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

As a Data Analyst, your focus will be on collecting, analyzing, and interpreting marketing data to inform strategies and decisions for nonprofit clients across diverse channels. This role will give you the insights you need to develop your expertise in omnichannel marketing, nonprofit fundraising, and analytic toolsets.

Moore is a data-driven constituent experience management (CXM) company achieving accelerated growth for clients through integrated supporter experiences across all platforms, channels, and devices. We are an innovation-led company that is the largest marketing, data, and fundraising company in North America, serving the purpose-driven industry with clients across education, association, political, and commercial sectors.

Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.

Your Impact:

Design and maintain comprehensive reports, dashboards, Key Performance Indicators, and other business tools to inform client strategy. Leverage your coding skills to transform data into useable information that can be presented in Power BI, Excel, and/or other reporting tools. Apply technical skills to deploy automated procedures that drive efficient data ingestion and transformation. Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in complex data sets to drive decisions. Work with internal team members to develop deep knowledge of our clients’ programs to produce more relevant analysis and deepen your analytic abilities. Collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Identify errors in data files or reports and take measures to resolve them. Perform other duties as required. 


Your Profile: 

Bachelor’s degree 1-3 years’ experience in an analytical role Experience in direct marketing preferred Excellent analytical skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to present findings clearly and concisely. Familiarity with fundraising metrics, file segmentation techniques, and direct marketing strategy. Demonstrated, hands-on experience with SQL and Python; a Snowflake environment a plus. Fundamental understanding of relational database design and reporting systems. Intermediate to advanced users of Excel with strong ability in formulas, functions, and pivot tables. Experience with statistical analysis methods and concepts like randomized controlled trials, hypothesis testing, summary statistics, regression, and other explanatory and predictive modeling frameworks. Experience with direct marketing and attribution across multiple channels, including but not limited to direct mail, website, digital advertising, email, and direct response TV. Attention to detail with the intrinsic ability to identify anomalies, discover the root cause, and correct underlying issues 


How We’ll Support You:

Join the largest marketing and fundraising company in North America serving the nonprofit industry, where we prioritize innovation and professional growth. Collaborate with industry subject matter experts with over 5,000 employees across the enterprise. To help you stay energized, engaged, and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits, including comprehensive healthcare, paid holidays, and generous paid time off so you can have the time and space to recharge and pursue your other passions and be with the people you care about.Moore is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. rows.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
We are the nonprofit behind .ORG. We provide safe and trusted online homes for anyone working to make a positive impact in the world. As a champion for privacy and security, we also foster collaboration among the Internet community to promote and protect a free and open Internet that serves the public interest. We are seeking a talented Marketing and Communications Coodinator to join our team!
The Marketing and Communications Coordinator is a generalist role that supports the day-to-day execution of Public Interest Registry's marketing and communications programs. Rather than specializing in a single channel, this position works across marketing, communications, and administrative functions to keep existing M&C programs and initiatives running smoothly — from content development and campaign support to internal communications, reporting, and event planning and support. This role is a strong fit for someone early in their marketing/communications career who wants broad, hands-on exposure across the discipline and is looking to grow into a more specialized or managerial role over time.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Support the Senior Director, Marketing and Communications and the broader M&C team in the day-to-day execution of existing marketing and communications programs and initiatives.
• Assist with the development and scheduling of content across digital, social, email marketing, blogs, and web channels, ensuring consistency with PIR's brand voice and style guidelines. Specifically, as it relates to both PIR and NetBeacon’s social media platforms. 
• Help maintain the team's editorial and campaign calendars, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and approvals across multiple concurrent projects.
• Draft, proofread, and format written materials such as newsletters, web copy, social posts, presentations, talking points, and internal communications.
• Serve as the primary intake point for internal requests, systematically organizing and prioritizing communication needs from various teams across the organization.
• Coordinate logistics for M&C-supported events, webinars, and sponsorships, including scheduling, vendor communication, and occasional on-site [KR1.1]or virtual support.
• Support the Digital Marketing Manager in compiling performance data and preparing regular reports on marketing metrics to inform ongoing campaigns.
• Maintain the department's digital asset library, media lists, and distribution lists, and help ensure marketing/communications materials are current and organized.
• Support internal communications efforts, including employee updates and materials that help align staff with marketing and communications initiatives.
• Assist with vendor and agency coordination (e.g., design, printing, media monitoring, and other outside partners) under the guidance of the Senior Director.
• Provide general administrative and project support to the Marketing and Communications team as needed, including invoice processing.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support the goals of the Marketing and Communications team.
Supervision Received and Exercised
Position works under the direct supervision of the Senior Director, Marketing and Communications. This position does not have supervisory responsibility for other staff.
Minimum Education and Experience Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
• 2-4 years of professional experience spanning marketing and/or communications functions (e.g., content, social media, digital marketing, PR, internal communications, or events); breadth across areas is valued over depth in a single specialty.
• Experience with common marketing/communications tools such as email marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp), social media management tools (e.g., Hootsuite), content management systems (e.g., WordPress), and basic design tools (e.g., Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite) preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, meet deadlines, and follow through on details without close supervision.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Requirements
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to grammar, tone, and brand voice.
• Solid organizational skills and comfort managing several projects and stakeholders at once.
• Basic understanding of marketing and communications principles across channels (digital, social, email, PR, and internal communications), rather than deep expertise in one area.
• Ability to take direction, ask clarifying questions, and exercise good judgment on when to escalate issues.
• Collaborative, team-oriented approach and willingness to support colleagues across the department as priorities shift.
• Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
Compensation
$25.00 - $31.25 per hour
This position is non-exempt and eligible for overtime. Final offer will be determined by the candidates experience, skills, and internal pay equity considerations.

Work Environment. This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers and phones.

The Summer Associate will have the opportunity to support our influencer marketing program, paid social campaign management, product marketing and financial education on social media.

Examples topics include, How Financial Institutions Can Leverage Influencers to Activate on Trends, Reaching Gen Z with Financial Education through Influencer Marketing, How Regulated Organizations Can Entertain on Social Media, Social Selling through Creator Partnerships.

The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Responsibilities

Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of a multi-year strategic plan to maximize Navy Federal’s brand awareness on social media platforms and ensure alignment with enterprise and department strategies, with a focus on our influencer marketing program. Help identify opportunities for influencer marketing support and ideate on relevant trends and content formats to leverage. Write campaign intakes for influencer agency to convert into creator briefs and facilitate compliance approval. Assist in the vetting and selection of influencers to partner with for always on and seasonal initiatives. Review influencer concepts, scripts and video drafts for brand safety, authenticity and platform relevance. Aid in the execution of paid social support for creator posts with our media agency. The Sheppard Pratt School - Hunt Valley is a year round special education program located in Baltimore County that provides educational services to students ages five to 21 with complex intellectual and behavioral disabilities, including autism spectrum disorder and other related disorders.

What to expect.

As a School Behavior Specialist you:

Are responsible for the timely completion of functional behavioral assessments and behavioral intervention plans on all students assigned to the caseload.Prepare Positive Behavior Support and Management Plans, train staff in their administration, and reassess and revise plans as needed.Supervise Assistant Behavior Specialist(s) and/or Resource Specialist(s) assigned to program.Work with education and treatment team; serve as a resource to teachers, staff, and family regarding behavior support and management.Depending on credentials and licensure, may work independently or under appropriate supervision by a licensed professional.


What you’ll get from us

At Sheppard Pratt, you will work alongside a multi-disciplined team led by a bold vision to change lives. We offer:

A commitment to professional development, including a comprehensive tuition reimbursement program to support ongoing education and licensure and/or certification preparationComprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits for benefits eligible positions403b retirement matchGenerous paid-time-off for benefit eligible positionsComplimentary Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous mileage reimbursement program

Work requires comprehensive knowledge of behavior analysis, psychiatric terminology and diagnoses, as well as highly developed communication skills, both oral and written- acquired through Master’s degree in applied behavior analysis, behavioral psychology, special education or closely related field of study. BCBA and LBA preferred. Work requires two to three years’ behavior assessment and behavior management experience with children and persons with autism or emotional disturbances and experience with computer software, including Microsoft Excel and data collection and analysis. Work requires frequent exposure (21-50% of the time) to mental strain while working with emotionally disturbed children and adolescents.

At Sheppard Pratt, we are more than just a workplace. We are a community of healthcare professionals who are dedicated to providing hope and healing to individual’s facing life’s challenges. Join us and be a part of a mission that changes lives!

rows.title: Therapeutic Foster Care Social Worker
rows.descriptionText: Overview:  Some careers are just jobs. This one is different. At Foundations for Home and Community, the work you do every day helps create safe, stable, and supportive environments where youth can heal, grow, and build brighter futures. We're a Maryland-based nonprofit organization dedicated to providing therapeutic and specialized foster care services for adolescents and young adults with emotional, behavioral, and family-related challenges. Working alongside foster families, community partners, and mental health professionals, we deliver individualized, strengths-based care that empowers youth to develop resilience, gain independence, and achieve lasting success. Our team is guided by a commitment to compassion, collaboration, and excellence. We believe meaningful change happens when services are family-centered, culturally responsive, and rooted in the communities where the youth we serve live and thrive. Every member of our organization plays a vital role in supporting children, families, and foster parents through every step of their journey. If you're looking for a career where your work has a lasting impact, your contributions are valued, and you can help transform lives every day, you'll find that opportunity at Foundations for Home and Community. Responsibilities: If you’re someone who believes that every child deserves the opportunity to thrive in a safe, supportive family environment, this role was built for you. As a Therapeutic Foster Care Social Worker within our Therapeutic Foster Care program, you’ll provide comprehensive case management services to children, foster families, biological families, and adoptive families—ensuring each child receives the support, advocacy, and coordinated care needed for long-term stability and success. Your work will be relationship-driven, community-based, and essential to helping children and families achieve positive outcomes.What You'll DoAs a Therapeutic Foster Care Social Worker, you'll provide comprehensive case management and family-centered services for children in therapeutic foster care. Day to day, you can expect to:Conduct assessments, complete social histories, develop individualized treatment plans, and monitor client progress through regular home visits, family meetings, and ongoing case management.Provide crisis intervention, emotional support, and education to children, therapeutic foster parents, biological families, and adoptive families while promoting healthy family relationships and placement stability.Coordinate treatment services, facilitate Family Treatment Team Meetings, collaborate with community providers, and advocate for clients by connecting families with needed resources and supports.Maintain timely, accurate documentation, complete required reports, attend court hearings and case-related meetings, and ensure compliance with agency, licensing, and regulatory requirements.Participate in community-based services, including evening visits and an on-call rotation, while delivering responsive, high-quality support that promotes safety, permanency, and positive outcomes for children and families.What to ExpectThis role requires strong clinical judgment, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to effectively manage multiple cases while balancing office responsibilities with community-based services. You'll spend time in clients' homes, schools, community settings, and court proceedings, building meaningful relationships with children, families, foster parents, and community partners. As part of your role, you'll work collaboratively with supervisors, treatment teams, foster families, biological families, and external agencies to ensure children receive comprehensive, family-centered services that promote safety, permanency, and emotional well-being. Evening community visits, crisis response, and participation in an on-call rotation may be required to support the needs of children and families.Supporting Quality & ComplianceYou will ensure all case management activities comply with agency policies, licensing requirements, court expectations, and state regulations governing therapeutic foster care. Through timely documentation, effective communication, accurate assessments, and adherence to reporting deadlines, you'll help maintain high-quality services while supporting positive outcomes for children and families. You'll also contribute to a culture of service excellence by demonstrating professionalism, collaboration, accountability, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Qualifications: We welcome candidates who are passionate about serving children and families and meet the following qualifications:Bachelor's degree in Social Work required; Master's degree in Social Work preferredCurrent LBSW or LMSW licensure requiredMinimum of two years of direct clinical experience working with children, adolescents, adults, and/or familiesPrevious therapeutic foster care, child welfare, and/or case management experience strongly preferredKnowledge of community resources, family systems, crisis intervention, treatment planning, and child developmentStrong organizational, assessment, communication, and relationship-building skillsAbility to work independently in community settings, participate in an on-call rotation, and maintain accurate electronic documentationAbility to attend home visits, court hearings, treatment team meetings, and other community-based appointments as needed

You'll work alongside experienced marketing professionals, engineers, scientists, planners, and water resources specialists to help position RK&K for success in pursuits across the water, wastewater, water resources, environmental planning, and resilience markets.

Support the development of proposals, qualifications packages, presentations, and other client-facing marketing materials. Assist with editing, formatting, and quality control of pursuit documents. Maintain project descriptions, staff resumes, photos, and marketing content within the firm's CRM and marketing systems (Deltek Vantagepoint). Learn about the firm's environmental, water resources, wastewater, and resilience projects and help communicate their value to clients. Collaborate with marketing teammates and technical staff across multiple offices and disciplines.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

As a Data Analyst, your focus will be on collecting, analyzing, and interpreting marketing data to inform strategies and decisions for nonprofit clients across diverse channels. This role will give you the insights you need to develop your expertise in omnichannel marketing, nonprofit fundraising, and analytic toolsets.

Moore is a data-driven constituent experience management (CXM) company achieving accelerated growth for clients through integrated supporter experiences across all platforms, channels, and devices. We are an innovation-led company that is the largest marketing, data, and fundraising company in North America, serving the purpose-driven industry with clients across education, association, political, and commercial sectors.

Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.

Your Impact:

Design and maintain comprehensive reports, dashboards, Key Performance Indicators, and other business tools to inform client strategy. Leverage your coding skills to transform data into useable information that can be presented in Power BI, Excel, and/or other reporting tools. Apply technical skills to deploy automated procedures that drive efficient data ingestion and transformation. Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in complex data sets to drive decisions. Work with internal team members to develop deep knowledge of our clients’ programs to produce more relevant analysis and deepen your analytic abilities. Collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Identify errors in data files or reports and take measures to resolve them. Perform other duties as required. 


Your Profile: 

Bachelor’s degree 1-3 years’ experience in an analytical role Experience in direct marketing preferred Excellent analytical skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to present findings clearly and concisely. Familiarity with fundraising metrics, file segmentation techniques, and direct marketing strategy. Demonstrated, hands-on experience with SQL and Python; a Snowflake environment a plus. Fundamental understanding of relational database design and reporting systems. Intermediate to advanced users of Excel with strong ability in formulas, functions, and pivot tables. Experience with statistical analysis methods and concepts like randomized controlled trials, hypothesis testing, summary statistics, regression, and other explanatory and predictive modeling frameworks. Experience with direct marketing and attribution across multiple channels, including but not limited to direct mail, website, digital advertising, email, and direct response TV. Attention to detail with the intrinsic ability to identify anomalies, discover the root cause, and correct underlying issues

rows.title: Summer Associate Internship (Consumer Lending Experience Management)
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Consumer Loan Experience Management team seeks to increase product engagement, loyalty, and member value throughout the auto lending lifecycle. The Summer Associate will identify best-in-class experiences as our members transition through key touch points from application to loan servicing. The Summer Associate will utilize internal member data analytics reporting combined with vendor data to identify efficiencies and pain points throughout the lending journey. The Summer Associate will help further strategic portfolio goals and initiatives within the lending department while developing strong analytical, collaboration, and critical-thinking skills. 

The Summer Associate will work in a flexible hybrid manner and report to leadership at either our Vienna, VA or Pensacola, FL campus. Responsibilities will include analyzing data and competitive trends to identify areas of opportunity and then creating recommendations to influence decision-makers. Areas of focus may include creating personalized member engagement through segmentation, evaluating the highly competitive consumer lending auto loan landscape, identifying emerging patterns and trends to answer business questions, and developing models and visualizations to improve decision-making efficiency.   

The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Collaborate with functional areas to develop and maintain performance metrics, measurements, methods, and targets  Obtain quantitative and qualitative data of business processes to analyze, determine, and promote data driven decisions  Analyze and evaluate competitor data and industry trends to understand current business unit competitive posture  Design and document dashboards, reports, and thresholds to alert business units to monitor business status and fluctuations  Identify and assess business strategies and opportunities; develop appropriate analytical approaches  Collect and analyze data; synthesize results of analyses, develop and make recommendations and alternatives based on the full spectrum of internal/external considerations  Collaborate with business units and senior management to conduct needs assessment to support organization strategies, tactics, and learning solutions that support business unit objectives  Identify areas of improvement; determine solutions; implement enhancements/changes to improve operations, standards and results  Compile, research and analyze trends in support of projects and initiatives  Manage projects from concept through the planning, analysis, design, testing, implementation, and transition phases  Identify and assess business strategies and opportunities; develop appropriate analytical approaches  Performs other duties as assigned  


Qualifications

Currently pursuing a master’s degree in a related field  Experience with research, analysis, and data manipulation  Experience using data and analytic tools such as: PowerBI, Databricks, SQL, SPSS Modeler, R, or Tableau   Good communication and presentation skills  Comfort working with large datasets and telling stories with data  Ability to work independently and think outside of the box  Strong strategic, critical, and analytical thinking skills  Basic knowledge of financial services/payments a plus  


Additional Information

Hours: 

Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM 


Locations: 

820 Follin Lane, Vienna, VA 22180 5510 Heritage Oaks Drive, Pensacola, FL 32526 


About Us

The team is responsible for campaign measurement, reporting, business intelligence, forecasting, customer analytics, and strategic research that help Navy Federal understand marketing performance, member behavior, and business outcomes. The Summer Associate will work alongside analysts and business intelligence professionals on real-world business problems, gaining exposure to marketing analytics, reporting automation, data visualization, and strategic analysis. The role will involve analyzing large datasets, developing insights, creating presentations for leadership, and supporting initiatives that help answer key business questions.

rows.title: Data Annotator - Hybrid
rows.descriptionText:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About This Role

Produce high-fidelity annotations on imagery and video used to train and evaluate machine learning models. Annotators work to a defined ontology and labeling specification, meet project quality and throughput targets, and operate inside the designated annotation environment for each program. Assignments rotate across projects, modalities, and customers as program needs change.

Key Responsibilities

Label static imagery and video across a range of sensor types, image qualities, and scene conditions, including both real-world and synthetic data.Produce 2D bounding boxes, instance and semantic segmentation masks, and keypoint annotations to project specification.Produce oriented and rotated bounding boxes where scene geometry requires them.Produce 3D and 6 degrees-of-freedom pose, orientation, and scale annotations on projects that require them.Produce multi-object tracking annotations, maintaining consistent object identity across full sequences — through occlusion, frame exit and re-entry, scale change, and camera or platform motion.Review, correct, and accept or reject model-assisted and pre-labeled output; report systematic pre-label failure modes rather than silently correcting the same error frame by frame.Work strictly to the project ontology and guidelines; escalate ambiguous or out-of-ontology objects rather than guessing.Meet assigned accuracy and throughput targets, and hold that standard consistently across large batches.Complete rework promptly from QA feedback, applying the correction to comparable cases in the same batch.Log edge cases and recurring ambiguities so they can be adjudicated and folded into the guidelines.Follow all customer data-handling, confidentiality, and information security requirements for the assigned project, and keep required training current.

Must-Have Qualifications

1+ years of image or video annotation experience, or equivalent precision work in a quality-managed production environment.Working familiarity with at least one professional annotation platform (for example CVAT, V7 Darwin, Labelbox, Scale, or comparable).Practical understanding of bounding boxes, segmentation masks, keypoints, and object tracking — and of what makes each one correct rather than merely present.Strong visual attention to detail and the discipline to hold a standard across tens of thousands of frames.Ability to follow written labeling guidelines exactly, and to ask precise questions when they are silent on a case.Comfortable working in remote-desktop or browser-based environments.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience across multiple annotation modalities rather than a single task type.Experience with aerial, overhead, satellite, or thermal/IR imagery.Experience with long-form video and tracking work.Experience reviewing model-assisted pre-labels in a human-in-the-loop pipeline.Prior work on government or regulated-industry programs.

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $42,000 to $62.500 annually, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Program eligibility: Some programs require eligibility for a government background investigation or credentialing. Assignment to those programs is contingent on meeting those requirements.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at verifyjoboffer@innodata.com and consider reporting it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

rows.title: Research Technician II / III - PTR-BioImage Analysis
rows.descriptionText:
Primary Work Address: 19700 Helix Drive, Ashburn, VA, 20147

Current HHMI Employees, click here to apply via your Workday account.

The Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Janelia Research Campus is a pioneering research center in Ashburn, Virginia, where scientists pursue fundamental questions in the life sciences. Our integrated teams of biologists, computational scientists, and tool-builders innovate research practices and technologies to solve biology’s deepest mysteries. HHMI launched Janelia in 2006, establishing an intellectually enriching environment for scientists to do creative, collaborative, hands-on work. We share our methods, results, and tools with the scientific community.

About The Role

The PTR-BioImage analysis team within Project Technical Resources (PTR) is seeking a full-time technician to work on annotation and image analysis projects in collaboration with Team Projects, laboratories, and computational groups. The selected individual will work closely with the team manager and other scientists to develop and implement procedures to accomplish research goals. This job is ideal for someone who likes working with images and enjoys manual annotation, as well as establishing standard protocols and interacting with peers and collaborators. Our current work includes voxel-level segmentation of 3D microscopy volumes, segmentation of lightsheet images of expanded tissues, cell tracking in 4D light microscopy videos, and behavioral labeling from animal experimental video. The combination of projects and emphasis changes over time, requiring agile adaptation to specific requirements. Annotations typically serve as ground truth for automated image processing pipelines established for AI@HHMI projects, and in some cases are used to answer biological questions directly. Examples of related work can be explored at the BioImage Analysis page.

This position will be filled at Research Technician level II or III depending on the candidate’s experience.

Please include a cover letter and resume with your application.

What We Provide

On-the-job training on current tools, protocols, and techniquesCompetitive compensation with comprehensive health and welfare benefitsAmenities that enhance work-life balance such as on-site childcare, a free gym, social and dining spaces, convenient shuttle bus service from the Washington D.C. metro area, on-campus housing, and options for education assistanceA diverse team looking forward to exploring how your unique background, talents, and interests could contribute to PTR's ability to support science at Janelia 

What You'll Do

Gain in-depth knowledge of commercial and custom annotation softwareCollect relevant data from multidimensional images and videos Review and correct automatically or manually generated annotations Perform quality control on large datasets, including screening work produced by other team members Provide feedback on image quality, software performance, and annotation challenges Report biological observations arising from the data Communicate effectively with the team manager, project leads, researchers, and support groups at Janelia Prepare datasets for annotation, contribute to protocol development and documentation, and serve as a point of contact for collaborating researchers 

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree and a minimum of two years of experience in cellular biology, neuroscience, or related field Demonstrated proficiency with computers Ability to mentally visualize complex three-dimensional structures Ability to perform detailed, repetitive work while sustaining close attention Ability to understand and apply written guidelines consistently Good organizational skills Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate efficiently with team members and collaborators Work experience in a team-oriented environment and skills to be a good team player Interest in engaging in ground-breaking research in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Demonstrated ability to work independently and to recognize when a case falls outside established standards Experience contributing to written protocols or training other team members Candidates with four or more years of experience in image annotation, segmentation, microscopy, or a closely related area may be considered for Research Technician III level 

Physical Requirements

Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet). Work may involve possible exposure to malodorous vapors, low dose radiation, contamination by toxic chemicals and acids and presence of carcinogenic substances or other hazardous materials. This position also requires good color vision, the ability to visualize in 3D, the ability to sit for several hours at a computer (with breaks), and fine motor skills.

Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.

Please Note:

This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Hiring Pay Range

Research Technician II: $45,440.00 - $56,800.00

Research Technician III: $53,840.00 - $67,300.00

Pay Type:

Salary

The posted range reflects HHMI’s good faith estimate of the anticipated hiring salary range for this role at the time of posting. Actual hiring compensation is determined by a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

Compensation And Benefits

Our employees are compensated from a total rewards perspective in many ways for their contributions to our mission, including competitive pay, exceptional health benefits, retirement plans, time off, and a range of recognition and wellness programs. Visit our Benefits at HHMI site to learn more.

HHMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Join the team redefining credit analytics through AI! At Capital One, our credit policies are powered by data, and our future is driven by the transformative potential of AI. We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to act as a pioneer in our AI tooling space, maximizing the impact of large language models and generative technologies within Card analytics. You won’t just be using AI; you’ll be the architect of how our organization adopts it, establishing the frameworks for how we integrate tools like Gemini, Claude, and our AI Platform into the daily workflows of our analysts. As a trailblazer on this front, you will be responsible for setting the standard for AI usage and disseminating breakthrough learnings across the department.

This role blends product vision with hands-on execution. Beyond defining the roadmap for our next generation of credit tools, you will actively drive their development - gathering deep user context, leveraging Claude to engineer new workflows, and partnering with Business Analysts to ensure seamless enterprise adoption. Our team currently manages a sophisticated suite of tools that predict account performance and pinpoint risky populations, and your mission is to push these boundaries further. You will identify and operationalize untapped use cases that keep our analytical ecosystem streamlined, thorough, and ahead of the curve.

We are looking for a strong communicator with a rigorous analytical mindset and a genuine interest in emerging technology. While deep technical expertise is not required, you must possess the technical curiosity to navigate our data environments and the ingenuity to experiment with new AI capabilities as they are released. If you are a trailblazer eager to shape the future of analytics, we want you to help us build what’s next.

rows.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
We are the nonprofit behind .ORG. We provide safe and trusted online homes for anyone working to make a positive impact in the world. As a champion for privacy and security, we also foster collaboration among the Internet community to promote and protect a free and open Internet that serves the public interest. We are seeking a talented Marketing and Communications Coodinator to join our team!
The Marketing and Communications Coordinator is a generalist role that supports the day-to-day execution of Public Interest Registry's marketing and communications programs. Rather than specializing in a single channel, this position works across marketing, communications, and administrative functions to keep existing M&C programs and initiatives running smoothly — from content development and campaign support to internal communications, reporting, and event planning and support. This role is a strong fit for someone early in their marketing/communications career who wants broad, hands-on exposure across the discipline and is looking to grow into a more specialized or managerial role over time.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Support the Senior Director, Marketing and Communications and the broader M&C team in the day-to-day execution of existing marketing and communications programs and initiatives.
• Assist with the development and scheduling of content across digital, social, email marketing, blogs, and web channels, ensuring consistency with PIR's brand voice and style guidelines. Specifically, as it relates to both PIR and NetBeacon’s social media platforms. 
• Help maintain the team's editorial and campaign calendars, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and approvals across multiple concurrent projects.
• Draft, proofread, and format written materials such as newsletters, web copy, social posts, presentations, talking points, and internal communications.
• Serve as the primary intake point for internal requests, systematically organizing and prioritizing communication needs from various teams across the organization.
• Coordinate logistics for M&C-supported events, webinars, and sponsorships, including scheduling, vendor communication, and occasional on-site [KR1.1]or virtual support.
• Support the Digital Marketing Manager in compiling performance data and preparing regular reports on marketing metrics to inform ongoing campaigns.
• Maintain the department's digital asset library, media lists, and distribution lists, and help ensure marketing/communications materials are current and organized.
• Support internal communications efforts, including employee updates and materials that help align staff with marketing and communications initiatives.
• Assist with vendor and agency coordination (e.g., design, printing, media monitoring, and other outside partners) under the guidance of the Senior Director.
• Provide general administrative and project support to the Marketing and Communications team as needed, including invoice processing.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support the goals of the Marketing and Communications team.
Supervision Received and Exercised
Position works under the direct supervision of the Senior Director, Marketing and Communications. This position does not have supervisory responsibility for other staff.
Minimum Education and Experience Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
• 2-4 years of professional experience spanning marketing and/or communications functions (e.g., content, social media, digital marketing, PR, internal communications, or events); breadth across areas is valued over depth in a single specialty.
• Experience with common marketing/communications tools such as email marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp), social media management tools (e.g., Hootsuite), content management systems (e.g., WordPress), and basic design tools (e.g., Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite) preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, meet deadlines, and follow through on details without close supervision.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Requirements
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to grammar, tone, and brand voice.
• Solid organizational skills and comfort managing several projects and stakeholders at once.
• Basic understanding of marketing and communications principles across channels (digital, social, email, PR, and internal communications), rather than deep expertise in one area.
• Ability to take direction, ask clarifying questions, and exercise good judgment on when to escalate issues.
• Collaborative, team-oriented approach and willingness to support colleagues across the department as priorities shift.
• Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
Compensation
$25.00 - $31.25 per hour
This position is non-exempt and eligible for overtime. Final offer will be determined by the candidates experience, skills, and internal pay equity considerations.

This position supports the Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages (NWPB) division as a Sales Analytics Analyst dedicated to supporting the Category Strategy team. In addition to that, this role supports category presentations that are shared amongst the local & global leadership teams.

rows.title: Client Support Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Client Support Specialist

About This Role

As a Remote Client Support Specialist, you will provide relationship-driven support for Community Financial Institutions partners, their merchants, and internal teams across approved phone, email, and case-management channels. You will research service requests, troubleshoot account and technical issues, coordinate with specialized teams, and provide clear follow-up. Your work helps protect financial institution relationships while delivering accurate, timely, and compliant support.

What You'll Do

Serve as a primary service contact for Community Financial Institutions partners; credit unions, merchants, Business Consultants, Account Executives, Relationship Managers, and internal stakeholders through inbound and outbound calls, email, Client360 Merchant, InquiryPoint, and approved case-management channels.Own service inquiries from intake through closure by authenticating callers, clarifying needs, assessing urgency, documenting case details, coordinating with the correct team, providing status updates, and confirming next steps.Research and resolve account maintenance, billing, funding, transaction, equipment, portal access, chargeback, and merchant servicing questions within assigned authority and approved procedures.Troubleshoot technical and product-related issues for terminals, point-of-sale devices, Clover, CardConnect, CardPointe, and other merchant-service platforms by following documented support paths and escalation requirements.Triage requests by severity, partner or merchant impact, aging, and service-level expectations while escalating stalled, high-risk, high-impact, or time-sensitive matters through the defined Community Financial Institutions support path.Maintain complete case notes that include the issue, research completed, systems reviewed, actions taken, dependencies, owner, promised follow-up, and next update date.Identify repeat contacts, routing issues, aging work, process gaps, and recurring client pain points, then share observations that can improve procedures, training, queue design, first-contact resolution, and partner experience.Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience You'll Need To Have

2+ years of experience in customer-facing support within a call center, financial services, banking, payments, merchant services, or comparable support environment.2+ years of experience managing customer requests through phone, email, and case-management channels while maintaining accurate documentation, ownership, and follow-up commitments.Experience researching account, billing, transaction, funding, equipment, or technical support questions using documented procedures and approved knowledge-management resources.Ability to manage a steady flow of calls, emails, and cases while prioritizing competing needs, meeting service expectations, and escalating issues within documented authority.Ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with clients, merchants, financial institution partners, and internal teams while explaining next steps, status updates, and confirmed information.Experience using multiple business systems, customer relationship management tools, case-tracking tools, telephony tools, or merchant-support platforms.High school diploma or higher, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

Experience supporting community banks, credit unions, referral channels, agent channels, or relationship-based financial institution service models.Working knowledge of merchant acquiring operations, including boarding, billing, pricing, funding, settlement, account maintenance, chargebacks, risk, underwriting, collections, and equipment lifecycle support.Experience with Clover, CardPointe, CardConnect, Client360, InquiryPoint, FDPOS, Commerce Control, BusinessTrack, or similar merchant-service platforms.Experience creating or validating process documentation, job aids, knowledge articles, case timelines, or training materials.

How You'll Work

This role is remote Monday through Friday.This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.You will work on an assigned schedule between the hours of 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. EST.

Sponsorship

You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

Benefits At Fiserv

Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being.Paid holidays and generous time away policies.No-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs.Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards.Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network.Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities.Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one.Retirement planning including 401k match and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan.Tuition assistance and reimbursement program.Paid parental and military leave.

Salary Range

$39,000.00-$53,000.00

These pay ranges apply to employees in Maryland. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ. Certain Positions are Commissions eligible.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Flights Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. While specific job responsibilities will vary rotations and responsibilities may include:

Core Business

Project Development – estimating, preconstruction, budgetingProject Delivery – manage a trade, experience different life cycles of a projectManage and drive projects that will create a competitive advantage for the organization

Client & Business Development

Develop stakeholder engagement plans for projects across the countryWork with project teams to deploy partnering programs and ensure the programs are effective as deployedScreen potential business deals by analyzing market strategies, deal requirements, potential, and financials; evaluating options; resolving internal priorities; recommending pursuitsLeverage data to actively identify and pursue new business opportunitiesWork closely with Marketing on crafting the right proposal for each project and client

Strategy & Business

Develop creative solutions to challenges in collaboration with leaders across the companySupport company leadership in developing strategies in key functional domains and prioritizing investments with the best returnManage the development and delivery of strategic projects to realize the return on the investments we makeEngage our people across the organization to foster a culture of innovationManage and present business unit financials and KPIsConduct market research and analysisAssist in G&A budgeting and forecastingProvide cost-effective risk management and insurance solutions that mitigate operational risk and contribute to competitive advantage and profitability

As a Member Of The Clark Team, You Will Be An Ambassador For Our Business And Culture. In Addition To The Core Job Functions You Will Learn, You Will Be Expected To

Drive Stakeholder Success: Exceed our clients’ and partners’ expectations by anticipating their needs, desires, and goals.Foster Business Growth: Building meaningful industry connections to bring potential business opportunities to Clark leadership.Recruit the Next Generation of Talent: Embrace our "All team members are recruiters" mindset by building and leveraging relationships to help attract and recruit top talent to Clark.

Basic Qualifications

Pursuing an undergraduate degree (or equivalent) or a master's degree, in business, finance, commerce, economics, or a related field, with an expected graduation in either 2026 or 2026Interest and passion for the building and/or construction industry

What a Successful Candidate Looks Like

We look for individuals who embody these core principles:

Enthusiasm & Drive: Be punctual and dedicated, staying until work is done. Arrive early for meetings and events. Be a proactive team player – ask how you can help and be present. Take initiative, represent the company professionally (dress, demeanor), and build trust with your team, clients, and stakeholders. Proactively seek ways to contribute to team success, and always maintain a positive attitude.Delivery & Performance: Reliably meet the expectations of your role and commitments. Understand and follow Clark's standard procedures. Take on new responsibilities, dig into the details, and bring solutions to problems. Take ownership, be accountable, and demonstrate responsiveness with a sense of urgency.Learning & Growth: Immerse yourself in Clark's culture, your team, and your community. Fulfill Clark Corporate University learning requirements. Be engaged, accountable, and self-directed in your learning – be curious! Continuously build your technical expertise and grow your business acumen.

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role: This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.

Your Work Environment: You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines.

A Drug Free Workplace: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment fitness for duty screening is required, and random fitness for duty tests of employees are conducted quarterly.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Flights Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology.

The Performance Marketing - Flight Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this Role, you’ll get to: be heavily involved in growing our Flights business.

Core functions will be:

Data analysis: Analyze massive amounts of data generated in experiments, build dashboards and make actionable recommendations Pricing: Experiment with different pricing frameworks across channels to grow the businessPerformance marketing: Scale our performance marketing channels (e.g., metasearch, ads etc.)Strategy: Work with cross-functional stakeholders to arrive at investment plan for markets and channels

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Bachelor’s Degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject (computer science, mathematics, engineering, statistics or science)Ability to communicate fluently and succinctly in EnglishGood numerical reasoning skillsStrong problem-solving skillsProficiency in Excel and SQLIntellectual curiosity

It’s Great if you Have:

Exposure to one or more data analysis packages or databases, e.g., SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQL, TableauExperience in digital marketingExperience in travel sector (specifically flights)
