rows.title: Senior Financial Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is seeking a highly motivated and strategic Senior Financial Analyst to join our Corporate Finance Business Partnerships team as a Finance Business Partner supporting enterprise G&A functions! In this highly visible role, you will help steward payroll and G&A expenses, translate executive and functional priorities into financial plans, and provide trusted, data-driven insights to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. You will support budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, monthly reporting, and strategic analysis across areas including headcount, professional fees, business matters, settlements, insurance, software, and other corporate costs. This role operates with meaningful autonomy and judgment. Success requires a detail-oriented self-starter who can independently frame problems, build scalable financial mechanisms, operate at depth, and communicate clear recommendations in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

What You’ll Do

Serve as a Finance Business Partner for enterprise G&A functions, providing trusted, data-driven financial partnership and guidance to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.Steward payroll and G&A expenses across the supported functions, with ownership of key performance indicators and mechanisms that drive accountability to financial targets.Translate business strategies and executive priorities into financial plans, tradeoffs, and actionable recommendations, while proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and dependencies.Own and maintain detailed financial models for headcount and payroll, professional fees, business matters, settlements, insurance, software, and other corporate expenses.Support target setting and annual, quarterly, and rolling forecast processes by developing assumptions, evaluating business drivers, and influencing prioritization through clear financial insights.Lead monthly close and management reporting activities, including variance analysis, accrual support, forecast updates, and preparation of accurate, timely, and decision-relevant executive summaries.Create inspection mechanisms for budgets, forecasts, headcount, and actual results to improve forecast accuracy, financial visibility, data quality, and accountability to plan.Partner with functional stakeholders to improve planning and reporting across key spend categories, including professional services, business matters, settlements, insurance, and other corporate expenses.Provide ad hoc financial analysis and decision support for strategic initiatives, investment requests, cost optimization opportunities, and organizational changes. Develop standardized reporting and dashboards that translate complex financial data into actionable insights and ensure consistent communication with business partners and stakeholders.Drive continuous improvement and automation across reporting structures, close processes, governance, and planning mechanisms to increase efficiency and scalability.Extract, reconcile, and analyze data from central systems and databases using tools such as Hyperion SmartView, Oracle ERP, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.3+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Finance Business Partnering, Accounting, or a related analytical role, with an understanding of GAAP and financial statements.Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills, including demonstrated experience building complex models from the ground up and working with large, detailed datasets.Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables, scenario modeling, and large-data analysis; strong PowerPoint and data visualization skills.Experience with budgeting, forecasting, headcount and payroll analysis, key performance indicators, variance analysis, and financial controls.Confidence interacting with senior business leaders and the ability to distill complex analyses into clear, concise insights and recommendations for senior and executive audiences.Strong influencing, written, and verbal communication skills, with sound business judgment and the ability to build effective working relationships and drive data-backed decisions.Ability to independently navigate ambiguity by framing problems, setting priorities, and driving analytical work forward in the absence of established templates or clear precedent.

Bonus

MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced degree or certification.Experience supporting executive or corporate functions.Familiarity with an e-commerce or retail business model.Experience with Hyperion SmartView, Oracle ERP, Tableau, SQL, or similar financial and analytical tools.Experience improving or automating financial reporting and planning processes.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. rows.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Initiatives Support
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at one of our corporate offices in McLean, VA or Memphis, TN

This is your chance to be part of an in-house Brand Performance Support (BPS) team that delivers responsive and effective support to Hotel Leaders across over 9,000 hotels through close collaboration with many parts of the business. As the Senior Director of Enterprise Initiatives Support (EIS) reporting to the Vice President of Brand Performance Support, you will be responsible for leading the support of key enterprise-wide initiatives and programs through driving maximum hotel-level compliance, participation and utilization.

When initiatives and programs are supported through EIS, you and your team will collaborate with many other stakeholders while also driving participation and utilization through innovation, technology, data-driven decision making, and automation. You will balance execution with strategic thought leadership, building strong partnerships across the enterprise to continuously evolve how BPS supports critical enterprise-wide initiatives and programs that drive hotel performance.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Oversee BPS-led strategies and efforts to support Stay Score improvement through both targeted programs and “always on” resources.Oversee Digital Stay Experience strategies and support efforts to ensure hotel-level engagement and participation with critical Digital tools such as Guest Messaging (Kipsu), Digital Key, and Connected Room.Oversee the BPS support of Hilton Commercial enterprise-wide initiatives/programs to ensure high levels of hotel compliance, participation, and utilization to drive maximum performance success.Oversee the BPS support of operational enterprise-wide initiatives/programs to drive high levels of hotel compliance, participation, and utilization to ensure maximum success.Executive level communications to share current action status, progress, and impact, both written and verbal, across Brand Management Americas (BMA) and Hilton stakeholder audiences.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Work closely with other BPS/BMA functional leaders to ensure awareness and education of the enterprise initiatives being supported.Leverage BPS support channels to ensure a wholistic support approach to driving participation and utilization levels of enterprise initiatives.Partner closely with the Customer Promise team to ensure BPS support efforts are aligned appropriately across core CP strategic initiatives.Partner closely with Commercial leaders to ensure BPS support efforts are aligned appropriately across the Commercial initiatives that need maximum hotel-level participation to be successful.Partner closely with key Hilton stakeholders related to new enterprise initiatives to ensure all necessary support has been identified – before, during, and after the launch of the initiative.Partner with BMA leaders to surface trending topics and hotel/owner friction points that need to be addressed through stronger program support.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Experience working with Hilton Brands.Experience in project management and customer experience strategy.Knowledge of Salesforce CRM, BOSS, and related support technologies.Experience in managing vendor relationships and enterprise partnerships.Bachelor's Degree in Business, Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

The pay range for this role is $160,000 – $210,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

rows.title: Content Optimization Specialist - Ready to Wear

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The primary responsibility of the PDP Content Specialist will be to ensure that all PDPs (Product Description Pages) for a category of business are optimized and meet/exceed Macys.com content standards. This role will be responsible for optimizing product images, ensuring copy meets requirements and that selling tools such as size charts and product videos, are available on all relevant product pages. The Content Specialist will support an offshore team onboarding new products while also ensuring all existing pages on site are optimized to drive conversion. A successful candidate will be detail oriented, highly organized, process driven and have strong communication skills. This role reports to the Senior Manager - PDP Optimization.

What You Will Do

Serve as a subject matter expert on site standards and opportunities for improvements based on competitive analysis.Provide training, coaching, and supporting materials to merchants and business partners on PDP standards, optimization best practices, and customer experience improvements to drive content quality and adoption.Leverage internal reporting, competitive analysis, and performance analytics to identify content gaps, prioritize optimization opportunities, and partner with merchants to enrich product content and improve PDP health.Coach and support the offshore team on workflows, quality standards, and content guidelines to drive consistent execution and high-quality PDP creation across more than 100K products annually.Check quality & technical specifications of images and perform light retouching as needed – including, but not limited to resizing, cropping, color matching, corrections, etc. Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

1-2 years related experienceProfessional experience in retail, site merchandising, and/or marketingStrong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to analyze data, create reporting, and communicate insights effectively.Experience utilizing content management, digital asset management, and image editing tools to support product content and imagery workflowsStrong communication and collaboration skillsAbility to stay on top of workload in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining high standardsAbility to problem solve and think creatively, strategically and technicallyDemonstrates a growth mindset with the ability to adapt quickly, embrace change, and continuously learn new processes and technologies.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. 

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

rows.title: Financial Analyst I
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Overview of the role 

We are seeking a dynamic, analytical person for the West Elm’s Brand Finance division. This position is responsible for providing financial, analytical, and business decision support for short-term and long-term planning. An ideal candidate will bring financial experience, analytical capabilities, an eagerness to learn and collaborate, and an ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. This position reports into the Senior Manager of Brand Finance.

Responsibilities


Develop annual budget and monthly forecast across assigned business channels, including shipping income and expenses, non-merchandise product costs and vendor/sourcing compliance-related expensesManage month-end close process including journal entries, expense accruals, and variance analysis to reconcile actual results against forecastOwn operating and general expense analysis and forecasting across assigned expense categoriesOwn recurring financial reporting and KPI packages (quarterly, monthly, and weekly) for assigned areas of the businessCreate, prepare and continuously enhance key reporting packages for various brand partners to provide visibility into financial performance and driversIdentify and analyze ad hoc business issues, including vendor and contract-related initiatives, and collaborate with key partners across the organization to actively influence brand P&L performanceDevelop and maintain strong working relationships with business partners, communicating effectively in a variety of settings and ensuring partners are well informed and aligned with the brand's financial goalsSupport broader brand finance team by developing new tools to enhance financial modeling and analytics across the businessDevelop Powerpoint presentations for budget review, ad hoc brand initiatives, etc.


Criteria


Love to work collaboratively in a group, you have an innate willingness to dig in and contribute with your teamAre driven and motivated by the possibilities aheadAre a self-starter who appreciates challenges and takes initiative to improve the status quoAre a true business owner; comfortable with decision making and calculated risk taking for the benefit of your businessThink innovation is critical in a business environment and support others in creative thinkingPride yourself on the quality of work and are a stickler for the detailsChallenge yourself and others to grow1-4 years of experience in corporate finance, banking, accounting, planning, or similar technical analytical roleBachelor’s degree required, preferably in a quantitative field (finance, economics, business)Strong analytical skills – extensive experience with Excel building financial models, forecasts and analysis from scratch Creative problem solving and strategic thinking skills – able to delve into business issues and large amounts of data to form insights and recommendations.Comfortable managing multiple projects with a high degree of ambiguity in a fast-paced setting. Results oriented – strong sense of urgency and excellent follow through.Solid interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills; ability to collaborate with non-financial partners and present a cohesive story to senior leadersUnderstanding of financial analysis concepts as well as a solid knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)Working knowledge of standard financial applications preferred: Hyperion (SmartView and Essbase), Oracle ERP, or equivalentAbility to work onsite in the Brooklyn office Monday - Thursday and work remotely on Fridays.


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits Tax-free commuter benefits A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning 


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-development Advisor (Mentor) program Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

The expected starting pay range for this position is $65,000-$78,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

rows.title: Senior Director / Vice President, Customer Services Strategy & Transformation
rows.descriptionText:
Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and ~34,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent is seeking a Senior Director / Vice President to shape and lead the next evolution of its global Customer Services organization. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, this leader will partner with Customer Success, Customer Support, Professional Services, and Learning & Development leaders to evolve strategy and operating models, scale customer outcomes, and drive operational excellence.

AI is reshaping how SaaS companies serve customers and operate at scale. This is a business transformation leadership role—not solely an AI, technology, or strategy role. You will redesign how people, AI agents, digital experiences, data, and technology work together to create customer and business value. You will also lead Customer Services through Cvent’s M&A lifecycle, partnering across the company from due diligence through integration and value realization.

Shape and transform Customer Services

Define and execute the global organization’s long-term strategy and operating model with the Chief Customer Officer and leadership team. Turn priorities into transformation roadmaps, capabilities, and measurable outcomes; design how people, AI, digital experiences, data, technology, and processes work together at scale. Evolve processes, systems, analytics, planning, and management mechanisms; establish an operating system that makes customer outcomes, business and financial performance, capacity, productivity, and transformation progress visible. Improve operations through simplification, standardization, automation, and process redesign. 

Build for an agentic future

Lead the Customer Services AI, automation, and agentic transformation agenda; redesign workflows and customer journeys around people and AI. Define the right mix of human-led, digital, self-service, and agent-led interactions by customer segment and journey. Partner with Product and Technology on scalable AI, data, technology, and platform capabilities. Prioritize opportunities by customer value, business impact, feasibility, economics, and risk; measure adoption, productivity, quality, customer experience, and financial impact. 

Evolve the Customer Services functions

Advise Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, and Learning & Development leaders on transformation and connect their strategies into a cohesive customer journey. Evolve Customer Success models for scalable adoption, outcomes, value realization, retention, and growth; partner with Professional Services on strategy, portfolio, delivery and resource models, economics, and AI-enabled delivery. Help Support deliver more intelligent, proactive, automated, and self-service experiences while retaining high-value human engagement. Evolve customer and employee learning for how AI changes knowledge creation, discovery, consumption, and application. 

Lead Customer Services M&A and cross-functional execution

Lead Customer Services from M&A due diligence through integration and value realization. Assess acquired customers, organizations, talent, operating and service models, processes, technology, economics, opportunities, and risks. Define the target operating model and integration strategy while protecting customer relationships, retention, and business continuity. Partner on organizational integration, customer migration, systems, data, services, and ways of working; build repeatable capabilities and track synergies, risks, milestones, and value. Serve as a senior Customer Services leader and trusted partner to the Chief Customer Officer. Align senior stakeholders and lead execution across Sales, Marketing, Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Corporate Development, and other teams—connecting Customer Services priorities to Cvent’s growth strategy, commercial model, product roadmap, and technology investments. 



Physical Demands

We are not able to offer sponsorship for this position

12+ years of progressive leadership in Customer Services, operations, strategy, transformation, or related fields, preferably in global SaaS or technology. A record of leading large, complex, globally distributed organizations, including large teams and leaders of leaders, with meaningful accountability for revenue, services revenue, retention, budgets, or other material business outcomes. Operational leadership and transformation experience: evolving operating models, processes, systems, metrics, planning, and organizational capabilities while maintaining customer, operational, and financial performance. Strong knowledge of SaaS post-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, customer education, or operations; experience with workforce and capacity planning, productivity, forecasting, business planning, performance management, and investment prioritization at scale. Strong understanding of AI, generative AI, agentic technologies, and automation, with the ability to apply them to operating models, customer experience, workforce strategy, and economics. Leadership experience in M&A due diligence, integration, or post-merger transformation. Strong business and financial acumen, analytical skills, executive communication, and ability to turn data into measurable outcomes, influence senior leaders, and lead change across organizational boundaries. A record of attracting, developing, and leading high-performing teams and senior leaders. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree preferred. 

What Will Set You Apart

Leading a scaled Customer Services, post-sales, or customer operations organization, including hundreds of employees and material revenue, retention, services, or financial outcomes. Combining operational leadership with hands-on delivery of large-scale transformation and AI-enabled operating model redesign. Evolving Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, or Learning in a scaled SaaS environment; integrating acquired SaaS or technology businesses into a global operating model. Bringing strategic thinking, operational depth, and leadership at scale to turn a vision for complex organizations into sustained execution and measurable results.

rows.title: Director, Branded Residential Marketing & Sales Experience
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of an in-house Brands team of industry experts in the domains of hospitality, brand management, innovation, food and beverage, wellness, owner relations, and more, for all of Hilton's unique brands! As a Director, Branded Residential Marketing & Sales Experience, you will support the team that leads our brands with the steadfast goal of strengthening and growing the Hilton portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President, Branded Residential by Hilton, you will support the Branded Residential team by leading the marketing and sales experience strategy for Hilton's branded residential portfolio and oversee account management responsibilities for a portfolio of projects. You will apply consumer insights, residential buyer expectations, and business insights to develop and refine positioning, sales narratives, launch tools, owner and developer materials, and resident-facing experiences that support deal flow, pre-sales, and a consistent luxury experience across projects. You will also coordinate marketing assets, project collateral, approval workflows, and research that bring Hilton's residential brand experience to life across developer, sales, owner, and resident touchpoints.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead residential marketing and sales experience strategy across Hilton's branded residential portfolio, shaping positioning, audience definition, brand narratives, and sales enablement tools in service of driving business results.Support project-level sales narratives, sales gallery content, launch toolkits, presentation templates, owner benefit messaging, and developer-ready collateral.Handle day-to-day activities with agency partners to gather inputs, route feedback, track revisions, and support timely delivery of creative and marketing assets through coordination of reviews and approvals for residential marketing materials with internal and external agency partners.Use customer insights, market research, analytics, and project feedback to inform buyer journeys, develop engaging creative, and improve the effectiveness of residential marketing executions.Monitor project milestones, asset needs, feedback, and deadlines to ensure residential marketing deliverables are completed on time and aligned with business priorities.Partner with media, social media, public relations, and agency teams to support integrated residential launch strategies and locally relevant sales materials.Monitor sales experience performance, lead generation trends, collateral usage, and opportunities for improvement in a test-and-learn environment.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Build partnerships across all levels and functions within the Hilton Enterprise, including Brand, Development, AD&C, Commercial Services, Legal, Operations, Marketing & Communications across all regional teams.Build strong relationships with owners, developers, and external partners to strengthen Hilton's reputation as a premier branded residential partner.Work with external agencies, developers, and sales teams to guide marketing and collateral development, review creative concepts, and support project launch needs.Partner with Marketing Centers of Excellence and agencies of record to develop consistent, high-impact residential storytelling across channels and audiences that achieve brand alignment.Coordinate with project stakeholders to keep materials current, approved, and accessible for developer, sales, and internal team use.Work with all facets of the Global Branded Residential team to develop and enhance product guidelines and standards.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Set the global integrated residential marketing and sales experience strategy, including audience journeys, sales narratives, and project launch guidance and lead portfolio wide initiatives.Sales gallery and buyer journey content, including scripts, presentation materials, owner benefit messaging, and experience touchpoints.Developer-facing launch toolkits, collateral templates, and residential marketing approval guidance. Residential marketing project trackers, asset lists, launch calendars, and approval timelines.Performance insights and recommendations tied to sales experience, marketing effectiveness, and residential buyer engagement.Coordination and activation of marketing and sales immersions, both virtually and in person.Engaging with project leads to track marketing status and sales monthly performance to support financial forecasting.Activating contractual and approved marketing initiatives to support individual projects.Primary responsibility for projects in assigned global regions and consultative support of all regions.Global partnership and event development to advance residential portfolio visibility and enhance residential sales and owner experiences.

Job Description

About the Team 

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating assortment strategies based on analyzing sales and trend. Our job blends creativity, analytics, and marketing.

About The Role

In the Merchandise Coordinator role, you will work closely with a very passionate and collaborative group of team members. The Merchandise Coordinator will provide support and coordination for the Associate/Assistant Buyer and Buyer in specified merchandise categories for all channels of sales. We strive for operational excellence while developing best in class merchandising strategies each season.

Responsibilities


Own sample management – communicating and partnering with our photo and warehouse teams to track sample positions Work in Merchandise Buyer systems to set up and maintain all SKUsEnter and maintain all price/cost changes for relevant categoriesPrepare reporting as directed and assist Assistant Buyers with business opportunitiesMaintaining data accuracy and integrity


Criteria


BA/BS degree requiredPrevious experience in Merchandising preferredAbility to handle multiple priorities, shifting tasks and timelineAbility to work autonomously, strong decision making skills with good judgementStrong written and verbal communication to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teamsDetail-oriented – takes the appropriate time to complete tasks and reviews work to ensure accuracyAbility to work in a fast pace, often changing environmentProficient in Microsoft Office (Excel/Word/PowerPoint); ability to create pivot tables and experience with advanced formulas such as VLOOKUP a plusAbility to transport samples including: lifting, moving, carrying objects up to 50 pounds on a limited basisNote: Occasional travel may be required within the bay area for photo shoots and floor sets.


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

A generous discount on all WSI brandsA 401(k) plan and other investment opportunitiesPaid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteerHealth benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefitsTax-free commuter benefitsA wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI UniversityCross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-developmentAdvisor (Mentor) programCareer development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. rows.descriptionText:
Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent is seeking a results-oriented, highly analytical, strategic and innovative individual to formulate business strategy, transform customer engagement and drive operational excellence via lead cross-functional projects to improve business performance. You have a strong understanding of B2B SaaS business models, market dynamics, customer segmentation and ability to translate insight into actionable business plans.

You have the talent to engage a wide range of senior stakeholders successfully and build credible relationships with the executive leadership team. You have a bias for action and are very comfortable in structuring and leading high impact cross-functional initiatives. You have an inherent ability to synthesize disparate inputs into actionable frameworks, solutions and ultimate drive to results. You will combine deep analytical, financial, management and technical know-how to address these business issues.

You will report directly to the SVP, Strategic Projects and PMO. You will dive in, hands-on and focus on execution in a fast-paced environment. You have deep insight into business operations and have driven strategic initiatives across Sales, Marketing, Product, Client Services, Finance and other Shared Services, preferably in a SaaS or high growth environment.

Spearhead cross-functional efforts to maximize revenue growth, drive operational excellence and customer satisfaction such as verticalized GTM motion and refine product integrations capabilityFormulate and refine strategic framework for growth over 5 years; conduct deep financial and operational analysis of customer baseUnderstand customer needs and manage a portfolio of AI powered initiatives to improve the customer experience that results in increased NPS and ARR Contribute to development of annual corporate priorities, prepare materials and analysis for board meetings and executive off-sitesConduct market research to determine impact of AI, research business trends, changing macro dynamics, leading practices to improve business strategy & operationsBuild and manage a portfolio of cross-functional strategic projects; formulate, define and prioritize projects based on business needsEstablish scalable dashboards and reporting mechanisms for key business metricsBuild and lead a high performing strategy and business operations team; mentor talent and foster a culture of analytical rigor and measurable impact15+ years of experience in strategy, or management consulting preferably within high-growth SaaS, enterprise software companies or top tier consulting companiesProven track record of shaping and executing company-wide strategies and delivering cross-functional initiativesDeep knowledge of SaaS metrics (i.e., CAC, LTV, ARR/NRR, Churn, etc.).Must be a well-balanced leader who can roll up their sleeves and focus on the detail while also grasping and supporting the big pictureStrong analytical and financial modeling skills; have previously built complex excel models to drive business decisionsStrong ability to compile, analyze and present data, including experience with AI-powered analytics tools, to inform strategic decision-makingExceptional written and interpersonal communication skills. rows.descriptionText:
Location

London

Business Area

Sales and Client Service

Ref #

10053298

Description & Requirements

Our Team 

Bloomberg’s Portfolio & Risk Analytics business delivers some of the industry's most sophisticated risk management, valuation, and investment analytics solutions to leading asset managers, pension funds, insurers, hedge funds, and sovereign institutions around the world.

Built on Bloomberg’s market-leading pricing engines, derivative libraries, and data infrastructure, our solutions help investment professionals value complex instruments, measure market and counterparty risk, streamline enterprise workflows, and make better portfolio decisions in real time.

As buy-side firms face increasing pressure to manage risk across more asset classes, larger data sets, and increasingly complex investment strategies, Bloomberg is uniquely positioned to provide an integrated, enterprise-wide solution spanning portfolio analytics, risk management, valuation, and investment workflows.

What’s the Role? 

We are seeking a commercially driven Enterprise Sales Specialist to lead new business growth across the UK market. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end sales lifecycle: identifying prospects, navigating complex enterprise sales cycles, and closing strategic deals with senior decision-makers.

You will position Bloomberg’s portfolio analytics and multi-asset risk solutions across a broad spectrum of buy-side investment workflows. You will articulate our capabilities across risk modeling, performance attribution, asset-liability management (ALM / LDI), private market asset integration, and modern data architecture.

We’ll Trust You To

Drive revenue growth by identifying, prospecting, and closing enterprise sales opportunities across the UK buy-side landscape. Build executive-level relationships with Chief Investment Officers, Chief Risk Officers, Heads of Asset Allocation, and Senior Portfolio Managers. Demonstrate Bloomberg’s enterprise value across diverse investment strategies, including multi-asset factor risk, LDI/ALM, credit and liquidity risk, and private markets. Partner with Pre-Sales Specialists, Relationship Managers, Product, and Core Sales teams to position holistic solutions across the investment management lifecycle. Manage a structured sales pipeline, lead enterprise contract negotiations, and consistently deliver against key commercial goals. 

You’ll Need To Have

Proven track record of enterprise sales success selling portfolio analytics, multi-asset risk, or financial technology solutions into institutional buy-side firms. Deep domain expertise in portfolio management, multi-factor risk models, performance attribution, and cross-asset valuation methodologies. Strong familiarity with modern institutional investment workflows, including active asset management, asset-liability management (ALM), LDI frameworks, and private market asset integration. A strong commercial mindset with demonstrated ability to manage long sales cycles and negotiate C-suite transactions. Knowledge of the UK landscape and market trends affecting both asset managers and asset owners. Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills. 

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at this:

https://www.bloomberg.com/professional/products/bloomberg-terminal/portfolio-analytics/

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

We are searching for top talent for the Director, GSINC Legal Template Transformation role within the Global Simplification and Innovation in Contracting program, GSINC!

Do you seek big, complex, and ambiguous challenges? Are you passionate about transforming enterprise contracting through simplified processes, modern technology, intelligent data, and responsible AI? Do you want to help build a capability that improves how Johnson & Johnson works with its employees, suppliers, customers, healthcare professionals, research partners, and other stakeholders?

GSINC is building an integrated, AI-enabled contracting capability designed to make contracting faster, simpler, more consistent, and more valuable to the enterprise! The program brings together process, policy, templates, technology, data, and intelligence to establish a scalable contracting foundation across Johnson & Johnson.

The Director owns the global strategy and execution for simplifying, governing, and implementing contract templates, clauses, fallback positions, and playbooks. The role translates approved legal strategy and risk parameters into scalable, user-centered content that preserves critical protections while improving consistency, speed, and readiness for technology, data, automation, and AI.

Operating with significant autonomy and enterprise visibility, the Director leads cross-functional delivery from drafting and approval through localization, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement. The role resolves issues within delegated authority and escalates material changes to legal position, policy, risk tolerance, or enterprise standards with clear recommendations.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the global legal template transformation roadmap, priorities, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.Lead the assessment, consolidation, simplification, drafting, validation, and approval of templates, clauses, fallback positions, playbooks, exhibits, and guidance.Set plain-language, user-centered content standards that maintain legal and compliance protections while reducing complexity, negotiation friction, critical issues, and cycle time.Steward consistent legal positions and risk treatment; challenge legacy approaches, decide within delegated authority, and frame material issues for senior leaders.Lead localization of globally neutral content, limiting variation to approved legal or operational requirements.Build the end-to-end operating model, including intake, simplification, taxonomy, roles, handoffs, maintenance, and supporting tools.Establish governance for ownership, version control, approvals, exceptions, review cycles, releases, and retirement.Sponsor implementation planning, stakeholder alignment, validation, testing, deployment readiness, and resolution of strategic risks, dependencies, and resource constraints.Define and report workstream measures for progress, adoption, simplification, cycle time, quality, risk, partner experience, and realized value.Partner on training, communications, adoption, lessons learned, and continuous improvement.Build alignment across Legal, business, contracting, Technology, and enabling functions; secure decisions and resources.Lead assigned team members and partners, with clear roles, expectations, accountability, and capacity plans.

Qualifications

Education:

Juris Doctor, LL.B., or equivalent law degree.Advanced training or experience in legal operations, contracting, project management, transformation, process improvement or change management is preferred.

Experience And Skills:

Minimum 10 years of legal or contracting experience, including leadership of complex commercial contracting, legal operations, or enterprise transformation; life sciences experience strongly preferred.Strong legal and enterprise judgment, balancing risk, compliance, business value, market practice, operational feasibility, and user experience.Demonstrated success leading complex global workstreams, navigating ambiguity, and influencing senior leaders without formal authority.Proven success delivering legal or contracting transformation at scale and connecting strategy, governance, content, technology, data, and change; fluency in automation, analytics, structured data, and responsible AI preferred.Executive communication, facilitation, decision-framing, program leadership, problem-solving, talent development, and accountability for outcomes.

Key Proficiencies:

Legal Judgment and Risk Leadership – Balances enterprise protection, simplicity, and business value.Strategic Execution, Accountability, and Governance – Converts enterprise strategy into a disciplined roadmap, clear decisions, effective controls, and measurable outcomes; owns delivery through others.Enterprise Influence and Stakeholder Leadership – Builds senior-level alignment, navigates competing priorities, and drives timely decisions across global partners.

This is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned.

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. rows.descriptionText:
Location

Business Area

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes.

Our Team

Our team is responsible for the end-to-end data management of equity corporate actions data (including dividends, stock splits, and rights offerings) as well as equities reference data to offer a comprehensive product offering for our internal and external partners such as Enterprise Data, Indices and News. Multi-functional collaboration, deep domain knowledge, thoughtful automation, and data management expertise are paramount for our ability to continuously deliver high quality data to our rapidly growing client base. Equity Corporate Actions and Reference data serve as foundational building blocks across our overall offering, supporting critical workflows for hundreds of thousands of financial market professionals across North America and global capital markets.

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on Senior Data Management Professional (DMP) - Data Engineering based in Princeton, NJ, to drive the technical evolution of our Equity Corporate Actions data products. In this role, you will act as a technical leader, navigating ambiguity to solve complex data challenges and engineer scalable, production-ready solutions.

This role is heavily focused on hands-on data engineering and the practical application of AI/LLMs for automated data extraction, validation and transformation to enterprise grade data model. You will design, build, and maintain high-throughput ETL pipelines, architect robust data models, and deploy intelligent automation frameworks to ingest and parse structured and unstructured financial data at scale.

We’ll Trust You To

Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver high-volume financial data using Python, SQL, and modern enterprise data technologies, including workflow orchestration, distributed processing, messaging frameworks, and cloud-based data platforms. Develop robust data architectures and automated ingestion frameworks that support structured and unstructured data sources, enabling scalable, high-performance data processing, schema design, and seamless interoperability across downstream systems. Leverage AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, and machine learning to extract, normalize, and enrich Corporate Actions data (e.g., dividends, stock splits, rights offerings) from issuer filings, regulatory disclosures, news, press releases, exchange feeds, and other complex data sources. Implement intelligent Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows and data quality frameworks that combine AI-driven extraction with automated validation, business rules, statistical methods, and exception management to maximize accuracy, completeness, and operational efficiency. Develop monitoring, reporting, and observability solutions by creating data quality dashboards, pipeline health metrics, and SLA monitoring capabilities that provide visibility into data integrity, processing performance, and operational effectiveness. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders to design scalable data solutions, standardize engineering best practices, and deliver high-quality data products that support trading, analytics, and client-facing applications.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Quantitative Finance, or an equivalent quantitative discipline.3+ years of hands-on experience in a Data Engineering or technical Data Management role, with a proven track record of building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines in a production environment.Advanced technical proficiency in Python (Pandas, PySpark, or standard data manipulation libraries) and complex SQL/NoSQL database engineering.Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs and Machine Learning (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AI Assisted APIs, Hugging Face, or custom NLP models) for structured/unstructured document processing and automated information extraction.Demonstrated experience with modern data tech stacks, including workflow orchestration engines, message streaming platforms, distributed computing frameworks, and object storage systems.Strong data modeling and schema design skills, with experience creating structures optimized for analytical capabilities.Exceptional problem-solving abilities, numerical proficiency, high attention to detail, and strong communication skills to present technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

Direct experience ingesting, normalizing, and processing exchange-disseminated US Equity Corporate Actions data (e.g., dividends, stock splits, rights offerings) and equity reference data.Industry certifications such as Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) or Data Capability Assessment Model (DCAM).Experience designing Human-in-the-Loop operational tooling and exception management workflows.Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog management, and modern data governance frameworks.

rows.title: Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
At Mintel, we help businesses understand people, markets, and what comes next. As a global market intelligence agency, our understanding of consumers, innovation, and markets gives clients the clarity to act and the confidence to lead. With more than 50 years of expertise, we combine the real-world understanding of our experts with advanced technology to uncover patterns, anticipate change, and help organizations make smarter decisions.

The Mintel Consulting team is an exciting arena to work in and a great place to launch your career as a Consultant. You must have a restless curiosity about the world, the ability to pivot on a dime, and a commercial mind that is always thinking end-game. You should come to the team with professional experience in consumer packaged goods strategy and insights and be eager to develop great trends-based consumer and market research.

You will be asked to demonstrate skills in critical thinking, should enjoy presenting to groups, display poise under pressure, and have the ability to manage multiple projects. We are also looking for heroic data skills, nimble BI talents, or exposure leading workshops or focus groups. In day-to-day work flow, you will be paired with and learn from seasoned Strategists on the team.

This is a Hybrid position based in Chicago

What You Will Be Doing

Rapidly organizing information, identifying patterns, drawing conclusions, and succinctly communicating key points in our data to clients within the consumer packaged goods industry.Translating knowledge visually in presentations using both our internal consumer and market data sources along with external resources.Managing a variety of unique custom projects simultaneously, thus practicing efficient time management skills.Working collaboratively across several different Mintel divisions such as sales, marketing, research analytics, and operations to deliver best-in-class custom work to our clients.

Who We Are Looking For

Commercially-Minded: You have a demonstrated talent for abstract thinking, spotting trends and patterns, an instinct for commercial opportunities, and a nuanced understanding of consumer insights are critical.A Storyteller: You are a lateral thinker, an intuitive dot-connector, and have experience weaving compelling narratives out of disparate facts across a wide range of categories. Data-Driven: You have solid familiarity with most forms of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies and working knowledge of when and how to apply them to a given client challenge. You should have expertise working with complex data sets, including econometrics, statistics, consumer surveys, and syndicated sales data, such as IRI or Nielsen. Experience with Business Intelligence and collaboration tools such as Tableau, Looker, Jira, Miro, etc. would be a plus.Naturally Curious: You are always drawn to knowing the “why” behind things and great at navigating client conversations, asking second and third level questions to get at the heart of clients’ challenges and goals.An Influencer: You have experience with brand strategy, innovation, or creative workshops and the energy, intellect, humility and passion that draws people to wanting to learn more from you.A Great Communicator: You are able to visualize strategic thought in evocative and engaging presentations, delivered with confidence and authority and can adapt your communication style to suit each client and internal business partner.A Collaborator: You take pride in the team you are a part of and the work you produce. Cultivating professional relationships with your colleagues is important and you are constantly finding innovative and unique ways to create an exceptional work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Race/Color/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Religion/National Origin/Disability/Vets

The below reflects the range of base salary for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, and qualifications. The salary range for this role is: $69,000 USD to $85,000 USD.

Alongside salary, Mintel offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employer paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match and paid time off. We are invested in our employees' wellbeing which is why we also offer flexible working hours, ClassPass subsidy, mental health benefit through Modern Health, paid volunteer time off, paid birthday leave and paid parental leave.

rows.title: Bloomberg Intelligence US Consumer Discretionary Softlines Research Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Location

New York

Business Area

Research

Ref #

10053757

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Intelligence (BI) delivers independent, data-driven research and interactive datasets integrated into the Bloomberg Terminal, helping investment professionals make decisions faster. With 500+ research professionals, BI provides company, credit, industry and strategy research across major global markets, covering 135+ industries and 2,000+ companies, including perspectives on company fundamentals as well as government policy, litigation, corporate governance and sustainable finance.

BI combines analyst expertise with interactive data, proprietary models and emerging technologies, including AI, to deliver faster, deeper and more differentiated research. Our research and datasets are delivered through curated Terminal dashboards and interactive research decks, with underlying data typically one click away, drawing on proprietary Bloomberg sources and 600+ data contributors.

What's In It For You

You would be part of an expanding team responsible for conducting analysis on a periodic and topical basis, and authoring equity research on companies within the US softlines retail sector, including specialty apparel stores, off-price retailers and department stores. You are entrusted to deliver high quality and timely content while also growing our data offering and producing deep thematic research on the key trends shaping the industry.

We'll Trust You To

 Leverage your knowledge of softlines retail sectors. Monitor and interpret major company developments and identify macro themes and trends affecting the industries. Conduct deep thematic research on structural trends, competitive dynamics and changing consumer behavior. Build and maintain financial, operating and scenario models to assess company performance, key sensitivities and expectations. Manage earnings cycle, including previews and reviews. Work closely with our global team of Bloomberg Intelligence analysts and strategists located across major financial centers to coordinate and collaborate on analysis. Develop and maintain relationships with investors, industry and market professionals, investor relations personnel, and senior management at target companies. Work with Global Data teams to ensure data completeness and quality control for existing and new data sets of target companies.

You Need To Have

 A minimum of 5 years of equity research experience, specializing in consumer, retail or related sectors. Sell-side or buy-side Research Analyst or Senior Associate experience preferred. Experience interpreting financial statements, building financial models and performing quantitative financial analysis. Knowledge of advanced concepts, practices, and procedures of finance and accounting. Ability to develop differentiated thematic research and translate industry and company data into investment-relevant conclusions. Exceptional primary research and writing skills. Excellent oral communication and presentation skills. Self-starter, independent thinker and collaborative team player. Strong organization skills and capable of handling multiple projects. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

We'd Love To See

 Direct experience covering specialty apparel stores, off-price retailers, department stores or related softlines retail sectors. CFA designation is preferred.

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match and we'll get in touch with you to let you know next steps. In the meantime, check out Bloomberg Intelligence to learn more about our research and data offering.

Salary Range = 215,000 - 285,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

rows.title: Senior Financial Specialist, Enterprise Products (Sell Side)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Location

New York

Business Area

Accounting and Finance

Ref #

10054083

Description & Requirements

The energy of a newsroom, the pace of a trading floor, the buzz of a recent tech breakthrough; we work hard, and we work fast - while keeping up the quality and accuracy we're known for. It's what keeps us inventing and reinventing, all the time. Our culture is wide open, just like our spaces. We bring out the best in each other through collaboration. Through our countless volunteer projects, we also help network with the communities around us, too. You can do outstanding work here. Work you couldn't do anywhere else. It's up to you to make it happen.

What's the role?

Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, news and insight and we use innovative technology to deliver trusted data and bring transparency to the financial markets. Our customers around the globe rely on us for the information and tools they need to make official investment decisions and remain connected across all sides of the financial community.

Our Global Finance organization provides financial analytics and insights to our business leaders. The Corporate Finance organization reports on the performance of the business and provides analysis to various stakeholders to guide key decisions. Our team provides our leaders with key drivers and considerations, as they execute their strategy and the daily operations.

As a Senior Financial Specialist, you will be responsible for the production and delivery of both recurring and ad-hoc management reporting and analysis. You will work in collaboration with the broader finance organization (Corporate Finance, Accounting, Tax, etc.) to ensure our data and reporting provide an accurate and insightful view of the business. You will also partner with internal stakeholders, prepare and analyze financial information (including budgets, forecasts, and other management reporting), and present findings to senior leaders to drive strategy and make better decisions.

We’ll Trust You With

 Prepare financial analysis and reporting for both recurring and ad-hoc management reporting, providing key stakeholders with insights into the performance of the business. Develop, maintain, and improve financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and recurring reports. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles for Enterprise Products. Analyze financial results, business drivers, and key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders, to influence project outcomes and resolve issues. Partner with Corporate Finance and Accounting during month-end close and annual budgeting to align actual results, accruals, and forecasts, while coordinating supporting requests through a centralized process. Partner with cross-functional business leaders (Product, Sales, Engineering, etc) to manage business relationships and translate financial insights into actionable recommendations. Evaluate special projects and business initiatives, including scenario analysis and assessment of financial impact. Gain a deep understanding of our workflows; drive process improvement to ensure we are operating as efficiently as possible, including the successful use of technology

You’ll Need To Have

 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 8-12+ years of experience in general finance, working across core financial activities (budgeting, management reporting, decision support, etc.) 2–4 years of experience partnering with business leaders and influencing senior stakeholders across the organization. Excellent analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into practical and actionable insights. Proficiency with spreadsheets and financial systems; experience building dashboards or using data visualization tools is a plus. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial information to non-finance stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, organization, and judgment, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and ad hoc priorities. A collaborative mindset and the ability to build productive relationships across Finance, Accounting, and business teams. Experience with financial systems (i.e. SAP, Oracle). Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with exceptional expertise in Excel and PowerPoint

The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Location

New York

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10054238

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Connects is a rapidly growing, free platform that helps museums, galleries, and cultural spaces make their institutions, stories and dynamic content more engaging to audiences around the world. Launched in 2019, Connects features multimedia guides with unique content exclusive to each of our over 1,500 cultural institution partners across 33 countries.

As part of Bloomberg's culture of giving back, Connects is a joint effort between Bloomberg and Bloomberg Philanthropies in support of their work to ensure better, longer lives for the greatest number of people by focusing on five key areas: the arts, education, the environment, government innovation, and public health.

We believe that technology opens doors, and we created Connects as a part of our mission to make art and culture accessible to all—in-person, at-home, and anywhere.

We are a team of designers, researchers, marketers, editors, engineers, and leaders working together to enhance our partner's capacity to reach audiences around the world and improve their visitor experience. Built through empathy and research, qualitative and quantitative data, and experimentation and iteration, our products seek to delight and empower.

What's in it for you?

The Data and Platform Tools team builds the systems behind Connects' analytics, search, speech, computer vision, and generative AI capabilities — plus the agentic core platform and tooling used by every discipline across the product organization.  Own product strategy and roadmap for Data and Platform Tools — spanning analytics and insights, semantic search, TTS/STT, computer vision, content generation, and the infrastructure behind our agentic systems Own product for our agentic core platform and tooling, used by every discipline across the product organization, not just engineering Partner with the Data and Platform Engineering Team Lead to prioritize and sequence platform investment against real, competing stakeholder demand Translate between deeply technical engineering work and the internal teams — engineering, business, and design — that depend on it, in both directions Build the roadmap and prioritization process this team currently lacks, so engineers can focus on building rather than triaging requests Manage a wide set of internal stakeholders — engineering, business, marketing, design, and product colleagues across every discipline — each with a different stake in the same underlying platform

 5+ years of product management experience, including platform, developer-tools, or internal-tooling product management — not purely consumer-facing product work A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related technical disciplines, or prior equivalent practical experience
